decl_259.name: FTC.Executable.stepCounted_remaining
decl_259.label: Executable.stepCounted_remaining
decl_259.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_259.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.Executable.stepCounted score Q).remaining = FTC.selectionStep (FTC.Executable.rationalRule score) Q
decl_259.source:
theorem stepCounted_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).remaining = selectionStep (rationalRule score) Q := by
  by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
  · have hn := selectedPair_ne_none (score Q) hQ
    cases hp : selectedPair (score Q) Q with
    | none => exact False.elim (hn hp)
    | some p =>
      have hp' : (maximumCounted (evaluateScores (score Q) (Q.sort (· ≤ ·))).1).1 =
          some p := hp
      simp only [stepCounted, hp']
      simp [selectionStep, hQ, rationalRule, rationalChoice, hp]
  · have hzero : Q = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
    subst Q
    simp [stepCounted, evaluateScores, maximumCounted, selectionStep]

decl_244.name: FTC.Executable.runCounted
decl_244.label: Executable.runCounted
decl_244.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_244.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder I] → (Finset I → I → ℚ) → ℕ → Finset I → FTC.Executable.WorkResult I
decl_244.source:
def runCounted (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) : ℕ → Finset I → WorkResult I
  | 0, Q => ⟨Q, 0, 0, 0⟩
  | n + 1, Q =>
      if Q.Nonempty then
        let first := stepCounted score Q
        let rest := runCounted score n first.remaining
        ⟨rest.remaining, first.scoreCalls + rest.scoreCalls,
          first.comparisons + rest.comparisons, first.deletions + rest.deletions⟩
      else ⟨Q, 0, 0, 0⟩

decl_253.name: FTC.Executable.selectionRun_empty
decl_253.label: Executable.selectionRun_empty
decl_253.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_253.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ), FTC.selectionRun rule n ∅ = ∅
decl_253.source:
theorem selectionRun_empty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) :
    selectionRun rule n ∅ = ∅ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa [selectionRun, selectionStep] using ih

decl_248.name: FTC.Executable.runCounted_remaining
decl_248.label: Executable.runCounted_remaining
decl_248.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_248.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.Executable.runCounted score n Q).remaining = FTC.Executable.decode score n Q
decl_248.source:
theorem runCounted_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).remaining = decode score n Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      rw [ih, stepCounted_remaining]
      rfl
    · have hzero : Q = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
      subst Q
      simp [runCounted, decode, selectionRun_empty]

decl_249.name: FTC.Executable.runCounted_scoreCalls_le
decl_249.label: Executable.runCounted_scoreCalls_le
decl_249.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_249.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.Executable.runCounted score n Q).scoreCalls ≤ n * Q.card
decl_249.source:
theorem runCounted_scoreCalls_le (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).scoreCalls ≤ n * Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [runCounted]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      have hrest := ih (stepCounted score Q).remaining
      have hsub : (stepCounted score Q).remaining ⊆ Q := by
        rw [stepCounted_remaining]
        exact selectionStep_subset _ _
      have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
      rw [stepCounted_scoreCalls]
      nlinarith
    · simp [runCounted, hQ]

decl_246.name: FTC.Executable.runCounted_comparisons_le
decl_246.label: Executable.runCounted_comparisons_le
decl_246.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_246.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.Executable.runCounted score n Q).comparisons ≤ n * (Q.card - 1)
decl_246.source:
theorem runCounted_comparisons_le (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).comparisons ≤ n * (Q.card - 1) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [runCounted]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      have hrest := ih (stepCounted score Q).remaining
      have hsub : (stepCounted score Q).remaining ⊆ Q := by
        rw [stepCounted_remaining]
        exact selectionStep_subset _ _
      have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Finset.card_le_card hsub) 1)
      rw [stepCounted_comparisons]
      nlinarith
    · simp [runCounted, hQ]

/-- The executable rational-score decoder inherits the full deterministic
filtering guarantee from the shared selector-parametric proof. -/

decl_176.name: FTC.Executable.decode_correct
decl_176.label: Executable.decode_correct
decl_176.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_176.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder I] {S : Type u_2} {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ}
  {ε δ α : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ d i s) →
      (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ reference s) →
        0 ≤ ε →
          ε < 1 / 10 →
            0 ≤ δ →
              1 ≤ α →
                FTC.IsCoreset ε reference (FTC.cost c U) →
                  B.card ≤ f →
                    (∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ (s : S), d i s = c i s) →
                      (∀ i ∈ U, ∀ (s : S), c i s ≤ δ * reference s) →
                        ↑f * α * δ ≤ ε →
                          ∀ (score : Finset I → I → ℚ),
                            (∀ (Q : Finset I), ∀ i ∈ Q, FTC.sensitivity d Q i ≤ α * ↑(score Q i)) →
                              (∀ (Q : Finset I), ∀ i ∈ Q, ↑(score Q i) ≤ FTC.sensitivity d Q i) →
                                FTC.IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (FTC.cost d (FTC.Executable.decode score f U))
decl_176.source:
theorem decode_correct {S : Type*} {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hd : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s)
    (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U)) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (score : Finset I → I → ℚ)
    (hlower : ∀ Q i, i ∈ Q → sensitivity d Q i ≤ α * (score Q i : ℝ))
    (hupper : ∀ Q i, i ∈ Q → (score Q i : ℝ) ≤ sensitivity d Q i) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (decode score f U)) := by
  let oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α := ⟨fun Q i => (score Q i : ℝ), hlower, hupper⟩
  exact filtering_decoder_correct_with_rule hc hd hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα
    hcoreset hB hagrees hentry hbudget oracle (rationalRule score) (rationalRule_isMaxFor score)

end OrderedIndices
end FTC.Executable

decl_156.name: FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCosts
decl_156.label: Executable.cachedQueryCosts
decl_156.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.

def cachedQueryCosts (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) : List (S × ℚ) :=

decl_180.name: FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver
decl_180.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolver
decl_180.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_180.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → List S → Option S
decl_180.source:
def exactFiniteSolver (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) : Option S :=
  ((cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).argmin Prod.snd).map Prod.fst

decl_184.name: FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver_none_iff
decl_184.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolver_none_iff
decl_184.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_184.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S),
  FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = none ↔ candidates = []
decl_184.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolver_none_iff (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = none ↔ candidates = [] := by
  simp [exactFiniteSolver, cachedQueryCosts, List.argmin_eq_none]

decl_185.name: FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver_spec
decl_185.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolver_spec
decl_185.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_185.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I} {candidates : List S}
  {s : S},
  FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = some s →
    s ∈ candidates ∧ ∀ t ∈ candidates, FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U s ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U t
decl_185.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolver_spec {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I} {candidates : List S}
    {s : S} (hsolve : exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = some s) :
    s ∈ candidates ∧ ∀ t ∈ candidates, rationalCost c U s ≤ rationalCost c U t := by
  unfold exactFiniteSolver at hsolve
  cases hbest : (cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).argmin Prod.snd with
  | none => simp [hbest] at hsolve
  | some best =>
    have hmem : best ∈ cachedQueryCosts c U candidates := List.argmin_mem hbest
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
    have hts : t = s := by simpa [hbest] using hsolve
    subst s
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    exact List.le_of_mem_argmin (f := Prod.snd)
      (a := (q, rationalCost c U q)) (m := (t, rationalCost c U t))
      (l := cachedQueryCosts c U candidates)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩) hbest

/-- Filtering candidates before the scan skips precisely the infeasible ones. -/

decl_167.name: FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver
decl_167.label: Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver
decl_167.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_167.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → List S → (admissible : S → Prop) → [DecidablePred admissible] → Option S

decl_171.name: FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff
decl_171.label: Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff
decl_171.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_171.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S)
  (admissible : S → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred admissible],
  FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = none ↔ ¬∃ s ∈ candidates, admissible s
decl_171.source:
theorem constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I)
    (candidates : List S) (admissible : S → Prop) [DecidablePred admissible] :
    constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = none ↔
      ¬ ∃ s ∈ candidates, admissible s := by
  rw [constrainedFiniteSolver, exactFiniteSolver_none_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h ⟨s, hs, ha⟩
    have hm : s ∈ candidates.filter (fun s => decide (admissible s)) := by simp [hs, ha]
    rw [h] at hm
    exact List.not_mem_nil hm
  · intro h
    apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
    intro s hs
    have hm : s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s := by simpa using hs
    exact h ⟨s, hm.1, hm.2⟩

decl_172.name: FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_spec
decl_172.label: Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_spec
decl_172.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_172.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I} {candidates : List S}
  {admissible : S → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred admissible] {s : S},
  FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = some s →
    s ∈ candidates ∧
      admissible s ∧
        ∀ t ∈ candidates, admissible t → FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U s ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U t
decl_172.source:
theorem constrainedFiniteSolver_spec {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I}
    {candidates : List S} {admissible : S → Prop} [DecidablePred admissible]
    {s : S} (hsolve : constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = some s) :
    s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s ∧
      ∀ t ∈ candidates, admissible t → rationalCost c U s ≤ rationalCost c U t := by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hopt⟩ := exactFiniteSolver_spec hsolve
  have hs : s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s := by simpa using hmem
  refine ⟨hs.1, hs.2, ?_⟩
  intro t ht ha
  exact hopt t (by simp [ht, ha])

/-! ## Counters carried by the exhaustive scan -/

decl_157.name: FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted
decl_157.label: Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted
decl_157.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_157.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → List S → List (S × ℚ) × ℕ
decl_157.source:
def cachedQueryCostsCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) :
    List S → List (S × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => ([], 0)
  | s :: candidates =>
    let value := rationalCostCounted c U s
    let rest := cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates
    ((s, value.1) :: rest.1, value.2 + rest.2)

decl_158.name: FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_value
decl_158.label: Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_value
decl_158.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_158.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S),
  (FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1 = FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCosts c U candidates
decl_158.source:
theorem cachedQueryCostsCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1 = cachedQueryCosts c U candidates := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s candidates ih =>
    simp [cachedQueryCostsCounted, cachedQueryCosts, ih]

decl_159.name: FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_work
decl_159.label: Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_work
decl_159.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_159.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S),
  (FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).2 = 2 * U.card * candidates.length
decl_159.source:
theorem cachedQueryCostsCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).2 = 2 * U.card * candidates.length := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => simp [cachedQueryCostsCounted]
  | cons s candidates ih =>
    simp only [cachedQueryCostsCounted, rationalCostCounted_work, ih, List.length_cons,
      Nat.mul_succ]
    omega

/-- A cached minimum scan, with one comparison at each nontrivial merge. -/

decl_153.name: FTC.Executable.argminCounted
decl_153.label: Executable.argminCounted
decl_153.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_153.statement: {S : Type u_2} → List (S × ℚ) → Option (S × ℚ) × ℕ
decl_153.source:
def argminCounted : List (S × ℚ) → Option (S × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => (none, 0)
  | a :: candidates =>
    let rest := argminCounted candidates
    match rest.1 with
    | none => (some a, rest.2)
    | some b => (some (if b.2 < a.2 then b else a), rest.2 + 1)

decl_154.name: FTC.Executable.argminCounted_value
decl_154.label: Executable.argminCounted_value
decl_154.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_154.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] (candidates : List (S × ℚ)),
  (FTC.Executable.argminCounted candidates).1 = List.argmin Prod.snd candidates
decl_154.source:
theorem argminCounted_value (candidates : List (S × ℚ)) :
    (argminCounted candidates).1 = candidates.argmin Prod.snd := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a candidates ih =>
    rw [List.argmin_cons]
    simp only [argminCounted, ← ih]
    cases h : (argminCounted candidates).1
    · rfl
    · simp only
      split_ifs <;> rfl

decl_155.name: FTC.Executable.argminCounted_work_le
decl_155.label: Executable.argminCounted_work_le
decl_155.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_155.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] (candidates : List (S × ℚ)),
  (FTC.Executable.argminCounted candidates).2 ≤ candidates.length
decl_155.source:
theorem argminCounted_work_le (candidates : List (S × ℚ)) :
    (argminCounted candidates).2 ≤ candidates.length := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons a candidates ih =>
    simp only [argminCounted]
    cases h : (argminCounted candidates).1 <;> simp only [h]
    · exact ih.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    · exact Nat.succ_le_succ ih

decl_181.name: FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted
decl_181.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted
decl_181.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_181.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → List S → Option S × ℕ
decl_181.source:
def exactFiniteSolverCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    Option S × ℕ :=
  let cache := cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates
  let optimum := argminCounted cache.1
  (optimum.1.map Prod.fst, cache.2 + optimum.2)

decl_182.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted_value
decl_182.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_182.statement:

  (FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).1 = FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver c U candidates
decl_182.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolverCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).1 = exactFiniteSolver c U candidates := by
  simp [exactFiniteSolverCounted, exactFiniteSolver, argminCounted_value,
    cachedQueryCostsCounted_value]

/-- One cost evaluation per candidate and at most one cached comparison per
candidate: exponential candidate enumeration is exposed, not hidden. -/

decl_183.name: FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted_work_le
decl_183.label: Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted_work_le
decl_183.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricEnumeration.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_183.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S),
  (FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).2 ≤ (2 * U.card + 1) * candidates.length
decl_183.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolverCounted_work_le (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).2 ≤
      (2 * U.card + 1) * candidates.length := by
  have h := argminCounted_work_le (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1
  rw [cachedQueryCostsCounted_value] at h
  have hlen : (cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).length = candidates.length := by
    simp [cachedQueryCosts]
  rw [hlen] at h
  change (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).2 +
      (argminCounted (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1).2 ≤ _
  rw [cachedQueryCostsCounted_work, cachedQueryCostsCounted_value]
  simpa [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using
    Nat.add_le_add_left h (2 * U.card * candidates.length)

decl_150.name: FTC.Executable.RationalMetric
decl_150.label: Executable.RationalMetric
decl_150.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_150.source:
structure RationalMetric (X : Type*) where
  distance : X → X → ℚ
  self : ∀ x, distance x x = 0
  comm : ∀ x y, distance x y = distance y x
  triangle : ∀ x y z, distance x z ≤ distance x y + distance y z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ x y, distance x y = 0 → x = y

decl_151.name: FTC.Executable.RationalMetric.toMetricSpace
decl_151.label: Executable.RationalMetric.toMetricSpace
decl_151.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_151.statement: {X : Type u_2} → FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → MetricSpace X
decl_151.source:
@[reducible] noncomputable def RationalMetric.toMetricSpace (d : RationalMetric X) : MetricSpace X where
  dist x y := (d.distance x y : ℝ)
  dist_self x := by simp [d.self]
  dist_comm x y := by rw [d.comm]
  dist_triangle x y z := by exact_mod_cast d.triangle x y z
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
    intro x y h
    exact d.eq_of_zero x y (by exact_mod_cast h)

structure RationalEntry (X : Type*) where

decl_226.name: FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss
decl_226.label: Executable.rationalPointLoss
decl_226.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_226.statement: {X : Type u_2} → FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → X → Finset X → ℚ
decl_226.source:
def rationalPointLoss (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : Finset X) : ℚ :=
  if h : C.Nonempty then C.inf' h (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) else 0

decl_228.name: FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss_nonneg
decl_228.label: Executable.rationalPointLoss_nonneg
decl_228.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_228.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : Finset X),
  0 ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss d p C
decl_228.source:
theorem rationalPointLoss_nonneg (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : Finset X) :
    0 ≤ rationalPointLoss d p C := by
  unfold rationalPointLoss
  split_ifs
  · exact Finset.le_inf' _ _ (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  · exact le_rfl

decl_218.name: FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss
decl_218.label: Executable.rationalKmeansLoss
decl_218.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_218.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} → FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → (I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) → I → Finset X → ℚ

decl_219.name: FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg
decl_219.label: Executable.rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg
decl_219.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_219.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X)
  (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (i : I) (C : Finset X),
  0 ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss d entries i C
decl_219.source:
theorem rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X) :
    ∀ i C, 0 ≤ rationalKmeansLoss d entries i C :=
  fun i C => mul_nonneg (entries i).weight_nonneg (rationalPointLoss_nonneg d _ C)

/-- All k-center subsets, in a computable canonical order. -/

decl_160.name: FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList
decl_160.label: Executable.centerCandidateList
decl_160.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_160.statement: {X : Type u_2} → [LinearOrder X] → Finset X → ℕ → List (Finset X)
decl_160.source:
def centerCandidateList (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) : List (Finset X) :=
  ((Y.sort).sublistsLen k).map List.toFinset

decl_205.name: FTC.Executable.mem_centerCandidateList
decl_205.label: Executable.mem_centerCandidateList
decl_205.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_205.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] {k : ℕ} {Y C : Finset X},
  C ∈ FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList Y k ↔ C ⊆ Y ∧ C.card = k
decl_205.source:
theorem mem_centerCandidateList {Y C : Finset X} :
    C ∈ centerCandidateList Y k ↔ C ⊆ Y ∧ C.card = k := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    obtain ⟨hsub, hlen⟩ := List.mem_sublistsLen.mp hl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hxl : x ∈ l := List.mem_toFinset.mp hx
      exact (Finset.mem_sort _).mp (hsub.subset hxl)
    · rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup ((Y.sort_nodup _).sublist hsub)]
      exact hlen
  · rintro ⟨hsub, hcard⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨C.sort, ?_, by simp⟩
    apply List.mem_sublistsLen.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, by simpa using hcard⟩
    apply List.sublist_of_subperm_of_pairwise
      (List.subperm_of_subset (C.sort_nodup _) ?_)
      (C.pairwise_sort _) (Y.pairwise_sort _)
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_sort _).mpr (hsub ((Finset.mem_sort _).mp hx))

decl_161.name: FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList_length
decl_161.label: Executable.centerCandidateList_length
decl_161.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_161.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ),
  (FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList Y k).length = Y.card.choose k
decl_161.source:
theorem centerCandidateList_length (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) :
    (centerCandidateList Y k).length = Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  simp [centerCandidateList, List.length_sublistsLen]

/-- At radius r all centers must be at squared distance at least r from p. -/

decl_206.name: FTC.Executable.rationalAdmissible
decl_206.label: Executable.rationalAdmissible
decl_206.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_206.statement: {X : Type u_2} → FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → X → ℚ → Finset X → Prop
decl_206.source:
def rationalAdmissible (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) (C : Finset X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C, r ≤ d.distance p x ^ 2

instance rationalAdmissibleDecidable (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    DecidablePred (rationalAdmissible d p r) := by
  intro C
  unfold rationalAdmissible
  infer_instance

/-- An actual exhaustive constrained weighted k-means solver. -/

decl_186.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans
decl_186.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeans
decl_186.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_186.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [LinearOrder X] →
      [Fintype X] →
        FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X →
          (I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) → Finset I → Finset X → ℕ → X → ℚ → Option (Finset X)
decl_186.source:
def exactRationalKmeans (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) : Option (Finset X) :=
  constrainedFiniteSolver (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U
    (centerCandidateList Y k) (rationalAdmissible d p r)

decl_194.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans_spec
decl_194.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeans_spec
decl_194.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_194.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [inst : LinearOrder X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] {k : ℕ}
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X)
  (p : X) (r : ℚ) {C : Finset X},
  FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = some C →
    C ⊆ Y ∧
      C.card = k ∧
        FTC.Executable.rationalAdmissible d p r C ∧
          ∀ D ⊆ Y,
            D.card = k →
              FTC.Executable.rationalAdmissible d p r D →
                FTC.Executable.rationalCost (FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U C ≤
                  FTC.Executable.rationalCost (FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U D
decl_194.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeans_spec (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) {C : Finset X}
    (h : exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = some C) :
    C ⊆ Y ∧ C.card = k ∧ rationalAdmissible d p r C ∧
      ∀ D ⊆ Y, D.card = k → rationalAdmissible d p r D →
        rationalCost (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U C ≤
          rationalCost (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U D := by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hadm, hopt⟩ := constrainedFiniteSolver_spec h
  obtain ⟨hsub, hcard⟩ := mem_centerCandidateList.mp hmem
  refine ⟨hsub, hcard, hadm, ?_⟩
  intro D hDY hDk hDa
  exact hopt D (mem_centerCandidateList.mpr ⟨hDY, hDk⟩) hDa

decl_193.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans_none_iff
decl_193.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeans_none_iff
decl_193.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_193.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [inst : LinearOrder X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] {k : ℕ}
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X)
  (p : X) (r : ℚ),
  FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = none ↔
    ¬∃ C ⊆ Y, C.card = k ∧ FTC.Executable.rationalAdmissible d p r C
decl_193.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeans_none_iff (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = none ↔
      ¬ ∃ C ⊆ Y, C.card = k ∧ rationalAdmissible d p r C := by
  rw [exactRationalKmeans, constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff]
  simp only [mem_centerCandidateList, and_assoc, exists_prop]

decl_187.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.

decl_188.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_188.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [inst : LinearOrder X] [inst_1 : Fintype X]
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X)

decl_188.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeansCounted_value (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    (exactRationalKmeansCounted d entries U Y k p r).1 =

/-- This counts rational-loss matrix accesses/additions and cached comparisons;
each matrix access here evaluates the point-to-center minimum. Thus this is
an explicit query/matrix-call bound, not a bit-complexity runtime assertion. -/

decl_189.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansCounted_work_le
decl_189.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeansCounted_work_le
decl_189.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_189.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [inst : LinearOrder X] [inst_1 : Fintype X]
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X)
  (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ),
  (FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansCounted d entries U Y k p r).2 ≤ (2 * U.card + 1) * Y.card.choose k
decl_189.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeansCounted_work_le (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    (exactRationalKmeansCounted d entries U Y k p r).2 ≤
      (2 * U.card + 1) * Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  simpa [exactRationalKmeansCounted, centerCandidateList_length] using
    constrainedFiniteSolverCounted_work_le (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U
      (centerCandidateList Y k) (rationalAdmissible d p r)

/-! ## Exact interpretation as the real k-means sensitivity -/

instance centerSetDecidableEq : DecidableEq (CenterSet X k) := fun C D =>
  if h : C.centers = D.centers then
    isTrue (by cases C; cases D; cases h; rfl)
  else isFalse (fun hCD => h (congrArg CenterSet.centers hCD))

/-- Finite enumeration of the actual nonempty k-center query type. -/

decl_162.name: FTC.Executable.centerQueries
decl_162.label: Executable.centerQueries
decl_162.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_162.statement: {X : Type u_2} → [LinearOrder X] → Finset X → (k : ℕ) → 0 < k → Finset (FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k)
decl_162.source:
def centerQueries (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : Finset (CenterSet X k) :=
  (Y.powersetCard k).attach.image (fun C =>
    ⟨C.val, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp C.property).2,
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp C.property).2] using hk)⟩)

decl_164.name: FTC.Executable.centerQueries_complete
decl_164.label: Executable.centerQueries_complete
decl_164.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_164.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  C ∈ FTC.Executable.centerQueries Finset.univ k hk
decl_164.source:
theorem centerQueries_complete (hk : 0 < k) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    C ∈ centerQueries (Finset.univ : Finset X) k hk := by
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  have hC : C.centers ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset X).powersetCard k :=
    Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, C.card_eq⟩
  refine ⟨⟨C.centers, hC⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
  cases C
  rfl

decl_163.name: FTC.Executable.centerQueries_card_le
decl_163.label: Executable.centerQueries_card_le
decl_163.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_163.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] {k : ℕ} (Y : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k),
  (FTC.Executable.centerQueries Y k hk).card ≤ Y.card.choose k
decl_163.source:
theorem centerQueries_card_le (Y : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (centerQueries Y k hk).card ≤ Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (by simp [Finset.card_powersetCard])

decl_207.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix
decl_207.label: Executable.rationalCenterMatrix
decl_207.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_207.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    {k : ℕ} →
      FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → (I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) → I → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k → ℚ
decl_207.source:
def rationalCenterMatrix (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℚ := rationalKmeansLoss d entries i C.centers

decl_227.name: FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss_cast
decl_227.label: Executable.rationalPointLoss_cast
decl_227.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_227.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] {k : ℕ} (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (p : X)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  ↑(FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss d p C.centers) = FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C
decl_227.source:
theorem rationalPointLoss_cast (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    (rationalPointLoss d p C.centers : ℝ) = kmeansLoss p C := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  unfold rationalPointLoss
  rw [dif_pos C.nonempty]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro x hx
    have hq : C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) ≤ d.distance p x ^ 2 :=
      Finset.inf'_le _ hx
    change ((C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      (d.distance p x : ℝ) ^ 2
    exact_mod_cast hq
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2)
    rw [hmin]
    have hreal : kmeansLoss p C ≤ (d.distance p x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq p C hx
    simpa only [Rat.cast_pow] using hreal

decl_208.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix_cast
decl_208.label: Executable.rationalCenterMatrix_cast
decl_208.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_208.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [LinearOrder X] [Fintype X] {k : ℕ}
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (i : I)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.Executable.realContribution (FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix d entries) i C =
    FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss (fun j => (entries j).toReal) i C
decl_208.source:
theorem rationalCenterMatrix_cast (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    realContribution (rationalCenterMatrix d entries) i C =
      weightedLoss (fun j => (entries j).toReal) i C := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  change (((entries i).weight * rationalPointLoss d (entries i).point C.centers : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
  push_cast
  rw [rationalPointLoss_cast]
  rfl

/-- Executable exact rational sensitivity for genuine weighted k-means. -/

decl_190.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity
decl_190.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity
decl_190.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_190.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [DecidableEq I] →
      [LinearOrder X] →
        [Fintype X] →
          {k : ℕ} → FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X → (I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) → 0 < k → Finset I → I → ℚ
decl_190.source:
def exactRationalKmeansSensitivity (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) : ℚ :=
  rationalSensitivity (rationalCenterMatrix d entries)
    (centerQueries Finset.univ k hk) U i

decl_191.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_cast_eq
decl_191.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_cast_eq
decl_191.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_191.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [inst_1 : LinearOrder X] [inst_2 : Fintype X] {k : ℕ}
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I)
  (i : I),
  ↑(FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity d entries hk U i) =
    FTC.sensitivity (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss fun j => (entries j).toReal) U i
decl_191.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_cast_eq (d : RationalMetric X)
    (entries : I → RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    (exactRationalKmeansSensitivity d entries hk U i : ℝ) =
      sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) (fun j => (entries j).toReal)) U i := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  have hmatrix : realContribution (rationalCenterMatrix (k := k) d entries) =
      weightedLoss (k := k) (fun j => (entries j).toReal) := by
    funext j C
    exact rationalCenterMatrix_cast d entries j C
  have hc : ∀ (j : I) (C : CenterSet X k), 0 ≤ rationalCenterMatrix d entries j C :=
    fun j C => rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg d entries j C.centers
  have heq := rationalSensitivity_cast_eq
    (c := rationalCenterMatrix (k := k) d entries)
    (queries := centerQueries (Finset.univ : Finset X) k hk)
    hc (centerQueries_complete hk) U i
  rw [hmatrix] at heq
  exact heq

decl_192.name: FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_work_le
decl_192.label: Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_work_le
decl_192.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricKMeans.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_192.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [inst_1 : LinearOrder X] [inst_2 : Fintype X] {k : ℕ}
  (d : FTC.Executable.RationalMetric X) (entries : I → FTC.Executable.RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I)
  (i : I),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted (FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix d entries)
        (FTC.Executable.centerQueries Finset.univ k hk) U i).2 ≤
    (Fintype.card X).choose k * (2 * U.card + 3)
decl_192.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_work_le (d : RationalMetric X)
    (entries : I → RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted (rationalCenterMatrix d entries)
      (centerQueries Finset.univ k hk) U i).2 ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card X) k * (2 * U.card + 3) := by
  rw [rationalSensitivityCounted_work]
  split_ifs
  · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by simpa using centerQueries_card_le (Finset.univ : Finset X) hk)
  · exact Nat.zero_le _

end FTC.Executable

decl_220.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax
decl_220.label: Executable.rationalMax
decl_220.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_220.statement: {S : Type u_2} → Finset S → (S → ℚ) → ℚ
decl_220.source:
def rationalMax (queries : Finset S) (f : S → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  queries.fold max 0 f

decl_222.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax_empty
decl_222.label: Executable.rationalMax_empty
decl_222.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_222.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] (f : S → ℚ), FTC.Executable.rationalMax ∅ f = 0
decl_222.source: @[simp] theorem rationalMax_empty (f : S → ℚ) : rationalMax ∅ f = 0 := rfl

decl_223.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax_insert
decl_223.label: Executable.rationalMax_insert
decl_223.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_223.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq S] {queries : Finset S} {s : S},
  s ∉ queries →
    ∀ (f : S → ℚ), FTC.Executable.rationalMax (insert s queries) f = max (f s) (FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries f)
decl_223.source:
theorem rationalMax_insert {queries : Finset S} {s : S} (hs : s ∉ queries)
    (f : S → ℚ) : rationalMax (insert s queries) f = max (f s) (rationalMax queries f) := by
  exact Finset.fold_insert hs

decl_225.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax_nonneg
decl_225.label: Executable.rationalMax_nonneg
decl_225.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_225.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] (queries : Finset S) (f : S → ℚ), 0 ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries f
decl_225.source:
theorem rationalMax_nonneg (queries : Finset S) (f : S → ℚ) :
    0 ≤ rationalMax queries f := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact le_rfl
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs]
    exact ih.trans (le_max_right _ _)

decl_195.name: FTC.Executable.le_rationalMax
decl_195.label: Executable.le_rationalMax
decl_195.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_195.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] {queries : Finset S} {s : S},
  s ∈ queries → ∀ (f : S → ℚ), f s ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries f
decl_195.source:
theorem le_rationalMax {queries : Finset S} {s : S} (hs : s ∈ queries) (f : S → ℚ) :
    f s ≤ rationalMax queries f := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp at hs
  | @insert t queries ht ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert ht]
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hs with rfl | hs
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact (ih hs).trans (le_max_right _ _)

decl_224.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax_le
decl_224.label: Executable.rationalMax_le
decl_224.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_224.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℚ},
  0 ≤ r → (∀ s ∈ queries, f s ≤ r) → FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries f ≤ r
decl_224.source:
theorem rationalMax_le {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℚ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : ∀ s ∈ queries, f s ≤ r) : rationalMax queries f ≤ r := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact hr
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs]
    exact max_le (h s (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun t ht => h t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)))

decl_221.name: FTC.Executable.rationalMax_cast_le
decl_221.label: Executable.rationalMax_cast_le
decl_221.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_221.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq S] {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (∀ s ∈ queries, ↑(f s) ≤ r) → ↑(FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries f) ≤ r
decl_221.source:
theorem rationalMax_cast_le {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : ∀ s ∈ queries, (f s : ℝ) ≤ r) :
    (rationalMax queries f : ℝ) ≤ r := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hr
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs, Rat.cast_max]
    exact max_le (h s (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun t ht => h t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)))

decl_242.name: FTC.Executable.realContribution

decl_242.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_242.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → I → S → ℝ
decl_242.source: def realContribution (c : I → S → ℚ) (i : I) (s : S) : ℝ := c i s

decl_243.name: FTC.Executable.realContribution_nonneg
decl_243.label: Executable.realContribution_nonneg
decl_243.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_243.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] {c : I → S → ℚ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) → ∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ FTC.Executable.realContribution c i s
decl_243.source:
theorem realContribution_nonneg {c : I → S → ℚ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) :
    ∀ i s, 0 ≤ realContribution c i s := by
  intro i s
  change 0 ≤ (c i s : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast hc i s

decl_215.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCost_cast
decl_215.label: Executable.rationalCost_cast
decl_215.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_215.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S),
  ↑(FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U s) = FTC.cost (FTC.Executable.realContribution c) U s
decl_215.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCost_cast (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCost c U s : ℝ) = cost (realContribution c) U s := by
  simp [rationalCost, cost, realContribution]

decl_216.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCost_nonneg
decl_216.label: Executable.rationalCost_nonneg
decl_216.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_216.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] {c : I → S → ℚ},
