theorem rationalCost_nonneg {c : I → S → ℚ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (U : Finset I) (s : S) : 0 ≤ rationalCost c U s :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hc i s)

/-- Rational zero-cost ratios are zero, agreeing with the real API. -/

decl_229.name: FTC.Executable.rationalRatio
decl_229.label: Executable.rationalRatio
decl_229.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_229.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → I → S → ℚ
decl_229.source:
def rationalRatio (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) : ℚ :=
  c i s / rationalCost c U s

decl_233.name: FTC.Executable.rationalRatio_cast
decl_233.label: Executable.rationalRatio_cast
decl_233.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_233.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S),
  ↑(FTC.Executable.rationalRatio c U i s) =
    FTC.Executable.realContribution c i s / FTC.cost (FTC.Executable.realContribution c) U s
decl_233.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatio_cast (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatio c U i s : ℝ) = realContribution c i s / cost (realContribution c) U s := by
  simp [rationalRatio, realContribution]

/-- Executable exact sensitivity of an active entry over a finite query matrix. -/

decl_236.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity
decl_236.label: Executable.rationalSensitivity
decl_236.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_236.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq I] → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset S → Finset I → I → ℚ
decl_236.source:
def rationalSensitivity (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) : ℚ :=
  if i ∈ U then rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) else 0

decl_241.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity_nonneg
decl_241.label: Executable.rationalSensitivity_nonneg
decl_241.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_241.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
  (U : Finset I) (i : I), 0 ≤ FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity c queries U i
decl_241.source:
theorem rationalSensitivity_nonneg (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) : 0 ≤ rationalSensitivity c queries U i := by
  unfold rationalSensitivity
  split_ifs
  · exact rationalMax_nonneg _ _
  · exact le_rfl

/-- The computed rational score casts to exactly the real supremum. This is
an equality of mathematical meanings, not an implementation of real suprema. -/

decl_240.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity_cast_eq
decl_240.label: Executable.rationalSensitivity_cast_eq
decl_240.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_240.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] {c : I → S → ℚ} {queries : Finset S},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    (∀ (s : S), s ∈ queries) →
      ∀ (U : Finset I) (i : I),
        ↑(FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity c queries U i) = FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Executable.realContribution c) U i
decl_240.source:
theorem rationalSensitivity_cast_eq {c : I → S → ℚ} {queries : Finset S}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hqueries : ∀ s : S, s ∈ queries)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivity c queries U i : ℝ) = sensitivity (realContribution c) U i := by
  have hcR := realContribution_nonneg hc
  by_cases hi : i ∈ U
  · unfold rationalSensitivity
    rw [if_pos hi]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply rationalMax_cast_le (sensitivity_nonneg hcR U i)
      intro s _
      rw [rationalRatio_cast, sensitivity, if_pos hi]
      exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hcR hi) (Or.inr ⟨s, rfl⟩)
    · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hcR hi
        (by exact_mod_cast rationalMax_nonneg queries (rationalRatio c U i))
      intro s
      have hratio := le_rationalMax (hqueries s) (rationalRatio c U i)
      have hratioR : realContribution c i s / cost (realContribution c) U s ≤
          (rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← rationalRatio_cast]
        exact_mod_cast hratio
      by_cases hz : cost (realContribution c) U s = 0
      · have hci := cost_eq_zero_contribution hcR hi hz
        simp [hz, hci]
      · have hpos : 0 < cost (realContribution c) U s :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hcR U s) (Ne.symm hz)
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hpos).1 hratioR
  · simp [rationalSensitivity, hi, sensitivity_of_not_mem hi]

/-- A finite rational matrix gives the exact real oracle used by the filtering
theorem, while its score values are produced by executable rational code. -/

decl_217.name: FTC.Executable.rationalExactOracle
decl_217.label: Executable.rationalExactOracle
decl_217.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_217.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} →
    [inst : DecidableEq I] →
      [DecidableEq S] →
        (c : I → S → ℚ) →
          (queries : Finset S) →
            (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
              (∀ (s : S), s ∈ queries) → FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle (FTC.Executable.realContribution c) 1
decl_217.source:
def rationalExactOracle (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hqueries : ∀ s : S, s ∈ queries) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle (realContribution c) 1 where
  score U i := (rationalSensitivity c queries U i : ℝ)
  lower U i _ := by rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]; simp
  upper U i _ := by rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]

/-! ## An instrumented arithmetic implementation

One charge is made for each matrix lookup, rational addition, rational
division, and maximum comparison. Finite-container enumeration and the bit
complexity of rational arithmetic are outside this unit-cost model. Counters
are carried by the evaluation itself, rather than attached to its result
afterward.
-/

/-- The first component is the cost; each row requires one lookup and one
addition to the accumulating sum. -/

decl_212.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted
decl_212.label: Executable.rationalCostCounted
decl_212.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_212.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → S → ℚ × ℕ
decl_212.source:
def rationalCostCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  ∑ i ∈ U, (c i s, 2)

decl_213.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted_value
decl_213.label: Executable.rationalCostCounted_value
decl_213.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_213.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted c U s).1 = FTC.Executable.rationalCost c U s
decl_213.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCostCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCostCounted c U s).1 = rationalCost c U s := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert i U hi ih =>
    change (∑ j ∈ insert i U, (c j s, 2)).1 = ∑ j ∈ insert i U, c j s
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    change c i s + (rationalCostCounted c U s).1 = c i s + rationalCost c U s
    rw [ih]

decl_214.name: FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted_work
decl_214.label: Executable.rationalCostCounted_work
decl_214.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_214.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted c U s).2 = 2 * U.card
decl_214.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCostCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCostCounted c U s).2 = 2 * U.card := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert i U hi ih =>
    change (∑ j ∈ insert i U, (c j s, 2)).2 = 2 * (insert i U).card
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    change 2 + (rationalCostCounted c U s).2 = 2 * (U.card + 1)
    rw [ih]
    omega

/-- In addition to the denominator, a ratio evaluates one numerator lookup
and one division. The zero-denominator convention is executable. -/

decl_230.name: FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted
decl_230.label: Executable.rationalRatioCounted
decl_230.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_230.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset I → I → S → ℚ × ℕ

decl_231.name: FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted_value
decl_231.label: Executable.rationalRatioCounted_value
decl_231.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_231.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted c U i s).1 = FTC.Executable.rationalRatio c U i s
decl_231.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatioCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatioCounted c U i s).1 = rationalRatio c U i s := by
  simp [rationalRatioCounted, rationalRatio]

decl_232.name: FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted_work
decl_232.label: Executable.rationalRatioCounted_work
decl_232.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_232.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted c U i s).2 = 2 * U.card + 2
decl_232.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatioCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatioCounted c U i s).2 = 2 * U.card + 2 := by
  simp [rationalRatioCounted]

/-- Combining two counted maxima executes one comparison. Associativity and
commutativity make the fold independent of finite-set representation. -/

decl_201.name: FTC.Executable.maxWithWork
decl_201.label: Executable.maxWithWork
decl_201.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_201.statement: ℚ × ℕ → ℚ × ℕ → ℚ × ℕ
decl_201.source:
def maxWithWork (a b : ℚ × ℕ) : ℚ × ℕ := (max a.1 b.1, a.2 + b.2 + 1)

instance : Std.Commutative maxWithWork where
  comm a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact max_comm _ _
    · simp [maxWithWork, Nat.add_comm]

instance : Std.Associative maxWithWork where
  assoc a b c := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact max_assoc _ _ _
    · simp [maxWithWork, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]

decl_237.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted
decl_237.label: Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted
decl_237.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_237.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq I] → (I → S → ℚ) → Finset S → Finset I → I → ℚ × ℕ

decl_173.name: FTC.Executable.countedMax_value
decl_173.label: Executable.countedMax_value
decl_173.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_173.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I)
  (i : I),
  (Finset.fold FTC.Executable.maxWithWork (0, 0) (FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted c U i) queries).1 =
    FTC.Executable.rationalMax queries (FTC.Executable.rationalRatio c U i)
decl_173.source:
theorem countedMax_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (queries.fold maxWithWork (0, 0) (rationalRatioCounted c U i)).1 =
      rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [Finset.fold_insert hs, rationalMax_insert hs]
    simp only [maxWithWork, rationalRatioCounted_value, ih]

decl_174.name: FTC.Executable.countedMax_work
decl_174.label: Executable.countedMax_work
decl_174.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_174.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I)
  (i : I),
  (Finset.fold FTC.Executable.maxWithWork (0, 0) (FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted c U i) queries).2 =
    queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3)
decl_174.source:
theorem countedMax_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (queries.fold maxWithWork (0, 0) (rationalRatioCounted c U i)).2 =
      queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [Finset.fold_insert hs, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hs]
    simp only [maxWithWork, rationalRatioCounted_work, ih, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

/-- The instrumented program computes exactly the uninstrumented score. -/

decl_238.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted_value
decl_238.label: Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted_value
decl_238.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_238.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
  (U : Finset I) (i : I),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).1 = FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity c queries U i
decl_238.source:
theorem rationalSensitivityCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).1 = rationalSensitivity c queries U i := by
  unfold rationalSensitivityCounted rationalSensitivity
  split_ifs
  · exact countedMax_value c queries U i
  · rfl

/-- Exact unit-cost arithmetic count: one denominator scan and ratio/max step
per query; inactive indices are not evaluated. -/

decl_239.name: FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted_work
decl_239.label: Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted_work
decl_239.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Executable/FiniteMetricMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_239.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
  (U : Finset I) (i : I),
  (FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).2 = if i ∈ U then queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) else 0
decl_239.source:
theorem rationalSensitivityCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).2 =
      if i ∈ U then queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) else 0 := by
  unfold rationalSensitivityCounted
  split_ifs
  · exact countedMax_work c queries U i
  · rfl

end FTC.Executable

decl_648.name: FTC.chosenMax
decl_648.label: chosenMax
decl_648.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_648.statement: {I : Type u_1} → (Finset I → I → ℝ) → (Q : Finset I) → Q.Nonempty → I
decl_648.source:
noncomputable def chosenMax (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I)
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : I :=
  Classical.choose (Q.exists_max_image (score Q) h)

decl_649.name: FTC.chosenMax_spec
decl_649.label: chosenMax_spec
decl_649.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_649.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) (h : Q.Nonempty),
  FTC.chosenMax score Q h ∈ Q ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q (FTC.chosenMax score Q h)
decl_649.source:
theorem chosenMax_spec (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I)
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    chosenMax score Q h ∈ Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q (chosenMax score Q h) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (Q.exists_max_image (score Q) h)

/-- The classical real maximizer as an explicit selection routine. -/

decl_650.name: FTC.classicalSelectionRule
decl_650.label: classicalSelectionRule
decl_650.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_650.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [inst : DecidableEq I] → (Finset I → I → ℝ) → FTC.SelectionRule I
decl_650.source:
noncomputable def classicalSelectionRule (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : SelectionRule I where
  select := chosenMax score
  select_mem := fun Q h => (chosenMax_spec score Q h).1

decl_651.name: FTC.classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor
decl_651.label: classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor
decl_651.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_651.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ), (FTC.classicalSelectionRule score).IsMaxFor score
decl_651.source:
theorem classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) :
    (classicalSelectionRule score).IsMaxFor score :=
  fun Q h => (chosenMax_spec score Q h).2

decl_685.name: FTC.peelStep
decl_685.label: peelStep
decl_685.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_685.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq I] → (Finset I → I → ℝ) → Finset I → Finset I
decl_685.source:
noncomputable def peelStep (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  if h : Q.Nonempty then Q.erase (chosenMax score Q h) else Q

decl_684.name: FTC.peel
decl_684.label: peel
decl_684.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_684.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq I] → (Finset I → I → ℝ) → ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
decl_684.source:
noncomputable def peel (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
  | 0, Q => Q
  | n + 1, Q => peel score n (peelStep score Q)

decl_690.name: FTC.peel_eq_selectionRun
decl_690.label: peel_eq_selectionRun
decl_690.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_690.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  FTC.peel score n Q = FTC.selectionRun (FTC.classicalSelectionRule score) n Q
decl_690.source:
theorem peel_eq_selectionRun (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score n Q = selectionRun (classicalSelectionRule score) n Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simpa [peel, selectionRun, peelStep, selectionStep, classicalSelectionRule] using
      (ih (peelStep score Q))

decl_686.name: FTC.peelStep_removes
decl_686.label: peelStep_removes
decl_686.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_686.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I},
  Q.Nonempty → ∃ g ∈ Q, FTC.peelStep score Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g
decl_686.source:
theorem peelStep_removes (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, peelStep score Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g := by
  refine ⟨chosenMax score Q h, (chosenMax_spec score Q h).1, ?_,
    (chosenMax_spec score Q h).2⟩
  simp [peelStep, h]

decl_687.name: FTC.peelStep_subset
decl_687.label: peelStep_subset
decl_687.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_687.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I), FTC.peelStep score Q ⊆ Q
decl_687.source:
theorem peelStep_subset (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peelStep score Q ⊆ Q := by
  unfold peelStep
  split
  · exact Finset.erase_subset _ _
  · exact Finset.Subset.refl _

decl_640.name: FTC.card_le_peelStep_add_one
decl_640.label: card_le_peelStep_add_one
decl_640.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_640.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I),
  Q.card ≤ (FTC.peelStep score Q).card + 1
decl_640.source:
theorem card_le_peelStep_add_one (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (peelStep score Q).card + 1 := by
  by_cases h : Q.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, _⟩ := peelStep_removes score h
    rw [hstep]
    have := Finset.card_erase_add_one hg
    omega
  · simp [peelStep, h]

decl_644.name: FTC.card_peelStep_add_one
decl_644.label: card_peelStep_add_one
decl_644.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_644.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I},
  Q.Nonempty → (FTC.peelStep score Q).card + 1 = Q.card
decl_644.source:
theorem card_peelStep_add_one (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : (peelStep score Q).card + 1 = Q.card := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, _⟩ := peelStep_removes score h
  rw [hstep]
  exact Finset.card_erase_add_one hg

decl_691.name: FTC.peel_subset
decl_691.label: peel_subset
decl_691.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_691.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I), FTC.peel score n Q ⊆ Q
decl_691.source:
theorem peel_subset (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score n Q ⊆ Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ n ih => exact (ih _).trans (peelStep_subset score Q)

decl_688.name: FTC.peel_add
decl_688.label: peel_add
decl_688.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_688.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  FTC.peel score (n + m) Q = FTC.peel score m (FTC.peel score n Q)
decl_688.source:
theorem peel_add (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score (n + m) Q = peel score m (peel score n Q) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih => simpa [Nat.succ_add, peel] using ih (peelStep score Q)

decl_689.name: FTC.peel_antitone
decl_689.label: peel_antitone
decl_689.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_689.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n m : ℕ},
  n ≤ m → ∀ (Q : Finset I), FTC.peel score m Q ⊆ FTC.peel score n Q
decl_689.source:
theorem peel_antitone (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (Q : Finset I) : peel score m Q ⊆ peel score n Q := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [peel_add]
  exact peel_subset score d _

decl_641.name: FTC.card_le_peel_add
decl_641.label: card_le_peel_add
decl_641.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_641.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  Q.card ≤ (FTC.peel score n Q).card + n
decl_641.source:
theorem card_le_peel_add (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (peel score n Q).card + n := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (peelStep score Q)
    have hstep := card_le_peelStep_add_one score Q
    change Q.card ≤ (peel score n (peelStep score Q)).card + (n + 1)
    omega

decl_645.name: FTC.card_peel_add_of_nonempty
decl_645.label: card_peel_add_of_nonempty
decl_645.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_645.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.peel score n Q).Nonempty → (FTC.peel score n Q).card + n = Q.card
decl_645.source:
theorem card_peel_add_of_nonempty (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (peel score n Q).Nonempty) :
    (peel score n Q).card + n = Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hs : (peelStep score Q).Nonempty := h.mono (peel_subset score n _)
    have hq : Q.Nonempty := hs.mono (peelStep_subset score Q)
    have hcard := card_peelStep_add_one score hq
    have hind := ih (peelStep score Q) h
    change (peel score n (peelStep score Q)).card + (n + 1) = Q.card
    omega

decl_696.name: FTC.removed_card_le
decl_696.label: removed_card_le
decl_696.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_696.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (Q \ FTC.peel score n Q).card ≤ n
decl_696.source:
theorem removed_card_le (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (Q \ peel score n Q).card ≤ n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (peel_subset score n Q)]
  have := card_le_peel_add score n Q
  omega

decl_695.name: FTC.removed_card_eq_of_nonempty
decl_695.label: removed_card_eq_of_nonempty
decl_695.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_695.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.peel score n Q).Nonempty → (Q \ FTC.peel score n Q).card = n
decl_695.source:
theorem removed_card_eq_of_nonempty (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (peel score n Q).Nonempty) :
    (Q \ peel score n Q).card = n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (peel_subset score n Q)]
  have := card_peel_add_of_nonempty score n Q h
  omega

/-- Every removed index was a maximum at an actual stage of the algorithm. -/

decl_697.name: FTC.removed_has_stage
decl_697.label: removed_has_stage
decl_697.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_697.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I} {x : I},
  x ∈ Q →
    x ∉ FTC.peel score n Q →
      ∃ t < n,
        x ∈ FTC.peel score t Q ∧ ∀ y ∈ FTC.peel score t Q, score (FTC.peel score t Q) y ≤ score (FTC.peel score t Q) x
decl_697.source:
theorem removed_has_stage (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I}
    {x : I} (hx : x ∈ Q) (hgone : x ∉ peel score n Q) :
    ∃ t < n, x ∈ peel score t Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ peel score t Q, score (peel score t Q) y ≤ score (peel score t Q) x := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hgone hx)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hs : x ∈ peelStep score Q
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt, hmax⟩ := ih hs hgone
      refine ⟨t + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [peel] using hxt
      · simpa [peel] using hmax
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, hmax⟩ := peelStep_removes score ⟨x, hx⟩
      have heq : x = g := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hs (hstep.symm ▸ Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hx⟩)
      subst x
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n, hg, hmax⟩

/-- If a bad index survives `f` deletions, a good maximum was deleted earlier. -/

decl_679.name: FTC.good_stage_of_bad_remaining
decl_679.label: good_stage_of_bad_remaining
decl_679.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Filtering.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_679.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ),
  B.card ≤ f →
    (FTC.peel score f U ∩ B).Nonempty →
      ∃ t < f,
        ∃ g ∈ FTC.peel score t U,
          g ∉ B ∧ ∀ y ∈ FTC.peel score t U, score (FTC.peel score t U) y ≤ score (FTC.peel score t U) g
decl_679.source:
theorem good_stage_of_bad_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℝ)
    (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hbad : (peel score f U ∩ B).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t < f, ∃ g ∈ peel score t U, g ∉ B ∧
      ∀ y ∈ peel score t U, score (peel score t U) y ≤ score (peel score t U) g := by
  let R := peel score f U
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hbad
  have hbR : b ∈ R := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).1
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hcard : (U \ R).card = f := removed_card_eq_of_nonempty score f U ⟨b, hbR⟩
  have hex : ∃ g ∈ U \ R, g ∉ B := by
    by_contra h
    have hsub : insert b (U \ R) ⊆ B := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact hbB
      · by_contra hxB
        exact h ⟨x, hx, hxB⟩
    have hbnot : b ∉ U \ R := by simp [hbR]
    have hlarge := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbnot, hcard] at hlarge
    omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgB⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨hgU, hgR⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgt, hmax⟩ := removed_has_stage score hgU hgR
  exact ⟨t, ht, g, hgt, hgB, hmax⟩

end FTC

decl_264.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet
decl_264.label: FiniteMetric.CenterSet
decl_264.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_264.source:
structure CenterSet (X : Type*) (k : ℕ) where
  centers : Finset X
  card_eq : centers.card = k
  nonempty : centers.Nonempty

/-- Squared distance to the closest center. -/

decl_279.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss
decl_279.label: FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss
decl_279.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_279.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → X → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k → ℝ
decl_279.source:
noncomputable def kmeansLoss (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℝ :=
  C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => dist p x ^ 2)

decl_281.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_nonneg
decl_281.label: FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_nonneg
decl_281.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_281.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p : X)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k), 0 ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C
decl_281.source:
theorem kmeansLoss_nonneg (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) : 0 ≤ kmeansLoss p C := by
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro x _
  exact sq_nonneg (dist p x)

decl_280.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq
decl_280.label: FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq
decl_280.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_280.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p : X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k)
  {x : X}, x ∈ C.centers → FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C ≤ dist p x ^ 2
decl_280.source:
theorem kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ C.centers) : kmeansLoss p C ≤ dist p x ^ 2 := by
  exact Finset.inf'_le _ hx

decl_276.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.exists_closest_center
decl_276.label: FiniteMetric.exists_closest_center
decl_276.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_276.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p : X)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k), ∃ x ∈ C.centers, FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C = dist p x ^ 2
decl_276.source:
theorem exists_closest_center (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    ∃ x ∈ C.centers, kmeansLoss p C = dist p x ^ 2 := by
  exact Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' C.nonempty (fun x => dist p x ^ 2)

/-- Every center must lie outside the open ball of squared radius `r`. -/

decl_263.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.Admissible
decl_263.label: FiniteMetric.Admissible
decl_263.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_263.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → X → ℝ → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k → Prop
decl_263.source:
def Admissible (p : X) (r : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C.centers, r ≤ dist p x ^ 2

decl_270.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.admissible_iff
decl_270.label: FiniteMetric.admissible_iff
decl_270.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_270.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p : X) (r : ℝ)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k), FTC.FiniteMetric.Admissible p r C ↔ r ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C
decl_270.source:
theorem admissible_iff (p : X) (r : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    Admissible p r C ↔ r ≤ kmeansLoss p C := by
  exact (Finset.le_inf'_iff C.nonempty _).symm

/-- A trial is feasible when at least `k` admissible centers can be selected. -/

decl_266.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.FeasibleRadius
decl_266.label: FiniteMetric.FeasibleRadius
decl_266.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_266.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → X → X → Prop
decl_266.source:
def FeasibleRadius (p x : X) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : CenterSet X k, Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C

/-- The finite admissible-center set; feasibility can be tested without an
optimization-oracle call by counting these centers. -/

decl_268.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.admissibleCenters
decl_268.label: FiniteMetric.admissibleCenters
decl_268.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_268.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [Fintype X] → [MetricSpace X] → X → ℝ → Finset X
decl_268.source:
noncomputable def admissibleCenters (p : X) (r : ℝ) : Finset X := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ : Finset X).filter (fun y => r ≤ dist p y ^ 2)

decl_277.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.feasibleRadius_iff_card
decl_277.label: FiniteMetric.feasibleRadius_iff_card
decl_277.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_277.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p x : X),
  FTC.FiniteMetric.FeasibleRadius p x ↔ 0 < k ∧ k ≤ (FTC.FiniteMetric.admissibleCenters p (dist p x ^ 2)).card
decl_277.source:
theorem feasibleRadius_iff_card (p x : X) :
    FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x ↔
      0 < k ∧ k ≤ (admissibleCenters p (dist p x ^ 2)).card := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    constructor
    · simpa [C.card_eq] using C.nonempty.card_pos
    · have hsub : C.centers ⊆ admissibleCenters p (dist p x ^ 2) := by
        intro y hy
        simp only [admissibleCenters, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact hC y hy
      simpa [C.card_eq] using Finset.card_le_card hsub
  · rintro ⟨hk, hcard⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hcard
    have hQnonempty : Q.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa [hQcard] using hk)
    refine ⟨⟨Q, hQcard, hQnonempty⟩, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hmem := hQ hy
    simpa only [admissibleCenters, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hmem

/-- The specification of a constrained approximation oracle, restricted to the
at most `|X|` instances needed for one sensitivity estimate. The comparison
against every feasible solution is equivalent to comparison against the
optimum, and avoids choosing an optimal solution in the interface. -/

decl_265.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle
decl_265.label: FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle
decl_265.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_265.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → Finset X → X → ℝ → Type u_1
decl_265.source:
structure ConstrainedOracle (P : Finset X) (p : X) (ρ : ℝ) where
  solve : ∀ x : X, FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x → CenterSet X k
  admissible : ∀ x h, Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) (solve x h)
  approximation : ∀ x h (C : CenterSet X k), Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C →
    cost kmeansLoss P (solve x h) ≤ ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C

variable {P : Finset X} {p : X} {ρ : ℝ}

/-- Score from one trial; infeasible radii contribute zero. -/

decl_284.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore
decl_284.label: FiniteMetric.trialScore
decl_284.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_284.statement:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : MetricSpace X] →
    {k : ℕ} → {P : Finset X} → {p : X} → {ρ : ℝ} → FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ → X → ℝ
decl_284.source:
noncomputable def trialScore (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (x : X) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x then
    dist p x ^ 2 / cost kmeansLoss P (oracle.solve x h)
  else 0

/-- The largest of at most `|X|` trial scores. -/

decl_272.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate
decl_272.label: FiniteMetric.estimate
decl_272.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_272.statement:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype X] →
    [inst : MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → {P : Finset X} → {p : X} → {ρ : ℝ} → FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ → ℝ
decl_272.source:
noncomputable def estimate (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ p⟩ (trialScore oracle)

decl_287.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_nonneg
decl_287.label: FiniteMetric.trialScore_nonneg
decl_287.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_287.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} {P : Finset X} {p : X} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ) (x : X), 0 ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore oracle x
decl_287.source:
theorem trialScore_nonneg (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ trialScore oracle x := by
  unfold trialScore
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg _ _)
  · exact le_rfl

decl_285.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_estimate
decl_285.label: FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_estimate
decl_285.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_285.source:
theorem trialScore_le_estimate (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (x : X) :
    trialScore oracle x ≤ estimate oracle := by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (trialScore oracle) (Finset.mem_univ x)

decl_275.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_nonneg
decl_275.label: FiniteMetric.estimate_nonneg
decl_275.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_275.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} {P : Finset X} {p : X} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ), 0 ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate oracle
decl_275.source:
theorem estimate_nonneg (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) :
    0 ≤ estimate oracle :=
  (trialScore_nonneg oracle p).trans (trialScore_le_estimate oracle p)

/-- Every feasible trial provides a lower bound on exact sensitivity. -/

decl_286.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_sensitivity
decl_286.label: FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_sensitivity
decl_286.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_286.source:
theorem trialScore_le_sensitivity (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ P) (x : X) :
    trialScore oracle x ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  unfold trialScore
  split_ifs with h
  · let C := oracle.solve x h
    change dist p x ^ 2 / cost kmeansLoss P C ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p
    have hr : dist p x ^ 2 ≤ kmeansLoss p C :=
      (admissible_iff p _ C).1 (oracle.admissible x h)
    have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P C
    by_cases hz : cost kmeansLoss P C = 0
    · simpa [hz] using sensitivity_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P p
    · have hcpos : 0 < cost kmeansLoss P C := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hz)
      have hs := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost kmeansLoss_nonneg hp C
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hcpos).2 (hr.trans hs)
  · exact sensitivity_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P p

decl_274.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_le_sensitivity
decl_274.label: FiniteMetric.estimate_le_sensitivity
decl_274.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_274.source:
theorem estimate_le_sensitivity (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ P) : estimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro x _
  exact trialScore_le_sensitivity oracle hp x

/-- For every query, the trial at its closest-center radius recovers at least
`1 / ρ` of that query's sensitivity ratio. -/

decl_271.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
decl_271.label: FiniteMetric.contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
decl_271.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_271.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} {P : Finset X} {p : X} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ),
  p ∈ P →
    0 < ρ →
      ∀ (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
        FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C ≤
          ρ * FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate oracle * FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P C
decl_271.source:
theorem contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
    (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (hp : p ∈ P) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (C : CenterSet X k) :
    kmeansLoss p C ≤ (ρ * estimate oracle) * cost kmeansLoss P C := by
  have he : 0 ≤ estimate oracle := estimate_nonneg oracle
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P C
  by_cases hz : kmeansLoss p C = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ.le he) hc
  · have hlpos : 0 < kmeansLoss p C :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (kmeansLoss_nonneg p C) (Ne.symm hz)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hclosest⟩ := exists_closest_center p C
    have hCadm : Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C := by
      rw [admissible_iff, ← hclosest]
    have hfeas : FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x := ⟨C, hCadm⟩
    let D := oracle.solve x hfeas
    have hD : kmeansLoss p C ≤ kmeansLoss p D := by
      rw [hclosest]
      exact (admissible_iff p _ D).1 (oracle.admissible x hfeas)
    have hdpos : 0 < cost kmeansLoss P D :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hlpos.trans_le hD) (contribution_le_cost kmeansLoss_nonneg hp D)
    have htrial : trialScore oracle x = kmeansLoss p C / cost kmeansLoss P D := by
      simp only [trialScore, dif_pos hfeas]
      rw [← hclosest]
    have hscore : kmeansLoss p C ≤ estimate oracle * cost kmeansLoss P D := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).1
      rw [← htrial]
      exact trialScore_le_estimate oracle x
    have happ : cost kmeansLoss P D ≤ ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C :=
      oracle.approximation x hfeas C hCadm
    calc
      kmeansLoss p C ≤ estimate oracle * cost kmeansLoss P D := hscore
      _ ≤ estimate oracle * (ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left happ he
      _ = (ρ * estimate oracle) * cost kmeansLoss P C := by ring

/-- Theorem 4.1, with all infeasible-radius and zero-cost cases explicit. -/

decl_273.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_approximates_sensitivity
decl_273.label: Theorem 4.1 · Sensitivity reduction
decl_273.summary: Theorem 4.1: reduces sensitivity approximation to constrained optimization in a finite metric.
decl_273.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} {P : Finset X} {p : X}
  {ρ : ℝ} (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle P p ρ),
  p ∈ P →
    0 < ρ →
      FTC.sensitivity FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P p / ρ ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate oracle ∧
        FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate oracle ≤ FTC.sensitivity FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P p
decl_273.source:
theorem estimate_approximates_sensitivity
    (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (hp : p ∈ P) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p / ρ ≤ estimate oracle ∧
      estimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  constructor
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hρ).2
    have hbound : sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p ≤ ρ * estimate oracle :=
      sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le kmeansLoss_nonneg hp
        (mul_nonneg hρ.le (estimate_nonneg oracle))
        (contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost oracle hp hρ)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  · exact estimate_le_sensitivity oracle hp

/-- Exactly the feasible trials are sent to the constrained oracle. -/

decl_283.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.queriedRadii
decl_283.label: FiniteMetric.queriedRadii
decl_283.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_283.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [Fintype X] → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → X → Finset X
decl_283.source:
noncomputable def queriedRadii (p : X) : Finset X := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ : Finset X).filter (FeasibleRadius (k := k) p)

/-- The reduction makes at most `|X|` constrained optimization calls. -/

decl_282.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.oracle_calls_le_card
decl_282.label: FiniteMetric.oracle_calls_le_card
decl_282.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/SensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_282.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p : X),
  (FTC.FiniteMetric.queriedRadii p).card ≤ Fintype.card X
decl_282.source:
theorem oracle_calls_le_card (p : X) : (queriedRadii (k := k) p).card ≤ Fintype.card X := by
  classical
  simpa [queriedRadii] using
    (Finset.card_filter_le (s := (Finset.univ : Finset X)) (FeasibleRadius (k := k) p))

end FTC.FiniteMetric

decl_269.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.admissible_dist_iff
decl_269.label: FiniteMetric.admissible_dist_iff
decl_269.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_269.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_2} [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (p x : X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.FiniteMetric.Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C ↔ ∀ y ∈ C.centers, dist p x ≤ dist p y
decl_269.source:
theorem admissible_dist_iff (p x : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C ↔ ∀ y ∈ C.centers, dist p x ≤ dist p y := by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).1 (h y hy)
  · intro h y hy
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).2 (h y hy)

/-- A separate weighted contribution for each stored index. -/

decl_292.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss
decl_292.label: FiniteMetric.weightedLoss
decl_292.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_292.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {X : Type u_2} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → (I → FTC.Entry X) → I → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k → ℝ
decl_292.source:
noncomputable def weightedLoss (entries : I → Entry X) (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℝ :=
  contribution kmeansLoss entries i C

decl_293.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss_nonneg
decl_293.label: FiniteMetric.weightedLoss_nonneg
decl_293.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_293.source:
theorem weightedLoss_nonneg (entries : I → Entry X) (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    0 ≤ weightedLoss entries i C :=
  contribution_nonneg kmeansLoss entries kmeansLoss_nonneg i C

decl_294.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedSensitivity_of_weight_zero
decl_294.label: FiniteMetric.weightedSensitivity_of_weight_zero
decl_294.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_294.source:
theorem weightedSensitivity_of_weight_zero (entries : I → Entry X)
    (U : Finset I) (p : I) (hw : (entries p).weight = 0) :
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p = 0 := by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ U
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp le_rfl
      intro C
      simp [weightedLoss, contribution, hw]
    · exact sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p
  · exact sensitivity_of_not_mem hp

/-- Specification of the weighted constrained oracle needed for one indexed
sensitivity. Its output cost is compared with every feasible competitor. -/

decl_267.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle
decl_267.label: FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle
decl_267.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_267.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {X : Type u_2} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → Finset I → (I → FTC.Entry X) → I → ℝ → Type u_2
decl_267.source:
structure IndexedConstrainedOracle (U : Finset I) (entries : I → Entry X)
    (p : I) (ρ : ℝ) where
  solve : ∀ x : X,
    FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x → CenterSet X k
  admissible : ∀ x h,
    Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) (solve x h)
  approximation : ∀ x h (C : CenterSet X k),
    Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) C →
    cost (weightedLoss entries) U (solve x h) ≤ ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C

variable {U : Finset I} {entries : I → Entry X} {p : I} {ρ : ℝ}

/-- A weighted trial score; the numerator uses the queried entry's own weight. -/

decl_295.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore
decl_295.label: FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore
decl_295.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_295.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [inst : MetricSpace X] →
      {k : ℕ} →
        {U : Finset I} →
          {entries : I → FTC.Entry X} →
            {p : I} → {ρ : ℝ} → FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ → X → ℝ
decl_295.source:
noncomputable def weightedTrialScore
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x then
    ((entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) /
      cost (weightedLoss entries) U (oracle.solve x h)
  else 0

decl_288.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate
decl_288.label: FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate
decl_288.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_288.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype X] →
      [inst : MetricSpace X] →
        {k : ℕ} →
          {U : Finset I} →
            {entries : I → FTC.Entry X} →
              {p : I} → {ρ : ℝ} → FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ → ℝ
decl_288.source:
noncomputable def weightedEstimate
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' ⟨(entries p).point, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    (weightedTrialScore oracle)

decl_298.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_nonneg
decl_298.label: FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_nonneg
decl_298.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_298.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_nonneg
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ weightedTrialScore oracle x := by
  unfold weightedTrialScore
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (entries p).weight_nonneg (sq_nonneg _))
      (cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) _ _)
  · exact le_rfl

omit [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq X] in

decl_296.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_estimate
decl_296.label: FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_estimate
decl_296.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_296.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_le_estimate
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) :
    weightedTrialScore oracle x ≤ weightedEstimate oracle := by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (weightedTrialScore oracle) (Finset.mem_univ x)

decl_291.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_nonneg
decl_291.label: FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_nonneg
decl_291.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_291.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_nonneg
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) :
    0 ≤ weightedEstimate oracle :=
  (weightedTrialScore_nonneg oracle (entries p).point).trans
    (weightedTrialScore_le_estimate oracle (entries p).point)

decl_297.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity
decl_297.label: FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity
decl_297.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_297.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (x : X) :
    weightedTrialScore oracle x ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  unfold weightedTrialScore
  split_ifs with h
  · let C := oracle.solve x h
    change ((entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) /
        cost (weightedLoss entries) U C ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p
    have hr : (entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2 ≤ weightedLoss entries p C := by
      have hd := (admissible_iff (entries p).point _ C).1 (oracle.admissible x h)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (entries p).weight_nonneg
    have hc : 0 ≤ cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
      cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U C
    by_cases hz : cost (weightedLoss entries) U C = 0
    · simpa [hz] using sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p
    · have hcpos : 0 < cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hz)
      have hs := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp C
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hcpos).2 (hr.trans hs)
  · exact sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p

decl_290.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity
decl_290.label: FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity
decl_290.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_290.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_3 : MetricSpace X]
  {k : ℕ} {U : Finset I} {entries : I → FTC.Entry X} {p : I} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ),
  p ∈ U → FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate oracle ≤ FTC.sensitivity (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries) U p
decl_290.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (hp : p ∈ U) :
    weightedEstimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro x _
  exact weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity oracle hp x

decl_299.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
decl_299.label: FiniteMetric.weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
decl_299.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_299.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ}
  {U : Finset I} {entries : I → FTC.Entry X} {p : I} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ),
  p ∈ U →
    0 < ρ →
      ∀ (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
        FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries p C ≤
          ρ * FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate oracle * FTC.cost (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries) U C
decl_299.source:
theorem weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    weightedLoss entries p C ≤
      (ρ * weightedEstimate oracle) * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := by
  have he : 0 ≤ weightedEstimate oracle := weightedEstimate_nonneg oracle
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
    cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U C
  by_cases hz : weightedLoss entries p C = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ.le he) hc
  · have hlpos : 0 < weightedLoss entries p C :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (weightedLoss_nonneg entries p C) (Ne.symm hz)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hclosest⟩ := exists_closest_center (entries p).point C
    have hCadm : Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) C := by
      rw [admissible_iff, ← hclosest]
    have hfeas : FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x := ⟨C, hCadm⟩
    let D := oracle.solve x hfeas
    have hD : weightedLoss entries p C ≤ weightedLoss entries p D := by
      have hd := (admissible_iff (entries p).point _ D).1 (oracle.admissible x hfeas)
      rw [← hclosest] at hd
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (entries p).weight_nonneg
    have hdpos : 0 < cost (weightedLoss entries) U D :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hlpos.trans_le hD)
        (contribution_le_cost (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp D)
    have htrial : weightedTrialScore oracle x =
        weightedLoss entries p C / cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := by
      simp only [weightedTrialScore, dif_pos hfeas]
      rw [weightedLoss, contribution, hclosest]
    have hscore : weightedLoss entries p C ≤
        weightedEstimate oracle * cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).1
      rw [← htrial]
      exact weightedTrialScore_le_estimate oracle x
    have happ : cost (weightedLoss entries) U D ≤ ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
      oracle.approximation x hfeas C hCadm
    calc
      weightedLoss entries p C ≤
          weightedEstimate oracle * cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := hscore
      _ ≤ weightedEstimate oracle * (ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left happ he
      _ = (ρ * weightedEstimate oracle) * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := by ring

/-- The weighted extension of Theorem 4.1, with separately indexed copies. -/

decl_289.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity
decl_289.label: FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity
decl_289.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_289.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_3 : MetricSpace X]
  {k : ℕ} {U : Finset I} {entries : I → FTC.Entry X} {p : I} {ρ : ℝ}
  (oracle : FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ),
  p ∈ U →
    0 < ρ →
      FTC.sensitivity (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries) U p / ρ ≤ FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate oracle ∧
        FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate oracle ≤ FTC.sensitivity (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries) U p
decl_289.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p / ρ ≤ weightedEstimate oracle ∧
      weightedEstimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  constructor
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hρ).2
    have hbound : sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p ≤
        ρ * weightedEstimate oracle :=
      sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp
        (mul_nonneg hρ.le (weightedEstimate_nonneg oracle))
        (weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost oracle hp hρ)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  · exact weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity oracle hp

/-- A family of constrained weighted solvers supplies exactly the oracle API
used by the deterministic filtering theorem. -/

decl_278.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.indexedApproxSensitivityOracle
decl_278.label: FiniteMetric.indexedApproxSensitivityOracle
decl_278.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_278.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [inst : DecidableEq I] →
      [Fintype X] →
        [DecidableEq X] →
          [inst_3 : MetricSpace X] →
            {k : ℕ} →
              (entries : I → FTC.Entry X) →
                (ρ : ℝ) →
                  0 < ρ →
                    ((U : Finset I) → (p : I) → FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracle U entries p ρ) →
                      FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss entries) ρ
decl_278.source:
noncomputable def indexedApproxSensitivityOracle
    (entries : I → Entry X) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (solvers : ∀ (U : Finset I) (p : I), IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) ρ where
  score U p := weightedEstimate (solvers U p)
  lower U p hp := by
    have h := (weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity (solvers U p) hp hρ).1
    have h' := (div_le_iff₀ hρ).1 h
    simpa [mul_comm] using h'
  upper U p hp :=
    (weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity (solvers U p) hp hρ).2

omit [DecidableEq I] in

decl_300.name: FTC.FiniteMetric.weighted_oracle_calls_le_card
decl_300.label: FiniteMetric.weighted_oracle_calls_le_card
decl_300.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/FiniteMetric/WeightedSensitivityReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_300.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ}
  (entries : I → FTC.Entry X) (p : I), (FTC.FiniteMetric.queriedRadii (entries p).point).card ≤ Fintype.card X
decl_300.source:
theorem weighted_oracle_calls_le_card (entries : I → Entry X) (p : I) :
    (queriedRadii (k := k) (entries p).point).card ≤ Fintype.card X :=
  oracle_calls_le_card (entries p).point

end FTC.FiniteMetric

decl_338.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size
