decl_344.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_pos
decl_344.label: Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_pos
decl_344.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_344.source:
theorem Ty.size_pos (t : Ty) (x : t.Value) : 0 < t.size x := by
  cases t <;> simp only [Ty.size] <;> omega

decl_341.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_mem_le
decl_341.label: Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_mem_le
decl_341.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_341.statement: ∀ {t : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {xs : List t.Value} {x : t.Value}, x ∈ xs → t.size x ≤ t.list.size xs
decl_341.source:
theorem Ty.size_mem_le {t : Ty} {xs : List t.Value} {x : t.Value} (hx : x ∈ xs) :
    t.size x ≤ (Ty.list t).size xs := by
  have h := List.single_le_sum (l := xs.map t.size) (fun n _ => Nat.zero_le n) _
    (List.mem_map_of_mem hx)
  simp only [Ty.size]
  omega

decl_354.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_add_le
decl_354.label: Hardness.Computation.size_add_le
decl_354.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_354.source:
theorem size_add_le (a b : ℕ) : (a + b).size ≤ a.size + b.size + 1 := by
  rw [Nat.size_le]
  have ha : a < 2 ^ (a.size + b.size) :=
    (Nat.lt_size_self a).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  have hb : b < 2 ^ (a.size + b.size) :=
    (Nat.lt_size_self b).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

decl_356.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_mul_le
decl_356.label: Hardness.Computation.size_mul_le
decl_356.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_356.source:
theorem size_mul_le (a b : ℕ) : (a * b).size ≤ a.size + b.size := by
  rw [Nat.size_le, pow_add]
  exact mul_lt_mul'' (Nat.lt_size_self a) (Nat.lt_size_self b) (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)

decl_357.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_sub_le
decl_357.label: Hardness.Computation.size_sub_le
decl_357.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_357.source:
theorem size_sub_le (a b : ℕ) : (a - b).size ≤ a.size := by
  rw [Nat.size_le]
  exact (Nat.sub_le a b).trans_lt (Nat.lt_size_self a)

decl_352.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum
decl_352.label: Hardness.Computation.maximum
decl_352.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_352.source:
def maximum : List ℕ → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | a :: xs => max a (maximum xs)

decl_351.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.le_maximum_of_mem
decl_351.label: Hardness.Computation.le_maximum_of_mem
decl_351.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_351.statement: ∀ {x : ℕ} {xs : List ℕ}, x ∈ xs → x ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum xs
decl_351.source:
theorem le_maximum_of_mem {x : ℕ} {xs : List ℕ} (hx : x ∈ xs) : x ≤ maximum xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
    · exact (ih hx).trans (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

decl_353.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum_size_le
decl_353.label: Hardness.Computation.maximum_size_le
decl_353.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_353.statement: ∀ (xs : List ℕ), (FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum xs).size ≤ (List.map (fun n => n.size + 1) xs).sum
decl_353.source:
theorem maximum_size_le (xs : List ℕ) :
    (maximum xs).size ≤ (xs.map fun n => n.size + 1).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [maximum]
  | cons a xs ih =>
    simp only [maximum, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    by_cases h : a ≤ maximum xs
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      omega
    · rw [max_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h))]
      omega

/-- Value iteration, with one charged loop step per iteration. -/

decl_350.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.iterateValue
decl_350.label: Hardness.Computation.iterateValue
decl_350.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_350.source:
def iterateValue {A : Type} (f : A → A) : ℕ → A → A
  | 0, x => x
  | n + 1, x => iterateValue f n (f x)

decl_349.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.iterateCost
decl_349.label: Hardness.Computation.iterateCost
decl_349.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_349.statement: {A : Type} → (A → A) → (A → ℕ) → ℕ → A → ℕ
decl_349.source:
def iterateCost {A : Type} (f : A → A) (charge : A → ℕ) : ℕ → A → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, x => charge x + iterateCost f charge n (f x) + 1

/-- A closed programming language. In particular, no constructor accepts an
arbitrary function together with an invented cost. -/

decl_314.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code
decl_314.label: Hardness.Computation.Code
decl_314.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_314.source:
inductive Code : Ty → Ty → Type where
  | id {a} : Code a a
  | const {a b} (v : b.Value) : Code a b
  | comp {a b c} : Code a b → Code b c → Code a c
  | pair {a b c} : Code a b → Code a c → Code a (.pair b c)
  | fst {a b} : Code (.pair a b) a
  | snd {a b} : Code (.pair a b) b
  | branch {a b} : Code a .bool → Code a b → Code a b → Code a b
  | add : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | mul : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | sub : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | div : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | mod : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | le : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .bool
  | eq : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .bool
  | cons {a} : Code (.pair a (.list a)) (.list a)
  | append {a} : Code (.pair (.list a) (.list a)) (.list a)
  | head {a} : Code (.pair a (.list a)) a
  | tail {a} : Code (.list a) (.list a)
  | length {a} : Code (.list a) .nat
  | map {a b} : Code a b → Code (.list a) (.list b)
  | mapWith {s a b} : Code (.pair s a) b → Code (.pair s (.list a)) (.list b)
  | flatten {a} : Code (.list (.list a)) (.list a)
  | maximum : Code (.list .nat) .nat
  | size {a} : Code a .nat
  | range : Code .nat (.list .nat)
  | iterate {a} : Code a a → Code (.pair .nat a) a

decl_322.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.eval
decl_322.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.eval
decl_322.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_322.statement: {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} → FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b → a.Value → b.Value
decl_322.source:
def Code.eval : {a b : Ty} → Code a b → a.Value → b.Value
  | _, _, .id, x => x
  | _, _, .const v, _ => v
  | _, _, .comp f g, x => g.eval (f.eval x)
  | _, _, .pair f g, x => (f.eval x, g.eval x)
  | _, _, .fst, x => x.1
  | _, _, .snd, x => x.2
  | _, _, .branch c f g, x => if c.eval x then f.eval x else g.eval x
  | _, _, .add, x => x.1 + x.2
  | _, _, .mul, x => x.1 * x.2
  | _, _, .sub, x => x.1 - x.2
  | _, _, .div, x => x.1 / x.2
  | _, _, .mod, x => x.1 % x.2
  | _, _, .le, x => decide (x.1 ≤ x.2)
  | _, _, .eq, x => decide (x.1 = x.2)
  | _, _, .cons, x => x.1 :: x.2
  | _, _, .append, x => x.1 ++ x.2
  | _, _, .head, x => x.2.headD x.1
  | _, _, .tail, x => x.tail
  | _, _, .length, x => x.length
  | _, _, .map f, x => x.map f.eval
  | _, _, .mapWith f, x => x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))
  | _, _, .flatten, x => x.flatten
  | _, _, .maximum, x => Computation.maximum x
  | a, _, .size, x => a.size x
  | _, _, .range, x => List.range x
  | _, _, .iterate f, x => iterateValue f.eval x.1 x.2

decl_321.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.cost
decl_321.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.cost
decl_321.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_321.statement: {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} → FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b → a.Value → ℕ
decl_321.source:
def Code.cost : {a b : Ty} → Code a b → a.Value → ℕ
  | a, _, .id, x => a.size x + 1
  | _, b, .const v, _ => b.size v + 1
  | _, _, .comp f g, x => f.cost x + g.cost (f.eval x) + 1
  | _, _, .pair f g, x => f.cost x + g.cost x + 1
  | _, _, .branch c f g, x => c.cost x + (if c.eval x then f.cost x else g.cost x) + 1
  | _, _, .map f, xs => (xs.map f.cost).sum + (Ty.list _).size xs + 1
  | _, _, .mapWith f, x => (x.2.map (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y))).sum +
      (Ty.pair _ (.list _)).size x + 1
  | _, _, .iterate f, x => iterateCost f.eval f.cost x.1 x.2 + (Ty.pair .nat _).size x
  | _, _, .range, n => (n + 1) ^ 2 * (n.size + 1)
  | a, _, _, x => (a.size x + 1) ^ 2

decl_345.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound
decl_345.label: Hardness.Computation.bound
decl_345.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_345.source: def bound (C d n : ℕ) : ℕ := C * (n + 1) ^ d

decl_348.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_mono
decl_348.label: Hardness.Computation.bound_mono
decl_348.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_348.statement:
∀ {C C' d d' n n' : ℕ},
  C ≤ C' → d ≤ d' → n ≤ n' → FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound C d n ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound C' d' n'
decl_348.source:
theorem bound_mono {C C' d d' n n' : ℕ}
    (hC : C ≤ C') (hd : d ≤ d') (hn : n ≤ n') : bound C d n ≤ bound C' d' n' := by
  unfold bound
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul hC ((Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) d).trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hd))

decl_346.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_add
decl_346.label: Hardness.Computation.bound_add
decl_346.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_346.statement:
∀ {C d E e n u v : ℕ},
  u ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound C d n →
    v ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound E e n → u + v ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound (C + E) (d + e) n
decl_346.source:
theorem bound_add {C d E e n u v : ℕ}
    (hu : u ≤ bound C d n) (hv : v ≤ bound E e n) :
    u + v ≤ bound (C + E) (d + e) n := by
  have hu' := hu.trans (bound_mono le_rfl (Nat.le_add_right d e) le_rfl)
  have hv' := hv.trans (bound_mono le_rfl (Nat.le_add_left e d) le_rfl)
  simpa only [bound, add_mul] using Nat.add_le_add hu' hv'

decl_347.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_comp
decl_347.label: Hardness.Computation.bound_comp
decl_347.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_347.statement:
∀ {C d E e n m : ℕ},
  m ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound C d n →
    FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound E e m ≤ FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound (E * (C + 1) ^ e) (d * e) n
decl_347.source:
theorem bound_comp {C d E e n m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ bound C d n) :
    bound E e m ≤ bound (E * (C + 1) ^ e) (d * e) n := by
  unfold bound at *
  have hone : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow d (n + 1) (by omega)
  calc
    E * (m + 1) ^ e ≤ E * ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ e := by
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
      nlinarith
    _ = E * (C + 1) ^ e * (n + 1) ^ (d * e) := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      ring

/-- Both actual charged computation and the materialized result have a
polynomial bound in the binary/structural input size. -/

decl_315.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly
decl_315.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly
decl_315.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_315.statement: {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} → FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b → Prop
decl_315.source:
def Code.IsPoly {a b : Ty} (p : Code a b) : Prop :=
  ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x, p.cost x + b.size (p.eval x) ≤ bound C d (a.size x)

decl_333.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_of_size_le
decl_333.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_of_size_le
decl_333.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_333.statement:
∀ {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} (p : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b),
  (∀ (x : a.Value), p.cost x ≤ (a.size x + 1) ^ 2) → (∀ (x : a.Value), b.size (p.eval x) ≤ a.size x + 1) → p.IsPoly
decl_333.source:
theorem Code.poly_of_size_le {a b : Ty} (p : Code a b)
    (hcost : ∀ x, p.cost x ≤ (a.size x + 1) ^ 2)
    (hsize : ∀ x, b.size (p.eval x) ≤ a.size x + 1) : p.IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2, 2, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hc := hcost x
  have hs := hsize x
  unfold bound
  nlinarith

decl_328.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_id
decl_328.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_id
decl_328.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_328.source:
theorem Code.poly_id {a : Ty} : (Code.id (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2, 1, ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, bound, pow_one]
  omega

decl_325.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_const
decl_325.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_const
decl_325.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_325.source:
theorem Code.poly_const {a b : Ty} (v : b.Value) : (Code.const (a := a) v).IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2 * b.size v + 1, 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, bound, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

decl_317.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.comp
decl_317.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.comp
decl_317.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_317.statement:
∀ {a b c : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {f : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b} {g : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code b c},
  f.IsPoly → g.IsPoly → (f.comp g).IsPoly
decl_317.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.comp {a b c : Ty} {f : Code a b} {g : Code b c}
    (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.comp f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨E, e, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + E * (C + 1) ^ e + 1, d + d * e + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hfx := hf x
  have hsize : b.size (f.eval x) ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := by omega
  have hsecond := (hg (f.eval x)).trans (bound_comp hsize)
  have hfirst : f.cost x ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := by omega
  have hsum := bound_add hfirst hsecond
  have hone : 1 ≤ bound 1 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add hsum hone
  simpa only [Code.cost, Code.eval, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using htotal

decl_320.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.pair
decl_320.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.pair
decl_320.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_320.statement:
∀ {a b c : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {f : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b} {g : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a c},
  f.IsPoly → g.IsPoly → (f.pair g).IsPoly
decl_320.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.pair {a b c : Ty} {f : Code a b} {g : Code a c}
    (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.pair f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨E, e, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + E + 2, d + e + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hsum := bound_add (hf x) (hg x)
  have htwo : 2 ≤ bound 2 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add hsum htwo
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_327.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_fst
decl_327.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_fst
decl_327.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_327.source:
theorem Code.poly_fst {a b : Ty} : (Code.fst (a := a) (b := b)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_334.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_snd
decl_334.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_snd
decl_334.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_334.source:
theorem Code.poly_snd {a b : Ty} : (Code.snd (a := a) (b := b)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_323.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_add
decl_323.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_add
decl_323.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_323.source:
theorem Code.poly_add : Code.add.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_add_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_332.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_mul
decl_332.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_mul
decl_332.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_332.source:
theorem Code.poly_mul : Code.mul.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_mul_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_335.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_sub
decl_335.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_sub
decl_335.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_335.source:
theorem Code.poly_sub : Code.sub.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_sub_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_331.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_maximum
decl_331.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_maximum
decl_331.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_331.source:
theorem Code.poly_maximum : Code.maximum.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  change (Computation.maximum x).size + 1 ≤
    (x.map (fun n : ℕ => n.size + 1)).sum + x.length + 1 + 1
  have := maximum_size_le x
  omega

decl_329.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_le
decl_329.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_le
decl_329.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_329.source:
theorem Code.poly_le : Code.le.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_359.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.sum_map_le_length_mul
decl_359.label: Hardness.Computation.sum_map_le_length_mul
decl_359.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_359.statement: ∀ {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f : A → ℕ) (M : ℕ), (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ M) → (List.map f xs).sum ≤ xs.length * M
decl_359.source:
theorem sum_map_le_length_mul {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f : A → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ M) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ xs.length * M := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hxs := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

decl_358.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.sum_map_add
decl_358.label: Hardness.Computation.sum_map_add
decl_358.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_358.statement:
∀ {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f g : A → ℕ),
  (List.map (fun x => f x + g x) xs).sum = (List.map f xs).sum + (List.map g xs).sum
decl_358.source:
theorem sum_map_add {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f g : A → ℕ) :
    (xs.map (fun x => f x + g x)).sum = (xs.map f).sum + (xs.map g).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

decl_318.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.map
decl_318.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.map
decl_318.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_318.statement: ∀ {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {f : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b}, f.IsPoly → f.map.IsPoly
decl_318.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.map {a b : Ty} {f : Code a b} (hf : f.IsPoly) :
    (Code.map f).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨C + 2, d + 1, ?_⟩
  intro xs
  let s := (Ty.list a).size xs
  have hlen : xs.length ≤ s := by dsimp [s, Ty.size]; omega
  have heach : ∀ x ∈ xs, f.cost x + b.size (f.eval x) ≤ bound C d s := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hf x).trans (bound_mono le_rfl le_rfl (Ty.size_mem_le hx))
  have hsum := sum_map_le_length_mul xs (fun x => f.cost x + b.size (f.eval x)) _ heach
  rw [sum_map_add] at hsum
  have hsum' := hsum.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (bound C d s) hlen)
  have hone : 1 ≤ (s + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hm1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (C * (s + 1) ^ d) (Nat.le_succ s)
  have hm2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * (s + 1)) hone
  change ((xs.map f.cost).sum + s + 1) +
    (((xs.map f.eval).map b.size).sum + (xs.map f.eval).length + 1) ≤ _
  simp only [List.map_map, List.length_map, Function.comp_def]
  change ((xs.map f.cost).sum + s + 1) +
    ((xs.map (fun x => b.size (f.eval x))).sum + xs.length + 1) ≤ bound (C + 2) (d + 1) s
  simp only [bound, pow_succ] at hsum' ⊢
  nlinarith

decl_355.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_flatten_le
decl_355.label: Hardness.Computation.size_flatten_le
decl_355.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_355.statement: ∀ {a : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} (xs : List (List a.Value)), a.list.size xs.flatten ≤ a.list.list.size xs
decl_355.source:
theorem size_flatten_le {a : Ty} (xs : List (List a.Value)) :
    (Ty.list a).size xs.flatten ≤ (Ty.list (.list a)).size xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [Ty.size]
  | cons ys xs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatten_cons, Ty.size, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
      List.length_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons] at *
    omega

decl_326.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_flatten
decl_326.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_flatten
decl_326.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_326.source:
theorem Code.poly_flatten {a : Ty} : (Code.flatten (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro xs
  exact (size_flatten_le xs).trans (Nat.le_succ _)

decl_324.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_cons
decl_324.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_cons
decl_324.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_324.source:
theorem Code.poly_cons {a : Ty} : (Code.cons (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons]
  omega

decl_330.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_length
decl_330.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_length
decl_330.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_330.source:
theorem Code.poly_length {a : Ty} : (Code.length (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro xs
  have hs : xs.length.size ≤ xs.length + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.size_le]
    exact (Nat.lt_succ_self _).trans_le (Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

decl_316.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.branch
decl_316.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.branch
decl_316.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_316.statement:
∀ {a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {c : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.bool}
  {f g : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a b}, c.IsPoly → f.IsPoly → g.IsPoly → (c.branch f g).IsPoly
decl_316.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.branch {a b : Ty} {c : Code a .bool} {f g : Code a b}
    (hc : c.IsPoly) (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.branch c f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hc⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨E, e, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨F, q, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + (E + F) + 1, d + (e + q) + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hcx : c.cost x ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (hc x)
  have hfg := bound_add (hf x) (hg x)
  have hone : 1 ≤ bound 1 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add (bound_add hcx hfg) hone
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at htotal
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval]
  cases c.eval x <;> simp <;> omega

decl_319.name: FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.mapWith
decl_319.label: Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.mapWith
decl_319.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_319.statement: ∀ {s a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {f : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code (s.pair a) b}, f.IsPoly → f.mapWith.IsPoly
decl_319.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.mapWith {s a b : Ty} {f : Code (.pair s a) b} (hf : f.IsPoly) :
    (Code.mapWith f).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨C + 2, d + 1, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let n := (Ty.pair s (.list a)).size x
  have hlen : x.2.length ≤ n := by dsimp [n, Ty.size]; omega
  have heach : ∀ y ∈ x.2, f.cost (x.1, y) + b.size (f.eval (x.1, y)) ≤ bound C d n := by
    intro y hy
    have hpair : (Ty.pair s a).size (x.1, y) ≤ n :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Ty.size_mem_le hy) _) _
    exact (hf _).trans (bound_mono le_rfl le_rfl hpair)
  have hsum := sum_map_le_length_mul x.2
    (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y) + b.size (f.eval (x.1, y))) _ heach
  rw [sum_map_add] at hsum
  have hsum' := hsum.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (bound C d n) hlen)
  have hone : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hm1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (C * (n + 1) ^ d) (Nat.le_succ n)
  have hm2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * (n + 1)) hone
  change ((x.2.map (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y))).sum + n + 1) +
    (((x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))).map b.size).sum +
      (x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))).length + 1) ≤ bound (C + 2) (d + 1) n
  simp only [List.map_map, List.length_map, Function.comp_def]
  simp only [bound, pow_succ] at hsum' ⊢
  nlinarith

-- Keep downstream certificate search at the program-syntax level. Unfolding
-- the semantic cost bound during failed `apply` attempts causes unnecessary
-- normalization of whole interpreters.
attribute [irreducible] Code.IsPoly

end FTC.Hardness.Computation

namespace FTC.Hardness.Complexity

open Computation

/-- YES and NO sets are disjoint. Inputs outside their union are unpromised. -/

decl_310.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem
decl_310.label: Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem
decl_310.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_310.source:
structure PromiseProblem (t : Ty) where
  yes : t.Value → Prop
  no : t.Value → Prop
  disjoint : ∀ x, yes x → no x → False

decl_313.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.languageProblem
decl_313.label: Hardness.Complexity.languageProblem
decl_313.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_313.source:
def languageProblem (L : List Bool → Prop) : PromiseProblem (.list .bool) where
  yes := L
  no x := ¬ L x
  disjoint _ hy hn := hn hy

/-- Polynomial-time many-one reduction, with an actual program witness. -/

decl_308.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction
decl_308.label: Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction
decl_308.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_308.statement:
{a b : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} →
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem a → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem b → Type
decl_308.source:
structure PolyReduction {a b : Ty} (P : PromiseProblem a) (Q : PromiseProblem b) where
  program : Code a b
  polynomial : program.IsPoly
  yes : ∀ x, P.yes x → Q.yes (program.eval x)
  no : ∀ x, P.no x → Q.no (program.eval x)

decl_309.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction.comp
decl_309.label: Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction.comp
decl_309.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_309.statement:
{a b c : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} →
  {P : FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem a} →
    {Q : FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem b} →
      {R : FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem c} →
        FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction P Q →
          FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction Q R → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction P R
decl_309.source:
def PolyReduction.comp {a b c : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} {Q : PromiseProblem b}
    {R : PromiseProblem c} (f : PolyReduction P Q) (g : PolyReduction Q R) :
    PolyReduction P R where
  program := .comp f.program g.program
  polynomial := f.polynomial.comp g.polynomial
  yes x hx := g.yes _ (f.yes x hx)
  no x hx := g.no _ (f.no x hx)

/-- Polynomial certificate verification in the explicit bit-cost model. -/

decl_303.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP
decl_303.label: Hardness.Complexity.InNP
decl_303.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_303.source:
def InNP (L : List Bool → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (verifier : Code (.pair (.list .bool) (.list .bool)) .bool),
    verifier.IsPoly ∧ ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x,
      L x ↔ ∃ witness : List Bool,
        witness.length ≤ bound C d x.length ∧ verifier.eval (x, witness) = true

decl_304.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP
decl_304.label: Hardness.Complexity.InP
decl_304.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_304.source:
def InP (L : List Bool → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (decider : Code (.list .bool) .bool), decider.IsPoly ∧
    ∀ x, L x ↔ decider.eval x = true

/-- NP-hardness for a promise problem, in the same explicit program model. -/

decl_305.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard
decl_305.label: Hardness.Complexity.NPHard
decl_305.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_305.source:
def NPHard {t : Ty} (P : PromiseProblem t) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → Nonempty (PolyReduction (languageProblem L) P)

decl_307.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.of_reduction
decl_307.label: Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.of_reduction
decl_307.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_307.source:
theorem NPHard.of_reduction {a b : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} {Q : PromiseProblem b}
    (hP : NPHard P) (r : PolyReduction P Q) : NPHard Q := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := hP L hL
  exact ⟨f.comp r⟩

decl_311.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.Solves
decl_311.label: Hardness.Complexity.Solves
decl_311.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_311.statement:
{a : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} →
  FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.bool → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem a → Prop
decl_311.source:
def Solves {a : Ty} (p : Code a .bool) (P : PromiseProblem a) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, P.yes x → p.eval x = true) ∧ (∀ x, P.no x → p.eval x = false)

decl_306.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.inP_of_solver
decl_306.label: Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.inP_of_solver
decl_306.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_306.statement:
∀ {a : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty} {P : FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem a},
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard P →
    ∀ {p : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code a FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.bool},
      p.IsPoly →
        FTC.Hardness.Complexity.Solves p P →
          ∀ {L : List Bool → Prop}, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L
decl_306.source:
theorem NPHard.inP_of_solver {a : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} (hP : NPHard P)
    {p : Code a .bool} (hpoly : p.IsPoly) (hsolve : Solves p P)
    {L : List Bool → Prop} (hL : InNP L) : InP L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hP L hL
  refine ⟨.comp r.program p, r.polynomial.comp hpoly, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact hsolve.1 _ (r.yes x hx)
  · intro hx
    by_contra hn
    have hfalse := hsolve.2 _ (r.no x hn)
    change p.eval (r.program.eval x) = true at hx
    simp [hfalse] at hx

decl_312.name: FTC.Hardness.Complexity.inNP_of_inP
decl_312.label: Hardness.Complexity.inNP_of_inP
decl_312.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Computation.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_312.statement: ∀ {L : List Bool → Prop}, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L
decl_312.source:
theorem inNP_of_inP {L : List Bool → Prop} (h : InP L) : InNP L := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨.comp .fst p, Code.poly_fst.comp hp, 0, 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨[], by simp [bound], (h x).mp hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, _, hw⟩
    exact (h x).mpr hw

end FTC.Hardness.Complexity

    rcases hr with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  clients_length := rfl
  self := by

  comm := by

  triangle := by
    intro i j z
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases z <;>
      norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational]
  eq_of_zero := by
    intro i j h

    all_goals first | rfl | norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational] at h

decl_461.label: Hardness.Examples.toy_cost

decl_461.statement:
∀
  (C :
    FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount FTC.Hardness.Examples.toyBase))
      (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.centerCount FTC.Hardness.Examples.toyBase)),
  FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.clients FTC.Hardness.Examples.toyBase) C = 1
decl_461.source:
theorem toy_cost (C : CenterSet (Fin (pointCount toyBase)) (centerCount toyBase)) :
    letI := toyBase_valid.metric.toMetricSpace
    cost kmeansLoss (clients toyBase) C = 1 := by
  letI := toyBase_valid.metric.toMetricSpace

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  simp only [cost, clients_toy, kmeansLoss, hp, Finset.inf'_singleton]
  change (∑ x : Fin 2, (matrixDistance toyBase.1 x p : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  fin_cases p <;> norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, rational]

decl_375.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidFull
decl_375.label: Hardness.Encoding.ValidFull
decl_375.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_375.source:
structure ValidFull (x : FullData) : Prop where
  matrix_length : (fullMatrix x).length = x.1 + 1
  square : ∀ row ∈ fullMatrix x, row.length = x.1 + 1
  flags_length : (fullFlags x).length = x.1 + 1
  weights_length : (fullWeights x).length = x.1 + 1
  self : ∀ i, fullDistance x i i = 0
  comm : ∀ i j, fullDistance x i j = fullDistance x j i
  triangle : ∀ i j z, fullDistance x i z ≤ fullDistance x i j + fullDistance x j z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ i j, fullDistance x i j = 0 → i = j
  centers_pos : 0 < fullK x
  centers_le : fullK x ≤ x.1 + 1
  query_active : (fullFlags x).getD 0 false = true

decl_376.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidFull.metric

decl_376.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_376.source:
def ValidFull.metric {x : FullData} (h : ValidFull x) : RationalMetric (Option (Fin x.1)) where
  distance := fullDistance x
  self := h.self
  comm := h.comm
  triangle := h.triangle
  eq_of_zero := h.eq_of_zero

decl_409.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.getD_map_inBounds
decl_409.label: Hardness.Encoding.getD_map_inBounds
decl_409.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_409.statement:
∀ {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (xs : List A),
  ∀ i < xs.length, ∀ (da : A) (db : B), (List.map f xs).getD i db = f (xs.getD i da)
decl_409.source:
theorem getD_map_inBounds {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (xs : List A) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < xs.length) (da : A) (db : B) :
    (xs.map f).getD i db = f (xs.getD i da) := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hi), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
  simp

/-- Every entry of the materialized distance matrix has the intended value. -/

decl_415.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializedDistance
decl_415.label: Hardness.Encoding.materializedDistance
decl_415.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_415.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (i j : Option (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1))),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullDistance (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize x) i j =
    match i, j with
    | none, none => 0
    | none, some val => ↑x.2.1
    | some val, none => ↑x.2.1
    | some a, some b => FTC.Hardness.Encoding.matrixDistance x.1.1 a b
decl_415.source:
theorem materializedDistance (x : TargetData) (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    fullDistance (materialize x) i j =
      match i, j with
      | none, none => 0
      | none, some _ => (x.2.1 : ℚ)
      | some _, none => (x.2.1 : ℚ)
      | some a, some b => matrixDistance x.1.1 a b := by
  cases i with
  | none =>
    cases j with
    | none => simp [fullDistance, materialize, expandedMatrix, fullMatrix, position, rational]
    | some j =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ j j.isLt [] (0, 0)]
      simp [rational]
  | some i =>
    cases j with
    | none =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] []]
      simp [rational]
    | some j =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] []]
      simp only [List.getD_cons_succ, matrixDistance]

decl_416.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializedDistance_cast
decl_416.label: Hardness.Encoding.materializedDistance_cast
decl_416.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_416.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x)
  (i j : Option (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1))),
  ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullDistance (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize x) i j) =
    FTC.Hardness.extensionDist (↑x.2.1) i j
decl_416.source:
theorem materializedDistance_cast (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x)
    (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) = extensionDist (x.2.1 : ℝ) i j := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [materializedDistance]
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp only [extensionDist, Rat.cast_zero, Rat.cast_natCast]
  rfl

/-- Materialization produces an ordinary valid finite weighted metric instance. -/

decl_414.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize_valid
decl_414.label: Hardness.Encoding.materialize_valid
decl_414.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_414.source:
theorem materialize_valid (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) : ValidFull (materialize x) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := extensionMetric (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos h.real_radius_bound
  have hdist (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
      (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) = dist i j := materializedDistance_cast x h i j
  refine {
    matrix_length := by simp [materialize, expandedMatrix, fullMatrix, pointCount]
    square := ?_
    flags_length := ?_
    weights_length := by simp [materialize, fullWeights, pointCount]
    self := ?_
    comm := ?_
    triangle := ?_
    eq_of_zero := ?_
    centers_pos := h.base.centers_pos
    centers_le := h.base.centers_le.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    query_active := by simp [materialize, fullFlags]
  }
  · intro row hr
    simp only [materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, List.mem_cons, List.mem_map] at hr
    rcases hr with rfl | ⟨old, hold, rfl⟩
    · simp [pointCount, materialize]
    · have := h.base.square old hold
      simpa only [List.length_cons, materialize] using congrArg Nat.succ this
  · have := h.base.clients_length
    simpa only [materialize, fullFlags, List.length_cons] using congrArg Nat.succ this
  · intro i
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i i : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hdist, dist_self]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) =
        (fullDistance (materialize x) j i : ℝ) := by rw [hdist, hdist, dist_comm]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j z
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i z : ℝ) ≤
        (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) + (fullDistance (materialize x) j z : ℝ) := by
      rw [hdist, hdist, hdist]
      exact dist_triangle _ _ _
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j hij
    apply dist_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← hdist, hij, Rat.cast_zero]

decl_391.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullClients_materialize
decl_391.label: Hardness.Encoding.fullClients_materialize
decl_391.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_391.source:
theorem fullClients_materialize (x : TargetData) :
    fullClients (materialize x) = extendedClients (clients x.1) := by
  ext i
  cases i <;> simp [fullClients, materialize, fullFlags, position, extendedClients,
    clients, Finset.mem_map]

decl_396.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullEntries_materialize_weight
decl_396.label: Hardness.Encoding.fullEntries_materialize_weight
decl_396.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_396.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (i : Option (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1))),
  (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullEntries (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize x) i).weight =
    match i with
    | none => 1
    | some val => ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2.2)
decl_396.source:
theorem fullEntries_materialize_weight (x : TargetData) (i : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    (fullEntries (materialize x) i).weight =
      match i with | none => 1 | some _ => (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) := by
  cases i with
  | none => simp [fullEntries, materialize, fullWeights, position, rational]
  | some i =>
    simp only [fullEntries, materialize, fullWeights, position, List.getD_cons_succ]
    rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] (0, 0)]

decl_399.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullLoss_materialize
decl_399.label: Hardness.Encoding.fullLoss_materialize
decl_399.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_399.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x)
  (p : Option (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1)))
  (C :
    FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option (Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1)))
      (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.centerCount x.1)),
  FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C = FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss (↑x.2.1) p C
decl_399.source:
theorem fullLoss_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x)
    (p : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1)))
    (C : CenterSet (Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) (centerCount x.1)) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    letI := (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace
    kmeansLoss p C = extensionLoss (x.2.1 : ℝ) p C := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold kmeansLoss extensionLoss
  apply Finset.inf'_congr C.nonempty rfl
  intro q _
  change (fullDistance (materialize x) p q : ℝ) ^ 2 = extensionDist (x.2.1 : ℝ) p q ^ 2
  rw [materializedDistance_cast x h]

decl_393.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullContribution_materialize
decl_393.label: Hardness.Encoding.fullContribution_materialize
decl_393.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_393.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullContribution (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize x) ⋯ =
    FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution ↑x.2.1 ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2.2)
decl_393.source:
theorem fullContribution_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    fullContribution (materialize x) (materialize_valid x h) =
      gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1) (x.2.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  funext i C
  change (fullEntries (materialize x) i).weight *
      @kmeansLoss (Option (Fin (pointCount x.1)))
        (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace _ i C = _
  rw [fullEntries_materialize_weight, fullLoss_materialize x h]
  cases i <;> simp only [gadgetContribution, one_mul]

decl_407.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullSensitivity_materialize
decl_407.label: Hardness.Encoding.fullSensitivity_materialize
decl_407.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullMatrix.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_407.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullSensitivity (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize x) ⋯ =
    FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity x h
decl_407.source:
theorem fullSensitivity_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    fullSensitivity (materialize x) (materialize_valid x h) = targetSensitivity x h := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold fullSensitivity
  rw [fullClients_materialize, fullContribution_materialize x h]
  exact (targetSensitivity_eq_gadget x h).symm

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding

  simp only [materializeCode, baseMatrixCode, expandedMatrixCode, firstRowCode, otherRowsCode,
    targetRadiusCode, targetWeightCode, flagsCode, weightsCode, targetCentersCode]
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | apply Code.IsPoly.mapWith
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_cons
    | exact Code.poly_length

decl_405.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode_polynomial

decl_405.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_405.source:

decl_404.statement:
∀ (c : ℕ) (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.SourceData),
  (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode c).eval x =
    FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce c x)
decl_404.source:
@[simp] theorem fullReductionCode_eval (c : ℕ) (x : SourceData) :
    (fullReductionCode c).eval x = materialize (reduce c x) := by
  simp only [fullReductionCode, Code.eval, reductionCode_eval, materializeCode_eval]

/-- Both the bit-cost of the construction and the encoded output size have a
polynomial bound, uniformly over all raw inputs, even malformed ones. -/

decl_403.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode_cost_size
decl_403.label: Polynomial construction cost and size
decl_403.summary: Bounds the full reduction’s binary bit-cost and encoded output size in the formalized program model.
decl_403.statement:
∀ (c : ℕ),
  ∃ C d,
    ∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.SourceData),
      (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode c).cost x +
          FTC.Hardness.Encoding.FullTy.size (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce c x)) ≤
        FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound C d (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.SourceTy.size x)
decl_403.source:
theorem fullReductionCode_cost_size (c : ℕ) :
    ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x : SourceData,
      (fullReductionCode c).cost x + FullTy.size (materialize (reduce c x)) ≤
        bound C d (SourceTy.size x) := by
  have h := fullReductionCode_polynomial c
  unfold Code.IsPoly at h
  simpa only [fullReductionCode_eval] using h

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding
