decl_496.label: Hardness.fullGapSensitivity
decl_496.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_496.statement: (α : ℝ) → 1 ≤ α → (t : ℚ) → 0 < t → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem FTC.Hardness.Encoding.FullTy
decl_496.source:
def fullGapSensitivity (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PromiseProblem FullTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidFull x, α * (t : ℝ) ≤ fullSensitivity x h
  no x := ∃ h : ValidFull x, fullSensitivity x h < (t : ℝ)
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have htR : 0 < (t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
    change fullSensitivity x hy < (t : ℝ) at hno
    nlinarith

decl_512.name: FTC.Hardness.materializeReduction
decl_512.label: Hardness.materializeReduction
decl_512.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_512.statement:
(α : ℝ) →
  (hα : 1 ≤ α) →
    (t : ℚ) →
      (ht : 0 < t) →
        FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction (FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity α hα t ht)
          (FTC.Hardness.fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht)
decl_512.source:
def materializeReduction (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PolyReduction (gapSensitivity α hα t ht) (fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht) where
  program := materializeCode
  polynomial := materializeCode_polynomial
  yes x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    rw [materializeCode_eval]
    exact ⟨materialize_valid x h, by rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x h]; exact hyes⟩
  no x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    rw [materializeCode_eval]
    exact ⟨materialize_valid x h, by rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x h]; exact hno⟩

decl_495.name: FTC.Hardness.fullGapReduction
decl_495.label: Hardness.fullGapReduction
decl_495.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_495.statement:
{ρ α : ℝ} →
  (hα : 1 ≤ α) →
    (hαρ : α < ρ) →
      (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α) →
        FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯)
          (FTC.Hardness.fullGapSensitivity α hα params.threshold ⋯)
decl_495.source:
def fullGapReduction {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) :
    PolyReduction (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))
      (fullGapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) :=
  (gapReduction hα hαρ params).comp
    (materializeReduction α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos)

/-- Theorem 4.2 with an ordinary explicit matrix/weight-list target encoding. -/

decl_536.name: FTC.Hardness.theorem_4_2_full_matrix
decl_536.label: Theorem 4.2 · Conditional hardness
decl_536.summary: Theorem 4.2: conditional hardness transfer for the explicit rational full-distance-matrix reduction. Assumes the external gap-k-means hardness premise.
decl_536.statement:
∀ {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ),
  0 < δ →
    ∀ (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1),
      FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ hρ) →
        ∃ params, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.fullGapSensitivity (ρ - δ) ⋯ params.threshold ⋯)
decl_536.source:
theorem theorem_4_2_full_matrix {ρ δ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ params : GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ),
      NPHard (fullGapSensitivity (ρ - δ) (by linarith)
        params.threshold params.threshold_pos) := by
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := paper_gapParameters_nonempty hρ hδ hδsmall
  exact ⟨params, hhard.of_reduction (fullGapReduction (by linarith) (by linarith) params)⟩

/-- An approximation algorithm on unrestricted ordinary matrix inputs. -/

decl_301.name: FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity
decl_301.label: Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity
decl_301.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_301.source:
def ApproximatesFullSensitivity (α : ℝ) (algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy) : Prop :=
  ∀ x (h : ValidFull x),
    fullSensitivity x h / α ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ∧
      (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ≤ fullSensitivity x h

decl_478.name: FTC.Hardness.approximation_on_materialized_inputs
decl_478.label: Hardness.approximation_on_materialized_inputs
decl_478.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_478.statement:
∀ {α : ℝ} {algorithm : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.FullTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy},
  FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm →
    FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity α (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializeCode.comp algorithm)
decl_478.source:
theorem approximation_on_materialized_inputs {α : ℝ} {algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy}
    (h : ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ApproximatesSensitivity α (.comp materializeCode algorithm) := by
  intro x hx
  have happrox := h (materialize x) (materialize_valid x hx)
  rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x hx] at happrox
  simpa only [Code.eval, materializeCode_eval] using happrox

decl_497.name: FTC.Hardness.full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p
decl_497.label: Hardness.full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p
decl_497.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_497.statement:
∀ {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯) →
    ∀ {algorithm : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.FullTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy},
      algorithm.IsPoly →
        FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm →
          ∀ (L : List Bool → Prop), FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L
decl_497.source:
theorem full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p {ρ α : ℝ}
    (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    {algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy} (hpoly : algorithm.IsPoly)
    (happrox : ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → InP L :=
  approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard
    (materializeCode_polynomial.comp hpoly) (approximation_on_materialized_inputs happrox)

/-- The usual impossibility consequence, with NP ≠ P stated as an explicit
language witness in the same bit-cost model. -/

decl_515.name: FTC.Hardness.no_polynomial_full_approximation
decl_515.label: Hardness.no_polynomial_full_approximation
decl_515.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_515.statement:
∀ {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯) →
    (∃ L, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L ∧ ¬FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L) →
      ¬∃ algorithm, algorithm.IsPoly ∧ FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm
decl_515.source:
theorem no_polynomial_full_approximation {ρ α : ℝ}
    (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    (hseparation : ∃ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L ∧ ¬ InP L) :
    ¬ ∃ algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy,
      algorithm.IsPoly ∧ ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm := by
  rintro ⟨algorithm, hpoly, happrox⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hnot⟩ := hseparation
  exact hnot (full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard hpoly happrox L hL)

/-- Any externally established open interval of gap-hardness factors transfers
to pointwise sensitivity approximation on full matrix inputs. In particular,
the paper's cited k-means hardness family can be supplied with R = 1 + 8/e. -/

decl_531.name: FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_hardness_below_limit
decl_531.label: Hardness.sensitivity_hardness_below_limit
decl_531.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/FullReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_531.statement:
∀ {R α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α),
  α < R →
    (∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ), ρ < R → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ hρ)) →
      ∃ t, ∃ (ht : 0 < t), FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht)
decl_531.source:
theorem sensitivity_hardness_below_limit {R α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαR : α < R)
    (hbase : ∀ ρ : ℝ, ∀ hρ : 1 < ρ, ρ < R → NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t), NPHard (fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht) := by
  let ρ := (α + R) / 2
  have hαρ : α < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  have hρR : ρ < R := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := gapParameters_nonempty hα hαρ
  exact ⟨params.threshold, params.threshold_pos,
    (hbase ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ) hρR).of_reduction (fullGapReduction hα hαρ params)⟩

end FTC.Hardness

decl_470.name: FTC.Hardness.GapParameters
decl_470.label: Hardness.GapParameters
decl_470.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_470.source:
structure GapParameters (ρ α : ℝ) where
  copies : ℕ
  copies_pos : 0 < copies
  threshold : ℚ
  threshold_pos : 0 < threshold
  no_lt : 1 / (1 + (copies : ℝ) * ρ) < (threshold : ℝ)
  yes_le : (threshold : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (α * (1 + (copies : ℝ)))

/-- Explicit integer amplification and rational separation exist for every
constant slack, including irrational approximation factors. -/

decl_504.name: FTC.Hardness.gapParameters_nonempty
decl_504.label: Hardness.gapParameters_nonempty
decl_504.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_504.statement: ∀ {ρ α : ℝ}, 1 ≤ α → α < ρ → Nonempty (FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α)
decl_504.source:
theorem gapParameters_nonempty {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) :
    Nonempty (GapParameters ρ α) := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := hαpos.trans hαρ
  have hgap : 0 < ρ - α := sub_pos.mpr hαρ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ρ / (ρ - α))
  have hcposR : 0 < (c : ℝ) := (div_pos hρpos hgap).trans hc
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by exact_mod_cast hcposR
  have hlarge : ρ < (c : ℝ) * (ρ - α) := (div_lt_iff₀ hgap).mp hc
  have hsep : α * (1 + (c : ℝ)) < 1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ := by nlinarith
  have hleft : 0 < 1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ := by positivity
  have hright : 0 < α * (1 + (c : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hinv : 1 / (1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ) < 1 / (α * (1 + (c : ℝ))) := by
    exact (div_lt_div_iff₀ hleft hright).mpr (by simpa using hsep)
  obtain ⟨t, htleft, htright⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hinv
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    exact_mod_cast (div_pos zero_lt_one hleft).trans htleft
  exact ⟨⟨c, hcpos, t, htpos, htleft, htright.le⟩⟩

/-- A concrete weight, using only the input threshold and a diameter bound. -/

decl_471.name: FTC.Hardness.amplification
decl_471.label: Hardness.amplification
decl_471.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_471.source: noncomputable def amplification (c : ℕ) (D B : ℝ) : ℝ := (c : ℝ) * D ^ 2 / B

decl_472.name: FTC.Hardness.amplification_pos
decl_472.label: Hardness.amplification_pos
decl_472.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_472.statement: ∀ {c : ℕ}, 0 < c → ∀ {D B : ℝ}, 0 < D → 0 < B → 0 < FTC.Hardness.amplification c D B

decl_473.name: FTC.Hardness.amplified_sensitivity_formula
decl_473.label: Hardness.amplified_sensitivity_formula
decl_473.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_473.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {D B : ℝ},
  0 < D →
    0 < B →
      ∀ {c : ℕ},
        0 < c →
          FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D (FTC.Hardness.amplification c D B))
              (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none =
            B / (B + ↑c * FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX)
decl_473.source:
theorem amplified_sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {D B : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification c D B))
      (extendedClients P) none = B / (B + (c : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX) := by
  have hL := amplification_pos hc hD hB
  have hopt := optimum_nonneg P hk hkX
  have hcR : 0 ≤ (c : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg c
  have hden : 0 < D ^ 2 + amplification c D B * optimum P hk hkX := by positivity
  have hden' : 0 < B + (c : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX := by positivity
  rw [sensitivity_formula P hk hkX D hD hL.le]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hden.ne' hden'.ne').mpr
  unfold amplification
  field_simp

/-- YES instances land above the α-times-threshold side of the target gap. -/

decl_533.name: FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_yes
decl_533.label: Hardness.sensitivity_yes
decl_533.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_533.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  1 ≤ α →
    0 < D →
      0 < B →
        FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX ≤ B →
          α * ↑params.threshold ≤
            FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D (FTC.Hardness.amplification params.copies D B))
              (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none
decl_533.source:
theorem sensitivity_yes (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B) (hyes : optimum P hk hkX ≤ B) :
    α * (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
        (extendedClients P) none := by
  rw [amplified_sensitivity_formula P hk hkX hD hB params.copies_pos]
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  have hc : 0 ≤ (params.copies : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hc1 : 0 < 1 + (params.copies : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hden : 0 < B + (params.copies : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hB (mul_nonneg hc (optimum_nonneg P hk hkX))
  have hsmall : α * (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (1 + (params.copies : ℝ)) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hc1).mpr
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hαpos hc1)).mp params.yes_le
    nlinarith
  apply hsmall.trans
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hc1 hden).mpr
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyes hc
  nlinarith

/-- NO instances land strictly below the rational threshold. -/

decl_532.name: FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_no
decl_532.label: Hardness.sensitivity_no
decl_532.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_532.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  1 ≤ α →
    α < ρ →
      0 < D →
        0 < B →
          ρ * B < FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX →
            FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D (FTC.Hardness.amplification params.copies D B))
                (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none <
              ↑params.threshold
decl_532.source:
theorem sensitivity_no (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B) (hno : ρ * B < optimum P hk hkX) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none < (params.threshold : ℝ) := by
  rw [amplified_sensitivity_formula P hk hkX hD hB params.copies_pos]
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα).trans hαρ
  have hc : 0 < (params.copies : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast params.copies_pos
  have hden : 0 < B + (params.copies : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hB (mul_nonneg hc.le (optimum_nonneg P hk hkX))
  have hden' : 0 < 1 + (params.copies : ℝ) * ρ := by positivity
  apply lt_trans _ params.no_lt
  apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hden hden').mpr
  have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hno hc
  nlinarith

/-- A single approximate sensitivity value decides the promised gap instance.
The bound is the approximation convention used throughout the paper:
`σ / α ≤ score ≤ σ`. -/

decl_507.name: FTC.Hardness.gap_decision_of_approximation
decl_507.label: Hardness.gap_decision_of_approximation
decl_507.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_507.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {ρ α D B score : ℝ} (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  1 ≤ α →
    α < ρ →
      0 < D →
        0 < B →
          FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX ≤ B ∨ ρ * B < FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX →
            FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D (FTC.Hardness.amplification params.copies D B))
                    (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none /
                  α ≤
                score →
              score ≤
                  FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D (FTC.Hardness.amplification params.copies D B))
                    (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none →
                (↑params.threshold ≤ score ↔ FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX ≤ B)
decl_507.source:
theorem gap_decision_of_approximation (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {ρ α D B score : ℝ}
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hpromise : optimum P hk hkX ≤ B ∨ ρ * B < optimum P hk hkX)
    (hlower : sensitivity
      (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none / α ≤ score)
    (hupper : score ≤ sensitivity
      (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none) :
    (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤ score ↔ optimum P hk hkX ≤ B := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  constructor
  · intro ht
    rcases hpromise with hy | hn
    · exact hy
    · have hbad := sensitivity_no P hk hkX params hα hαρ hD hB hn
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt hbad) (ht.trans hupper))
  · intro hy
    have hgood := sensitivity_yes P hk hkX params hα hD hB hy
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ hαpos).mp hlower
    nlinarith

/-- The parameters in Theorem 4.2 satisfy the more general reduction above. -/

decl_526.name: FTC.Hardness.paper_gapParameters_nonempty
decl_526.label: Hardness.paper_gapParameters_nonempty
decl_526.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/GapReduction.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_526.statement: ∀ {ρ δ : ℝ}, 1 < ρ → 0 < δ → δ < ρ - 1 → Nonempty (FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ))
decl_526.source:
theorem paper_gapParameters_nonempty {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1) :
    Nonempty (GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ)) :=
  gapParameters_nonempty (by linarith) (by linarith)

end FTC.Hardness

decl_503.name: FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans
decl_503.label: Hardness.gapKMeans
decl_503.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_503.source:
def gapKMeans (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ) : PromiseProblem SourceTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidSource x, originalOptimum x.1 h.base ≤ (rational x.2 : ℝ)
  no x := ∃ h : ValidSource x, ρ * (rational x.2 : ℝ) < originalOptimum x.1 h.base
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have hB : 0 < (rational x.2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast rational_pos hy.budget_pos
    change ρ * (rational x.2 : ℝ) < originalOptimum x.1 hy.base at hno
    nlinarith

/-- The sensitivity gap that every α-approximation can decide by comparison
with t. The metric has one distinguished point and otherwise arbitrary
rational distances; all k centers may be chosen anywhere in the metric. -/

decl_506.name: FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity
decl_506.label: Hardness.gapSensitivity
decl_506.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_506.statement: (α : ℝ) → 1 ≤ α → (t : ℚ) → 0 < t → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy
decl_506.source:
def gapSensitivity (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PromiseProblem TargetTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidTarget x, α * (t : ℝ) ≤ targetSensitivity x h
  no x := ∃ h : ValidTarget x, targetSensitivity x h < (t : ℝ)
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have htR : 0 < (t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
    change targetSensitivity x hy < (t : ℝ) at hno
    nlinarith

/-- The executable, polynomial, promise-preserving reduction of Appendix B. -/

decl_505.name: FTC.Hardness.gapReduction
decl_505.label: Hardness.gapReduction
decl_505.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_505.statement:
{ρ α : ℝ} →
  (hα : 1 ≤ α) →
    (hαρ : α < ρ) →
      (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α) →
        FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯)
          (FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold ⋯)
decl_505.source:
def gapReduction {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) :
    PolyReduction (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))
      (gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) where
  program := reductionCode params.copies
  polynomial := reductionCode_polynomial params.copies
  yes x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    rw [reductionCode_eval]
    refine ⟨reduce_valid params.copies_pos h, ?_⟩
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    rw [reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget params.copies_pos x h]
    exact sensitivity_yes (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
      params hα (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1)
      (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hyes
  no x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    rw [reductionCode_eval]
    refine ⟨reduce_valid params.copies_pos h, ?_⟩
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    rw [reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget params.copies_pos x h]
    exact sensitivity_no (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
      params hα hαρ (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1)
      (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hno

decl_518.name: FTC.Hardness.npHard_sensitivity_of_gap
decl_518.label: Hardness.npHard_sensitivity_of_gap
decl_518.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_518.statement:
∀ {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯) →
    FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold ⋯)
decl_518.source:
theorem npHard_sensitivity_of_gap {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))) :
    NPHard (gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) :=
  hhard.of_reduction (gapReduction hα hαρ params)

/-- Theorem 4.2, with the paper's parameters and its source-hardness premise.
The rational threshold is fixed independently of the input instance. -/

decl_535.name: FTC.Hardness.theorem_4_2
decl_535.label: Hardness.theorem_4_2
decl_535.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_535.statement:
∀ {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ),
  0 < δ →
    ∀ (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1),
      FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ hρ) →
        ∃ params, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity (ρ - δ) ⋯ params.threshold ⋯)
decl_535.source:
theorem theorem_4_2 {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ params : GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ),
      NPHard (gapSensitivity (ρ - δ) (by linarith) params.threshold params.threshold_pos) := by
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := paper_gapParameters_nonempty hρ hδ hδsmall
  exact ⟨params, npHard_sensitivity_of_gap (by linarith) (by linarith) params hhard⟩

/-! ## Thresholding any polynomial approximation program -/

decl_481.name: FTC.Hardness.encodeRational
decl_481.label: Hardness.encodeRational
decl_481.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.

decl_527.name: FTC.Hardness.rational_encodeRational
decl_527.label: Hardness.rational_encodeRational
decl_527.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_527.source:
theorem rational_encodeRational (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : rational (encodeRational t) = t := by
  have hden : t.den - 1 + 1 = t.den := Nat.sub_add_cancel t.pos
  have hdenQ : ((t.den - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = (t.den : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hden
  have hnumZ : (t.num.natAbs : ℤ) = t.num := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr ht)
  have hnumQ : (t.num.natAbs : ℚ) = (t.num : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℚ)) hnumZ
  change (t.num.natAbs : ℚ) / (((t.den - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) = t
  rw [hnumQ, hdenQ]
  exact t.num_div_den

decl_528.name: FTC.Hardness.rational_le_iff
decl_528.label: Hardness.rational_le_iff
decl_528.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_528.statement:
∀ (q r : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatData),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational q ≤ FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational r ↔ q.1 * (r.2 + 1) ≤ r.1 * (q.2 + 1)
decl_528.source:
theorem rational_le_iff (q r : RatData) :
    rational q ≤ rational r ↔ q.1 * (r.2 + 1) ≤ r.1 * (q.2 + 1) := by
  unfold rational
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (q.2 : ℚ) + 1)
    (by positivity : 0 < (r.2 : ℚ) + 1)]
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

decl_537.name: FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode
decl_537.label: Hardness.thresholdCode
decl_537.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_537.source:
def thresholdCode (q : RatData) : Code RatTy .bool :=
  .comp
    (.pair
      (.comp (.pair (.const q.1) (.comp (.pair .snd (.const 1)) .add)) .mul)
      (.comp (.pair .fst (.const (q.2 + 1))) .mul)) .le

decl_538.name: FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode_correct
decl_538.label: Hardness.thresholdCode_correct
decl_538.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_538.statement:
∀ (q r : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatData),
  (FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode q).eval r = true ↔ FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational q ≤ FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational r
decl_538.source:
theorem thresholdCode_correct (q r : RatData) :
    (thresholdCode q).eval r = true ↔ rational q ≤ rational r := by
  simp only [thresholdCode, Code.eval, decide_eq_true_eq, rational_le_iff]

decl_539.name: FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode_polynomial
decl_539.label: Hardness.thresholdCode_polynomial
decl_539.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_539.source:
theorem thresholdCode_polynomial (q : RatData) : (thresholdCode q).IsPoly := by
  unfold thresholdCode
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_add
    | exact Code.poly_mul
    | exact Code.poly_le

/-- The paper's one-sided approximation convention, on every valid input. -/

decl_302.name: FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity
decl_302.label: Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity
decl_302.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_302.source:
def ApproximatesSensitivity (α : ℝ) (algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy) : Prop :=
  ∀ x (h : ValidTarget x),
    targetSensitivity x h / α ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ∧
      (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ≤ targetSensitivity x h

decl_474.name: FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider
decl_474.label: Hardness.approximationDecider
decl_474.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_474.statement:
ℚ →
  FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy →
    FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.bool
decl_474.source:
def approximationDecider (t : ℚ) (algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy) : Code TargetTy .bool :=
  .comp algorithm (thresholdCode (encodeRational t))

decl_475.name: FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider_polynomial
decl_475.label: Hardness.approximationDecider_polynomial
decl_475.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_475.statement:
∀ (t : ℚ) {algorithm : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy},
  algorithm.IsPoly → (FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider t algorithm).IsPoly

decl_476.name: FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider_solves
decl_476.label: Hardness.approximationDecider_solves
decl_476.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_476.statement:
∀ {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) {t : ℚ} (ht : 0 < t)
  {algorithm : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy},
  FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm →
    FTC.Hardness.Complexity.Solves (FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider t algorithm)
      (FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity α hα t ht)
decl_476.source:
theorem approximationDecider_solves {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) {t : ℚ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy} (happrox : ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm) :
    Solves (approximationDecider t algorithm) (gapSensitivity α hα t ht) := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    have ha := (happrox x h).1
    have hscore : (t : ℝ) ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) := by
      have h := (div_le_iff₀ hαpos).mp ha
      nlinarith
    apply (thresholdCode_correct _ _).mpr
    rw [rational_encodeRational t ht.le]
    exact_mod_cast hscore
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    have hscore : (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) < (t : ℝ) :=
      (happrox x h).2.trans_lt hno
    apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    intro heq
    have hle := (thresholdCode_correct (encodeRational t) (algorithm.eval x)).mp heq
    rw [rational_encodeRational t ht.le] at hle
    have hleR : (t : ℝ) ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hscore) hleR

/-- A polynomial α-approximation, together with source gap hardness, puts
every NP language in P in the specified bit-cost model. -/

decl_477.name: FTC.Hardness.approximation_implies_np_subset_p
decl_477.label: Hardness.approximation_implies_np_subset_p
decl_477.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_477.statement:
∀ {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯) →
    ∀ {algorithm : FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetTy FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatTy},
      algorithm.IsPoly →
        FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm →
          ∀ (L : List Bool → Prop), FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L → FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L
decl_477.source:
theorem approximation_implies_np_subset_p {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    {algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy} (hpoly : algorithm.IsPoly)
    (happrox : ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → InP L := by
  intro L hL
  exact (npHard_sensitivity_of_gap hα hαρ params hhard).inP_of_solver
    (approximationDecider_polynomial params.threshold hpoly)
    (approximationDecider_solves hα params.threshold_pos happrox) hL

decl_514.name: FTC.Hardness.no_polynomial_approximation
decl_514.label: Hardness.no_polynomial_approximation
decl_514.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/Hardness.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_514.statement:
∀ {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : FTC.Hardness.GapParameters ρ α),
  FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard (FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans ρ ⋯) →
    (∃ L, FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP L ∧ ¬FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP L) →
      ¬∃ algorithm, algorithm.IsPoly ∧ FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm
decl_514.source:
theorem no_polynomial_approximation {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    (hseparation : ∃ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L ∧ ¬ InP L) :
    ¬ ∃ algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy, algorithm.IsPoly ∧ ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm := by
  rintro ⟨algorithm, hpoly, happrox⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hnot⟩ := hseparation
  exact hnot (approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard hpoly happrox L hL)

/-- The actual metric used by the hardness gadget. -/

decl_494.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionMetric
decl_494.label: Hardness.extensionMetric
decl_494.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_494.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [inst : MetricSpace X] → (D : ℝ) → 0 < D → (∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ D) → MetricSpace (Option X)
decl_494.source:
@[reducible] noncomputable def extensionMetric (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) : MetricSpace (Option X) where
  dist := extensionDist D
  dist_self x := by cases x <;> simp [extensionDist]
  dist_comm x y := by cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [extensionDist, dist_comm]
  dist_triangle x y z := by
    cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;> simp only [extensionDist]
    · norm_num
    · simp
    · linarith
    · rename_i x y
      have := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y); linarith
    · simp
    · rename_i x y
      have := hdiam x y; linarith
    · rename_i x y
      have := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y); linarith
    · exact dist_triangle _ _ _
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
    intro x y h
    cases x <;> cases y
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (hD.ne' h)
    · exact False.elim (hD.ne' h)
    · exact congrArg some (dist_eq_zero.mp h)

decl_511.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} [inst_2 : Fintype X]
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k),
  none ∉ C.centers → Finset.map FTC.Hardness.oldPoint (FTC.Hardness.oldCenters C) = C.centers
decl_511.source:
theorem map_oldCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) :
    (oldCenters C).map oldPoint = C.centers := by
  ext x
  cases x with
  | none => simp [Finset.mem_map, h]
  | some x => simp [Finset.mem_map]

/-- A query avoiding the new point is precisely an original k-center query. -/

decl_510.name: FTC.Hardness.lowerCenters
decl_510.label: Hardness.lowerCenters
decl_510.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_510.statement:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq X] →
    [MetricSpace X] →
      {k : ℕ} →
        [Fintype X] → (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k) → none ∉ C.centers → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k
decl_510.source:
def lowerCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) : CenterSet X k where
  centers := oldCenters C
  card_eq := by
    have hc := congrArg Finset.card (map_oldCenters C h)
    simpa [C.card_eq] using hc
  nonempty := by
    have hn : ((oldCenters C).map oldPoint).Nonempty :=
      (map_oldCenters C h).symm ▸ C.nonempty
    exact Finset.map_nonempty.mp hn

decl_509.name: FTC.Hardness.lift_lowerCenters
decl_509.label: Hardness.lift_lowerCenters
decl_509.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_509.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} [inst_2 : Fintype X]
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers),
  FTC.Hardness.liftCenters (FTC.Hardness.lowerCenters C h) = C
decl_509.source:
theorem lift_lowerCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) :
    liftCenters (lowerCenters C h) = C :=
  centerSet_ext (map_oldCenters C h)

end Finite

/-- Squared-distance loss in the extended metric, kept independent of the
metric-space instance so the numerical formulas have no proof parameters. -/

decl_488.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss
decl_488.label: Hardness.extensionLoss
decl_488.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_488.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → ℝ → Option X → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k → ℝ
decl_488.source:
noncomputable def extensionLoss (D : ℝ) (p : Option X)
    (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) : ℝ :=
  C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => extensionDist D p x ^ 2)

decl_492.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_nonneg
decl_492.label: Hardness.extensionLoss_nonneg
decl_492.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_492.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (p : Option X)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k), 0 ≤ FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss D p C
decl_492.source:
theorem extensionLoss_nonneg (D : ℝ) (p : Option X) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) :
    0 ≤ extensionLoss D p C :=
  Finset.le_inf' _ _ (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

decl_489.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_eq_kmeansLoss
decl_489.label: Hardness.extensionLoss_eq_kmeansLoss
decl_489.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_489.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hdiam : ∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ D)
  (p : Option X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k),
  FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss D p C = FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C
decl_489.source:
theorem extensionLoss_eq_kmeansLoss (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) (p : Option X) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    extensionLoss D p C = kmeansLoss p C := rfl

decl_493.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_old_lift
decl_493.label: Hardness.extensionLoss_old_lift
decl_493.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_493.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (p : X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss D (some p) (FTC.Hardness.liftCenters C) = FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss p C
decl_493.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionLoss_old_lift (D : ℝ) (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    extensionLoss D (some p) (liftCenters C) = kmeansLoss p C := by
  simp [extensionLoss, liftCenters, Finset.inf'_map, extensionDist, kmeansLoss]

decl_490.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_new_lift
decl_490.label: Hardness.extensionLoss_new_lift
decl_490.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_490.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss D none (FTC.Hardness.liftCenters C) = D ^ 2
decl_490.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionLoss_new_lift (D : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    extensionLoss D none (liftCenters C) = D ^ 2 := by
  simp [extensionLoss, liftCenters, Finset.inf'_map, extensionDist]

decl_491.name: FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_new_of_mem
decl_491.label: Hardness.extensionLoss_new_of_mem
decl_491.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_491.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k),
  none ∈ C.centers → FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss D none C = 0
decl_491.source:
theorem extensionLoss_new_of_mem (D : ℝ) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k)
    (h : none ∈ C.centers) : extensionLoss D none C = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · change C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => extensionDist D none x ^ 2) ≤ 0
    calc
      _ ≤ extensionDist D none none ^ 2 := Finset.inf'_le _ h
      _ = 0 := by simp [extensionDist]
  · exact extensionLoss_nonneg D none C

/-- One old entry per original client, plus the single distinguished entry. -/

decl_483.name: FTC.Hardness.extendedClients
decl_483.label: Hardness.extendedClients
decl_483.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_483.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq X] → Finset X → Finset (Option X)
decl_483.source:
def extendedClients (P : Finset X) : Finset (Option X) :=
  insert none (P.map oldPoint)

decl_516.source:
@[simp] theorem none_mem_extendedClients (P : Finset X) : none ∈ extendedClients P := by

decl_484.name: FTC.Hardness.extendedClients_card
decl_484.label: Hardness.extendedClients_card
decl_484.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_484.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [MetricSpace X] (P : Finset X),
  (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P).card = P.card + 1
decl_484.source:
@[simp] theorem extendedClients_card (P : Finset X) : (extendedClients P).card = P.card + 1 := by
  simp [extendedClients, Finset.mem_map]

decl_498.name: FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution
decl_498.label: Hardness.gadgetContribution
decl_498.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_498.statement: {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → Option X → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k → ℝ
decl_498.source:
noncomputable def gadgetContribution (D L : ℝ) : Option X → CenterSet (Option X) k → ℝ
  | none, C => extensionLoss D none C
  | some x, C => L * extensionLoss D (some x) C

decl_500.name: FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution_nonneg
decl_500.label: Hardness.gadgetContribution_nonneg
decl_500.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_500.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L → ∀ (i : Option X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet (Option X) k), 0 ≤ FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D L i C
decl_500.source:
theorem gadgetContribution_nonneg (D : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∀ i (C : CenterSet (Option X) k), 0 ≤ gadgetContribution D L i C := by
  intro i C
  cases i
  · exact extensionLoss_nonneg D none C
  · exact mul_nonneg hL (extensionLoss_nonneg D _ C)

decl_502.name: FTC.Hardness.gadgetEntries
decl_502.label: Hardness.gadgetEntries
decl_502.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_502.statement: {X : Type u_1} → (L : ℝ) → 0 ≤ L → Option X → FTC.Entry (Option X)

decl_499.name: FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss
decl_499.label: Hardness.gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss
decl_499.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_499.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hdiam : ∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ D)
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L),
  FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D L = FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss (FTC.Hardness.gadgetEntries L hL)
decl_499.source:
theorem gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    gadgetContribution (X := X) (k := k) D L = weightedLoss (gadgetEntries L hL) := by
  letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
  funext i C
  cases i <;> simp only [gadgetContribution, weightedLoss, contribution, gadgetEntries, one_mul]
  all_goals rfl

decl_501.name: FTC.Hardness.gadgetCost_lift
decl_501.label: Hardness.gadgetCost_lift
decl_501.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/MetricExtension.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_501.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X) (D L : ℝ)
  (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.cost (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D L) (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) (FTC.Hardness.liftCenters C) =
    D ^ 2 + L * FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P C
decl_501.source:
@[simp] theorem gadgetCost_lift (P : Finset X) (D L : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    cost (gadgetContribution D L) (extendedClients P) (liftCenters C) =
      D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P C := by
  simp [cost, extendedClients, Finset.sum_insert, Finset.mem_map,
    gadgetContribution, Finset.sum_map, ← Finset.mul_sum]

end FTC.Hardness

decl_428.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational_le_numerator
decl_428.label: Hardness.Encoding.rational_le_numerator
decl_428.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_428.source:
theorem rational_le_numerator (q : RatData) : rational q ≤ (q.1 : ℚ) := by
  unfold rational
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (q.2 : ℚ) + 1)).mpr
  have h := mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ q.1 by positivity)
    (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ q.2 by positivity)
  nlinarith

decl_372.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase
decl_372.label: Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase
decl_372.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_372.source:
structure ValidBase (b : BaseData) : Prop where
  square : ∀ row ∈ b.1, row.length = pointCount b
  clients_length : b.2.1.length = pointCount b
  self : ∀ x, matrixDistance b.1 x x = 0
  comm : ∀ x y, matrixDistance b.1 x y = matrixDistance b.1 y x
  triangle : ∀ x y z, matrixDistance b.1 x z ≤ matrixDistance b.1 x y + matrixDistance b.1 y z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ x y, matrixDistance b.1 x y = 0 → x = y
  centers_pos : 0 < centerCount b
  centers_le : centerCount b ≤ pointCount b

decl_374.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase.metric
decl_374.label: Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase.metric
decl_374.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_374.source:
def ValidBase.metric {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b) : RationalMetric (Fin (pointCount b)) where
  distance := matrixDistance b.1
  self := h.self
  comm := h.comm
  triangle := h.triangle
  eq_of_zero := h.eq_of_zero

decl_383.source:
def clients (b : BaseData) : Finset (Fin (pointCount b)) :=

decl_373.source:
theorem ValidBase.centers_le_card {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b) :
    centerCount b ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (pointCount b)) := by simpa using h.centers_le

decl_418.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.matrixDistance_le_radius
decl_418.label: Hardness.Encoding.matrixDistance_le_radius
decl_418.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_418.statement:
∀ {b : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.BaseData},
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase b →
    ∀ (i j : Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount b)),
      FTC.Hardness.Encoding.matrixDistance b.1 i j ≤ ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radius b)
decl_418.source:
theorem matrixDistance_le_radius {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b)
    (i j : Fin (pointCount b)) : matrixDistance b.1 i j ≤ (radius b : ℚ) := by
  have hrow : b.1.getD i [] ∈ b.1 := by
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ i.isLt]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  have hlen := h.square _ hrow
  have hj : (j : ℕ) < (b.1.getD i []).length := hlen.symm ▸ j.isLt
  have hentry : (b.1.getD i []).getD j (0, 0) ∈ b.1.flatten := by
    apply List.mem_flatten.mpr
    refine ⟨b.1.getD i [], hrow, ?_⟩
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  have hnum := le_maximum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Prod.fst) hentry)
  calc
    matrixDistance b.1 i j ≤ (((b.1.getD i []).getD j (0, 0)).1 : ℚ) :=
      rational_le_numerator _
    _ ≤ (maximum (b.1.flatten.map Prod.fst) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hnum
    _ ≤ (radius b : ℚ) := by unfold radius; push_cast; linarith

decl_445.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight
decl_445.label: Hardness.Encoding.weight
decl_445.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_445.source:
def weight (c D : ℕ) (B : RatData) : RatData :=
  (c * D ^ 2 * (B.2 + 1), B.1 - 1)

decl_447.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight_pos
decl_447.label: Hardness.Encoding.weight_pos
decl_447.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_447.statement: ∀ {c D : ℕ}, 0 < c → 0 < D → ∀ {B : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatData}, 0 < B.1 → 0 < (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight c D B).1
decl_447.source:
theorem weight_pos {c D : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 < D)
    {B : RatData} (hB : 0 < B.1) : 0 < (weight c D B).1 := by
  dsimp [weight]
  positivity

decl_448.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight_value
decl_448.label: Hardness.Encoding.weight_value
decl_448.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_448.statement:
∀ (c D : ℕ) (B : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.RatData),
  0 < B.1 →
    ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight c D B)) =
      FTC.Hardness.amplification c ↑D ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational B)
decl_448.source:
theorem weight_value (c D : ℕ) (B : RatData) (hB : 0 < B.1) :
    (rational (weight c D B) : ℝ) = amplification c (D : ℝ) (rational B : ℝ) := by
  have hsub : B.1 - 1 + 1 = B.1 := Nat.sub_add_cancel hB
  have hnum : (B.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hB)
  have hden : (B.2 : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsubR : ((B.1 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (B.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsub
  simp only [rational, weight, amplification, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_add,
    Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hsubR]
  push_cast
  field_simp

/-- The complete raw transformation. It is defined even on malformed inputs;
the correctness proof uses only the source promise. -/

decl_435.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce_valid

decl_379.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget.real_radius_bound

decl_379.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_379.statement:
∀ {x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData} (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x)
  (i j : Fin (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.pointCount x.1)), dist i j ≤ ↑x.2.1
decl_379.source:
theorem ValidTarget.real_radius_bound {x : TargetData} (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    ∀ i j : Fin (pointCount x.1), dist i j ≤ (x.2.1 : ℝ) := by

decl_442.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity
decl_442.label: Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity
decl_442.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_442.source:
noncomputable def targetSensitivity (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) : ℝ :=
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := extensionMetric (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos h.real_radius_bound
  sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := centerCount x.1)
    (gadgetEntries (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) (real_weight_nonneg x.2.2)))
    (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none

decl_443.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity_eq_gadget
decl_443.label: Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity_eq_gadget
decl_443.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_443.statement:
∀ (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.TargetData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget x),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity x h =
    FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution ↑x.2.1 ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2.2))
      (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.clients x.1)) none
decl_443.source:
theorem targetSensitivity_eq_gadget (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    targetSensitivity x h =
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
        (x.2.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2.2 : ℝ)) (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold targetSensitivity
  rw [← gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos
    h.real_radius_bound (real_weight_nonneg x.2.2)]

decl_434.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce_sensitivity_formula
decl_434.label: Hardness.Encoding.reduce_sensitivity_formula
decl_434.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_434.statement:
∀ {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.SourceData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidSource x),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce c x) ⋯ =
    ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2) /
      (↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2) + ↑c * FTC.Hardness.Encoding.originalOptimum x.1 ⋯)
decl_434.source:
theorem reduce_sensitivity_formula {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : SourceData) (h : ValidSource x) :
    targetSensitivity (reduce c x) (reduce_valid hc h) =
      (rational x.2 : ℝ) / ((rational x.2 : ℝ) + (c : ℝ) * originalOptimum x.1 h.base) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [targetSensitivity_eq_gadget]
  change sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
    (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational (weight c (radius x.1) x.2) : ℝ))
      (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none = _
  rw [weight_value c (radius x.1) x.2 h.budget_pos]
  exact amplified_sensitivity_formula (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
    (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1) (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hc

decl_433.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget
decl_433.label: Hardness.Encoding.reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget
decl_433.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_433.statement:
∀ {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.SourceData) (h : FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidSource x),
  FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce c x) ⋯ =
    FTC.sensitivity
      (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution (↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radius x.1))
        (FTC.Hardness.amplification c ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radius x.1) ↑(FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational x.2)))
      (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients (FTC.Hardness.Encoding.clients x.1)) none
decl_433.source:
theorem reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (x : SourceData) (h : ValidSource x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    targetSensitivity (reduce c x) (reduce_valid hc h) =
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1) (radius x.1 : ℝ)
        (amplification c (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2 : ℝ)))
        (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [targetSensitivity_eq_gadget]
  change sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
    (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational (weight c (radius x.1) x.2) : ℝ))
      (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none = _
  rw [weight_value c (radius x.1) x.2 h.budget_pos]

decl_438.name: FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reductionCode_polynomial
decl_438.label: Hardness.Encoding.reductionCode_polynomial
decl_438.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/RationalEncoding.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_438.source:
theorem reductionCode_polynomial (c : ℕ) : (reductionCode c).IsPoly := by
  unfold reductionCode weightCode sourceRadiusCode radiusCode
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | apply Code.IsPoly.map
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_flatten
    | exact Code.poly_maximum
    | exact Code.poly_add
    | exact Code.poly_mul
    | exact Code.poly_sub

decl_480.name: FTC.Hardness.centerSet_nonempty
decl_480.label: Hardness.centerSet_nonempty
decl_480.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_480.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : Fintype X] [MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ},
  0 < k → k ≤ Fintype.card X → Nonempty (FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k)
decl_480.source:
theorem centerSet_nonempty (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    Nonempty (CenterSet X k) := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (show k ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset X).card by simpa using hkX)
  exact ⟨⟨C, hC, Finset.card_pos.mp (hC ▸ hk)⟩⟩

decl_482.name: FTC.Hardness.exists_optimalCenters
decl_482.label: Hardness.exists_optimalCenters
decl_482.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_482.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X),
  0 < k →
    k ≤ Fintype.card X →
      ∃ C,
        ∀ (E : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
          FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P C ≤ FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P E
decl_482.source:
theorem exists_optimalCenters (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    ∃ C : CenterSet X k, ∀ E : CenterSet X k, cost kmeansLoss P C ≤ cost kmeansLoss P E := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (CenterSet X k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Nonempty (CenterSet X k) := centerSet_nonempty hk hkX
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image
    (Finset.univ : Finset (CenterSet X k)) (cost kmeansLoss P) Finset.univ_nonempty
  exact ⟨C, fun E => hC E (Finset.mem_univ E)⟩

decl_522.name: FTC.Hardness.optimalCenters
decl_522.label: Hardness.optimalCenters
decl_522.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_522.statement:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq X] →
    [inst : Fintype X] →
      [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → Finset X → 0 < k → k ≤ Fintype.card X → FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k
decl_522.source:
noncomputable def optimalCenters (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    CenterSet X k := (exists_optimalCenters P hk hkX).choose

decl_523.name: FTC.Hardness.optimum
decl_523.label: Hardness.optimum
decl_523.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_523.statement:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq X] → [inst : Fintype X] → [MetricSpace X] → {k : ℕ} → Finset X → 0 < k → k ≤ Fintype.card X → ℝ
decl_523.source:
noncomputable def optimum (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) : ℝ :=
  cost kmeansLoss P (optimalCenters P hk hkX)

decl_525.label: Hardness.optimum_nonneg
decl_525.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_525.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X), 0 ≤ FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX

theorem optimum_nonneg (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :

decl_524.name: FTC.Hardness.optimum_le
decl_524.label: Hardness.optimum_le
decl_524.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_524.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) (C : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
  FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX ≤ FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P C
