theorem optimum_le (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    (C : CenterSet X k) : optimum P hk hkX ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C :=
  (exists_optimalCenters P hk hkX).choose_spec C

/-- Exact identity, first stated with an arbitrary globally optimal center set. -/

decl_529.name: FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_eq_of_optimal
decl_529.label: Hardness.sensitivity_eq_of_optimal
decl_529.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_529.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X) (D : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    ∀ {L : ℝ},
      0 ≤ L →
        ∀ (Copt : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
          (∀ (E : FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet X k),
              FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P Copt ≤ FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P E) →
            FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D L) (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none =
              D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * FTC.cost FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss P Copt)
decl_529.source:
theorem sensitivity_eq_of_optimal (P : Finset X) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (Copt : CenterSet X k)
    (hopt : ∀ E : CenterSet X k, cost kmeansLoss P Copt ≤ cost kmeansLoss P E) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D L) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) := by
  have hD2 : 0 < D ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hD
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P Copt := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg _ _
  have hden : 0 < D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hD2 (mul_nonneg hL hc)
  have hr : 0 ≤ D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) :=
    div_nonneg hD2.le hden.le
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL)
      (none_mem_extendedClients P) hr
    intro C
    by_cases hnew : none ∈ C.centers
    · simp only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_of_mem D C hnew]
      exact mul_nonneg hr (cost_nonneg (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL) _ _)
    · rw [← lift_lowerCenters C hnew]
      simp only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_lift, gadgetCost_lift]
      calc
        D ^ 2 = (D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt)) *
            (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) :=
          (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne').symm
        _ ≤ (D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt)) *
            (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P (lowerCenters C hnew)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hopt _) hL) _) hr
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    have h := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL)
      (none_mem_extendedClients P) (liftCenters Copt)
    simpa only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_lift, gadgetCost_lift] using h

/-- The exact identity claimed in the proof of Theorem 4.2. -/

decl_530.name: FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_formula
decl_530.label: Hardness.sensitivity_formula
decl_530.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Hardness/SensitivityFormula.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_530.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) (D : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    ∀ {L : ℝ},
      0 ≤ L →
        FTC.sensitivity (FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution D L) (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P) none =
          D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX)
decl_530.source:
theorem sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D L) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * optimum P hk hkX) :=
  sensitivity_eq_of_optimal P D hD hL (optimalCenters P hk hkX)
    (optimum_le P hk hkX)

/-- The same identity for the project's actual weighted metric k-means API. -/

decl_540.name: FTC.Hardness.weighted_sensitivity_formula
decl_540.label: Exact hardness-instance sensitivity
decl_540.summary: Computes the exact sensitivity in the hardness construction.
decl_540.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq X] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [inst_2 : MetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (P : Finset X)
  (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hdiam : ∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L),
  FTC.sensitivity (FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss (FTC.Hardness.gadgetEntries L hL)) (FTC.Hardness.extendedClients P)
      none =
    D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * FTC.Hardness.optimum P hk hkX)
decl_540.source:
theorem weighted_sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) (gadgetEntries L hL)) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * optimum P hk hkX) := by
  rw [← gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss D hD hdiam hL]
  exact sensitivity_formula P hk hkX D hD hL

end FTC.Hardness

decl_545.name: FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace
decl_545.label: LowerBound.BasisSpace
decl_545.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_545.source:
abbrev BasisSpace (k : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)

/-- The standard basis vector `e_i`. -/

decl_548.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint
decl_548.label: LowerBound.basisPoint
decl_548.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_548.source:
noncomputable def basisPoint {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : BasisSpace k :=
  EuclideanSpace.single i 1

decl_549.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_apply
decl_549.label: LowerBound.basisPoint_apply
decl_549.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_549.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k), (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint i).ofLp j = if j = i then 1 else 0
decl_549.source:
@[simp] theorem basisPoint_apply {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k) :
    basisPoint i j = if j = i then 1 else 0 := by
  simp [basisPoint, PiLp.single_apply]

decl_551.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_ne_zero
decl_551.label: LowerBound.basisPoint_ne_zero
decl_551.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_551.source:
@[simp] theorem basisPoint_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : basisPoint i ≠ 0 := by
  simp [basisPoint]

decl_550.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_injective
decl_550.label: LowerBound.basisPoint_injective
decl_550.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_550.source:
theorem basisPoint_injective {k : ℕ} : Function.Injective (@basisPoint k) := by
  intro i j h
  have h' := congrArg (fun x : BasisSpace k => x i) h
  by_contra hij
  simpa [basisPoint_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij] using h'

decl_567.name: FTC.LowerBound.norm_basisPoint
decl_567.label: LowerBound.norm_basisPoint
decl_567.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_567.source:
@[simp] theorem norm_basisPoint {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : ‖basisPoint i‖ = 1 := by
  simp [basisPoint]

decl_559.name: FTC.LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_zero_sq
decl_559.label: LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_zero_sq
decl_559.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_559.source:
@[simp] theorem dist_basisPoint_zero_sq {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    dist (basisPoint i) 0 ^ 2 = 1 := by
  simp

decl_558.name: FTC.LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne
decl_558.label: LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne
decl_558.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_558.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k}, i ≠ j → dist (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint i) (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint j) ^ 2 = 2
decl_558.source:
theorem dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k} (h : i ≠ j) :
    dist (basisPoint i) (basisPoint j) ^ 2 = 2 := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_sq_real]
  norm_num [basisPoint, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, h]

/-- A genuine `k`-point Euclidean center set. -/

decl_546.name: FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery
decl_546.label: LowerBound.EuclideanQuery
decl_546.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_546.source:
structure EuclideanQuery (k : ℕ) where
  centers : Finset (BasisSpace k)
  card_centers : centers.card = k
  nonempty : centers.Nonempty

/-- Squared distance to the closest center, the Euclidean `k`-means loss. -/

decl_569.name: FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters
decl_569.label: LowerBound.sqDistToCenters
decl_569.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_569.statement: {k : ℕ} → FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k → FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery k → ℝ
decl_569.source:
noncomputable def sqDistToCenters {k : ℕ} (x : BasisSpace k) (S : EuclideanQuery k) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact S.centers.inf' S.nonempty (fun y => dist x y ^ 2)

decl_570.name: FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters_nonneg
decl_570.label: LowerBound.sqDistToCenters_nonneg
decl_570.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_570.statement:
∀ {k : ℕ} (x : FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k) (S : FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery k),
  0 ≤ FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters x S
decl_570.source:
theorem sqDistToCenters_nonneg {k : ℕ} (x : BasisSpace k) (S : EuclideanQuery k) :
    0 ≤ sqDistToCenters x S := by
  classical
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro y _
  exact sq_nonneg _

/-- The query `{e_j : j ≠ i} ∪ {0}` used in Claim A.2. -/

decl_577.name: FTC.LowerBound.witnessCenters
decl_577.label: LowerBound.witnessCenters
decl_577.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_577.source:
noncomputable def witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : Finset (BasisSpace k) := by
  classical
  exact insert 0 ((Finset.univ.erase i).image basisPoint)

decl_583.name: FTC.LowerBound.zero_mem_witnessCenters
decl_583.label: LowerBound.zero_mem_witnessCenters
decl_583.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_583.source:
@[simp] theorem zero_mem_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    (0 : BasisSpace k) ∈ witnessCenters i := by
  classical
  simp [witnessCenters]

decl_566.name: FTC.LowerBound.mem_witnessCenters
decl_566.label: LowerBound.mem_witnessCenters
decl_566.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_566.statement:
∀ {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k),
  x ∈ FTC.LowerBound.witnessCenters i ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ i ∧ FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint j = x
decl_566.source:
@[simp] theorem mem_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : BasisSpace k) :
    x ∈ witnessCenters i ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin k, j ≠ i ∧ basisPoint j = x := by
  classical
  simp [witnessCenters, Finset.mem_image]

decl_554.name: FTC.LowerBound.card_witnessCenters
decl_554.label: LowerBound.card_witnessCenters
decl_554.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_554.source:
@[simp] theorem card_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    (witnessCenters i).card = k := by
  classical
  have hz : (0 : BasisSpace k) ∉ (Finset.univ.erase i).image basisPoint := by
    simp [Finset.mem_image]
  rw [witnessCenters, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hz,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ basisPoint_injective]
  simpa using Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ i)

decl_578.name: FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery
decl_578.label: LowerBound.witnessQuery
decl_578.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_578.source:
noncomputable def witnessQuery {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : EuclideanQuery k where
  centers := witnessCenters i
  card_centers := card_witnessCenters i
  nonempty := ⟨0, zero_mem_witnessCenters i⟩

/-- The separating query charges exactly one unit at its omitted basis vector. -/

decl_565.name: FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_same
decl_565.label: LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_same
decl_565.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_565.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k), FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint i) (FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery i) = 1
decl_565.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery_same {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint i) (witnessQuery i) = 1 := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Finset.inf'_le (fun y : BasisSpace k => dist (basisPoint i) y ^ 2)
      (zero_mem_witnessCenters i)).trans_eq (dist_basisPoint_zero_sq i)
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro y hy
    rcases (mem_witnessCenters i y).1 hy with rfl | ⟨j, hji, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · rw [dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne (Ne.symm hji)]
      norm_num

/-- Every other basis vector is itself a center and has zero loss. -/

decl_564.name: FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_other
decl_564.label: LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_other
decl_564.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_564.statement:
∀ {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k},
  j ≠ i → FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint j) (FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery i) = 0
decl_564.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery_other {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k} (hji : j ≠ i) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) (witnessQuery i) = 0 := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hmem : basisPoint j ∈ witnessCenters i :=
      (mem_witnessCenters i (basisPoint j)).2 (Or.inr ⟨j, hji, rfl⟩)
    change (witnessCenters i).inf' _ (fun y => dist (basisPoint j) y ^ 2) ≤ 0
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (basisPoint j) (basisPoint j) ^ 2 := Finset.inf'_le _ hmem
      _ = 0 := by simp
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro y _
    exact sq_nonneg _

decl_563.name: FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery
decl_563.label: LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery
decl_563.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_563.statement:
∀ {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k),
  FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters (FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint j) (FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery i) = if j = i then 1 else 0
decl_563.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) (witnessQuery i) = if j = i then 1 else 0 := by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst j
    exact loss_witnessQuery_same i
  · exact loss_witnessQuery_other h

/-- Unweighted cost of the basis input `P = {e_1, …, e_k}`. -/

decl_552.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost
decl_552.label: LowerBound.basisReferenceCost
decl_552.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_552.source:
noncomputable def basisReferenceCost {k : ℕ} (S : EuclideanQuery k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin k, sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) S

/-- Cost of a separately indexed weighted summary supported on the basis input. -/

decl_571.name: FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost
decl_571.label: LowerBound.supportedCost
decl_571.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_571.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq I] → {k : ℕ} → Finset I → (I → Fin k) → (I → ℝ) → FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery k → ℝ

decl_553.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost_witness
decl_553.label: LowerBound.basisReferenceCost_witness
decl_553.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_553.source:
@[simp] theorem basisReferenceCost_witness {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    basisReferenceCost (witnessQuery i) = 1 := by
  simp [basisReferenceCost, loss_witnessQuery]

/-- The witness query reads exactly the total weight at its omitted coordinate. -/

decl_572.name: FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost_witness
decl_572.label: LowerBound.supportedCost_witness
decl_572.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/BasisInstance.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_572.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ) (i : Fin k),
  FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost Q loc a (FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery i) = ∑ j ∈ Q with loc j = i, a j
decl_572.source:
@[simp] theorem supportedCost_witness {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    supportedCost Q loc a (witnessQuery i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j := by
  classical
  simp [supportedCost, loss_witnessQuery, Finset.sum_filter, mul_ite]

/-- Claim A.2: any Euclidean `k`-means coreset supported on the basis input
approximately preserves the total weight at each coordinate. -/

decl_576.name: FTC.LowerBound.weight_preservation
decl_576.label: Claim A.2 · Weight preservation
decl_576.summary: Claim A.2: Euclidean basis queries force preservation of stored weights.
decl_576.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ),
  (∀ (S : FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery k),
      (1 - ε) * FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost S ≤ FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost Q loc a S ∧
        FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost Q loc a S ≤ (1 + ε) * FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost S) →
    ∀ (i : Fin k), 1 - ε ≤ ∑ j ∈ Q with loc j = i, a j ∧ ∑ j ∈ Q with loc j = i, a j ≤ 1 + ε
decl_576.source:
theorem weight_preservation {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    {ε : ℝ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
      (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤ supportedCost Q loc a S ∧
      supportedCost Q loc a S ≤ (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S) (i : Fin k) :
    1 - ε ≤ ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j ∧
      (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  simpa only [basisReferenceCost_witness, supportedCost_witness, mul_one]
    using h (witnessQuery i)

end FTC.LowerBound

decl_555.name: FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight
decl_555.label: LowerBound.coordinateWeight
decl_555.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_555.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {k : ℕ} → Finset I → (I → ℝ) → (I → Fin k) → Fin k → ℝ
decl_555.source:
def coordinateWeight (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (i : Fin k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j

/-- Corrupt exactly the indices in `J` by replacing their weight by zero. -/

decl_579.name: FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights
decl_579.label: LowerBound.zeroWeights
decl_579.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_579.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq I] → (I → ℝ) → Finset I → I → ℝ
decl_579.source:
def zeroWeights (a : I → ℝ) (J : Finset I) (j : I) : ℝ :=
  if j ∈ J then 0 else a j

decl_581.name: FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_mem
decl_581.label: LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_mem
decl_581.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_581.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I}, j ∈ J → FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights a J j = 0
decl_581.source:
@[simp] theorem zeroWeights_of_mem (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I}
    (hj : j ∈ J) : zeroWeights a J j = 0 := by simp [zeroWeights, hj]

decl_582.name: FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_notMem
decl_582.label: LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_notMem
decl_582.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_582.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I},
  j ∉ J → FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights a J j = a j
decl_582.source:
@[simp] theorem zeroWeights_of_notMem (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I}
    (hj : j ∉ J) : zeroWeights a J j = a j := by simp [zeroWeights, hj]

decl_580.name: FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_nonneg
decl_580.label: LowerBound.zeroWeights_nonneg
decl_580.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_580.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] {a : I → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : I), 0 ≤ a j) → ∀ (J : Finset I) (j : I), 0 ≤ FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights a J j
decl_580.source:
theorem zeroWeights_nonneg {a : I → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (J : Finset I) (j : I) : 0 ≤ zeroWeights a J j := by
  unfold zeroWeights
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact ha j

decl_556.name: FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight_mono
decl_556.label: LowerBound.coordinateWeight_mono
decl_556.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_556.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} {Q R : Finset I} {a : I → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : I), 0 ≤ a j) →
    ∀ (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k),
      R ⊆ Q → FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight R a loc i ≤ FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight Q a loc i
decl_556.source:
theorem coordinateWeight_mono {Q R : Finset I} {a : I → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (hRQ : R ⊆ Q) :
    coordinateWeight R a loc i ≤ coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · exact Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hRQ
  · intro j _ _
    exact ha j

/-- The weights outside the corrupted set are unchanged. -/

decl_557.name: FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight_zeroWeights
decl_557.label: LowerBound.coordinateWeight_zeroWeights
decl_557.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_557.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k) {J : Finset I},
  J ⊆ {j ∈ Q | loc j = i} →
    FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight Q (FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights a J) loc i =
      FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight Q a loc i - ∑ j ∈ J, a j
decl_557.source:
theorem coordinateWeight_zeroWeights (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ)
    (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k) {J : Finset I}
    (hJ : J ⊆ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) :
    coordinateWeight Q (zeroWeights a J) loc i =
      coordinateWeight Q a loc i - ∑ j ∈ J, a j := by
  classical
  have hz : (∑ j ∈ J, zeroWeights a J j) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact zeroWeights_of_mem a hj
  have hpart := Finset.sum_sdiff hJ (f := zeroWeights a J)
  have hpartA := Finset.sum_sdiff hJ (f := a)
  unfold coordinateWeight
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), zeroWeights a J j) =
        ∑ j ∈ (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) \ J, a j := by
      rw [← hpart, hz, add_zero]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact zeroWeights_of_notMem a (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j) - ∑ j ∈ J, a j := by
      linarith

/-- If the total number of copies is below `f*k/(2 ε)`, some bin is below
`f/(2 ε)`. This includes the empty-bin case. -/

decl_562.name: FTC.LowerBound.exists_small_bin
decl_562.label: LowerBound.exists_small_bin
decl_562.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_562.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε → ↑Q.card < ↑f * ↑k / (2 * ε) → ∃ i, ↑{j ∈ Q | loc j = i}.card < ↑f / (2 * ε)
decl_562.source:
theorem exists_small_bin (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (_hε : 0 < ε)
    (hsmall : (Q.card : ℝ) < (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε)) :
    ∃ i : Fin k, ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ) <
      (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε) := by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  have hcount : (∑ i : Fin k, (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card) = Q.card := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter Q Finset.univ loc
  have hcountR : (∑ i : Fin k, ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ)) =
      (Q.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcount
  have hle := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)))
    (f := fun _ => (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε))
    (g := fun i => ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ))
    (fun i _ => h i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hle
  rw [hcountR] at hle
  have heq : (k : ℝ) * ((f : ℝ) / (2 * ε)) =
      (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) := by ring
  linarith

/-- Quantitative form of the lower bound. The robustness assumption only asks
for the necessary coordinate lower bounds after zeroing corruptions; it is
therefore weaker than successful filtering into an ε-coreset. -/

decl_568.name: FTC.LowerBound.quantitative_filtering_lower_bound
decl_568.label: LowerBound.quantitative_filtering_lower_bound
decl_568.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/Combinatorial.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_568.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k),
  (∀ (j : I), 0 ≤ a j) →
    ∀ (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        ε < 1 / 2 →
          (∀ (i : Fin k),
              1 - ε ≤ FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight Q a loc i ∧ FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight Q a loc i ≤ 1 + ε) →
            (∀ J ⊆ Q,
                J.card ≤ f →
                  ∃ R ⊆ Q,
                    ∀ (i : Fin k), 1 - ε ≤ FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight R (FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights a J) loc i) →
              ↑f * ↑k / (2 * ε) ≤ ↑Q.card
decl_568.source:
theorem quantitative_filtering_lower_bound
    (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hclean : ∀ i : Fin k,
      1 - ε ≤ coordinateWeight Q a loc i ∧ coordinateWeight Q a loc i ≤ 1 + ε)
    (hrobust : ∀ J ⊆ Q, J.card ≤ f →
      ∃ R ⊆ Q, ∀ i : Fin k,
        1 - ε ≤ coordinateWeight R (zeroWeights a J) loc i) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  by_contra! hsmall
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_small_bin Q loc f ε hε hsmall
  have hA : 0 < coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
    have := (hclean i).1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hJf, hmass⟩ :=
    exists_destructive_subset (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) a f ε hε hεhalf hA hi
  have hJQ : J ⊆ Q := fun j hj => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hJ hj)).1
  obtain ⟨R, hRQ, hR⟩ := hrobust J hJQ hJf
  have hmono := coordinateWeight_mono (zeroWeights_nonneg ha J) loc i hRQ
  have hzero := coordinateWeight_zeroWeights Q a loc i hJ
  have hAupper := (hclean i).2
  have hRlower := hR i
  have hstrict : coordinateWeight Q (zeroWeights a J) loc i <
      (1 - 2 * ε) * coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
    rw [hzero]
    change 2 * ε * coordinateWeight Q a loc i < _ at hmass
    linarith
  have hproduct : (1 - 2 * ε) * coordinateWeight Q a loc i ≤
      (1 - 2 * ε) * (1 + ε) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAupper
    linarith
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hε]

end FTC.LowerBound

decl_561.name: FTC.LowerBound.exists_largest_weights
decl_561.label: LowerBound.exists_largest_weights
decl_561.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/LargestWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_561.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ),
  ∀ f ≤ s.card, ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card = f ∧ ↑f * ∑ i ∈ s, a i ≤ ↑s.card * ∑ i ∈ t, a i
decl_561.source:
theorem exists_largest_weights (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (f : ℕ)
    (hf : f ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card = f ∧
      (f : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ t, a i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmax⟩ :=
    (s.powersetCard f).exists_max_image (fun t => ∑ i ∈ t, a i)
      (Finset.powersetCard_nonempty.mpr hf)
  obtain ⟨hts, htf⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ s \ t, a y ≤ a x := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hys : y ∈ s := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).1
    have hyt : y ∉ t := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).2
    have hyerase : y ∉ t.erase x := by
      exact fun h => hyt (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
    have hsub : insert y (t.erase x) ⊆ s := by
      intro z hz
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hys
      · exact hts (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hz)
    have hcard : (insert y (t.erase x)).card = f := by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyerase, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx]
      have : 0 < t.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩
      omega
    have hle := hmax (insert y (t.erase x))
      (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨hsub, hcard⟩)
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hyerase] at hle
    have herase := Finset.sum_erase_add t a hx
    linarith
  have hcross : (t.card : ℝ) * (∑ y ∈ s \ t, a y) ≤
      ((s \ t).card : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by
    calc
      (t.card : ℝ) * (∑ y ∈ s \ t, a y) =
          ∑ y ∈ s \ t, (t.card : ℝ) * a y := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ s \ t, ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro y hy
        calc
          (t.card : ℝ) * a y = ∑ x ∈ t, a y := by simp
          _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, a x := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => horder x hx y hy)
      _ = ((s \ t).card : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by simp
  have hsum := Finset.sum_sdiff hts (f := a)
  have hcard := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hts
  have hcardR : ((s \ t).card : ℝ) + (t.card : ℝ) = (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  refine ⟨t, hts, htf, ?_⟩
  rw [← htf, ← hsum, ← hcardR]
  nlinarith

/-- The precise mass-removal inequality used in the paper: if the number of
copies is less than `f / (2 ε)`, at most `f` entries remove more than a
`2 ε` fraction of their total weight. -/

decl_560.name: FTC.LowerBound.exists_destructive_subset
decl_560.label: LowerBound.exists_destructive_subset
decl_560.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/LargestWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_560.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, a i → ↑s.card < ↑f / (2 * ε) → ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card ≤ f ∧ 2 * ε * ∑ i ∈ s, a i < ∑ i ∈ t, a i
decl_560.source:
theorem exists_destructive_subset (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hA : 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, a i)
    (hsmall : (s.card : ℝ) < (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε)) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card ≤ f ∧
      2 * ε * (∑ i ∈ s, a i) < ∑ i ∈ t, a i := by
  by_cases hsf : s.card ≤ f
  · refine ⟨s, Finset.Subset.refl s, hsf, ?_⟩
    nlinarith
  · have hfs : f ≤ s.card := by omega
    obtain ⟨t, hts, htf, hmass⟩ := exists_largest_weights s a f hfs
    have hsmall' : (s.card : ℝ) * (2 * ε) < (f : ℝ) :=
      (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hsmall
    have hcardpos : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
      have hs : 0 < s.card := by
        by_contra h
        have : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
        simp [this] at hA
      exact_mod_cast hs
    refine ⟨t, hts, htf.le, ?_⟩
    have hstrict := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall' hA
    nlinarith

end FTC.LowerBound

decl_547.name: FTC.LowerBound.basisEntries
decl_547.label: LowerBound.basisEntries
decl_547.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/LowerBound.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_547.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {k : ℕ} → (I → Fin k) → (a : I → ℝ) → (∀ (j : I), 0 ≤ a j) → I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k)
decl_547.source:
noncomputable def basisEntries (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (j : I) : FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k) where
  point := basisPoint (loc j)
  weight := a j
  weight_nonneg := ha j

/-- The explicit quantitative bound established by the proof of Theorem 3.4.
It holds for each successful coreset realization, independent of any
randomization used in constructing that realization. -/

decl_573.name: FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4
decl_573.label: LowerBound.theorem_3_4
decl_573.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/LowerBound.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_573.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ) (ha : ∀ (j : I), 0 ≤ a j)
  (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k)) → Finset I) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    ε < 1 / 2 →
      FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters Q
          (FTC.LowerBound.basisEntries loc a ha) decoder →
        ↑f * ↑k / (2 * ε) ≤ ↑Q.card
decl_573.source:
theorem theorem_3_4
    (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q (basisEntries loc a ha) decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  apply quantitative_filtering_lower_bound Q a loc ha f ε hε hεhalf
  · intro i
    have hclean : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
        (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤ supportedCost Q loc a S ∧
        supportedCost Q loc a S ≤ (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S := by
      simpa only [FTC.IsCoreset, FTC.cost, FTC.contribution, basisEntries,
        supportedCost] using hFT.1
    exact weight_preservation Q loc a hclean i
  · intro J hJ hJf
    let corrupted := basisEntries loc (zeroWeights a J) (zeroWeights_nonneg ha J)
    have hcorrupt : FTC.IsFCorruption f Q (basisEntries loc a ha) corrupted := by
      refine ⟨J, hJ, hJf, ?_⟩
      intro j _ hjJ
      simp [corrupted, basisEntries, zeroWeights, hjJ]
    obtain ⟨hsub, hco⟩ := hFT.2 corrupted hcorrupt
    refine ⟨decoder corrupted, hsub, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hcorrect : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
        (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤
          supportedCost (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) S ∧
        supportedCost (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) S ≤
          (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S := by
      simpa only [FTC.IsCoreset, FTC.cost, FTC.contribution, corrupted,
        basisEntries, supportedCost] using hco
    exact (weight_preservation (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) hcorrect i).1

end FTC.LowerBound

namespace FTC.LowerBound

/-- The same bound for arbitrary stored entries whose active locations are
basis vectors, without requiring a canonical representation outside `Q`. -/

decl_575.name: FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4_of_supported
decl_575.label: LowerBound.theorem_3_4_of_supported
decl_575.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/LowerBound/LowerBound.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_575.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k))
  (loc : I → Fin k),
  (∀ j ∈ Q, (entries j).point = FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint (loc j)) →
    ∀ (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k)) → Finset I) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        ε < 1 / 2 →
          FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters Q entries
              decoder →
            ↑f * ↑k / (2 * ε) ≤ ↑Q.card
decl_575.source:
theorem theorem_3_4_of_supported
    {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k))
    (loc : I → Fin k)
    (hsupport : ∀ j ∈ Q, (entries j).point = basisPoint (loc j))
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q entries decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let a : I → ℝ := fun j => (entries j).weight
  have ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j := fun j => (entries j).weight_nonneg
  have hagree : ∀ j ∈ Q, basisEntries loc a ha j = entries j := by
    intro j hj
    have hp := hsupport j hj
    cases he : entries j with
    | mk p w hw =>
      simp only [he] at hp
      simp [basisEntries, a, he, hp]
  have hcost : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
      FTC.cost (FTC.contribution (@sqDistToCenters k) (basisEntries loc a ha)) Q S =
        FTC.cost (FTC.contribution (@sqDistToCenters k) entries) Q S := by
    intro S
    apply FTC.cost_congr
    intro j hj T
    unfold FTC.contribution
    rw [hagree j hj]
  have hFT' : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q (basisEntries loc a ha) decoder := by
    constructor
    · intro S
      simpa only [hcost S] using hFT.1 S
    · intro corrupted hcorrupt
      apply hFT.2 corrupted
      obtain ⟨B, hBQ, hBf, hB⟩ := hcorrupt
      refine ⟨B, hBQ, hBf, ?_⟩
      intro j hj hjB
      exact (hB j hj hjB).trans (hagree j hj)
  exact theorem_3_4 Q loc a ha decoder f ε hε hεhalf hFT'

end FTC.LowerBound

namespace FTC.LowerBound

/-- The source theorem stated using only support on `P = {e_i}`. Locations of
inactive indices are unrestricted; a coordinate label is chosen only for the
proof. The empty-dimensional case has a zero required lower bound. -/

decl_574.name: FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4_of_support
decl_574.label: Theorem 3.4 · Support lower bound
decl_574.summary: Theorem 3.4: a quantitative lower bound on stored support using weight preservation on basis queries.
decl_574.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ} (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k)),
  (∀ j ∈ Q, ∃ i, (entries j).point = FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint i) →
    ∀ (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace k)) → Finset I) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        ε < 1 / 2 →
          FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters Q entries
              decoder →
            ↑f * ↑k / (2 * ε) ≤ ↑Q.card
decl_574.source:
theorem theorem_3_4_of_support
    {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k))
    (hsupport : ∀ j ∈ Q, ∃ i : Fin k, (entries j).point = basisPoint i)
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q entries decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    simp
  · have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
    let loc : I → Fin k := fun j =>
      if hj : j ∈ Q then Classical.choose (hsupport j hj) else ⟨0, hkpos⟩
    have hloc : ∀ j ∈ Q, (entries j).point = basisPoint (loc j) := by
      intro j hj
      dsimp only [loc]
      rw [dif_pos hj]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hsupport j hj)
    exact theorem_3_4_of_supported Q entries loc hloc decoder f ε hε hεhalf hFT

end FTC.LowerBound

decl_616.name: FTC.Probability.mass_le_one
decl_616.label: Probability.mass_le_one
decl_616.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.

/-- A normalized finite probability mass function from real probabilities. -/

decl_621.name: FTC.Probability.pmfOfMass
decl_621.label: Probability.pmfOfMass
decl_621.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_621.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype J] → (q : J → ℝ) → (∀ (x : J), 0 ≤ q x) → ∑ x, q x = 1 → PMF J
decl_621.source:
noncomputable def pmfOfMass (q : J → ℝ) (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x)
    (hsum : ∑ x, q x = 1) : PMF J :=
  PMF.ofFintype (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q x)) (by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun x _ => hq x), hsum]
    simp)

decl_618.name: FTC.Probability.mass_pmfOfMass
decl_618.label: Probability.mass_pmfOfMass
decl_618.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_618.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (q : J → ℝ)
  (hq : ∀ (x : J), 0 ≤ q x) (hsum : ∑ x, q x = 1) (x : J),
  FTC.Probability.mass (FTC.Probability.pmfOfMass q hq hsum) x = q x
decl_618.source:
@[simp] theorem mass_pmfOfMass (q : J → ℝ) (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x)
    (hsum : ∑ x, q x = 1) (x : J) : mass (pmfOfMass q hq hsum) x = q x := by
  simp [mass, pmfOfMass, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hq x)]

/-- The actual law of `m` independent draws with replacement. -/

decl_603.name: FTC.Probability.iidLaw
decl_603.label: Probability.iidLaw
decl_603.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_603.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [inst : MeasurableSpace J] → PMF J → (m : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin m → J)
decl_603.source:
noncomputable def iidLaw (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) : Measure (Fin m → J) :=
  Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure

instance iidLaw_isProbabilityMeasure (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (iidLaw p m) := by
  unfold iidLaw
  infer_instance

/-- The joint mass is the product of the individual masses. -/

decl_606.name: FTC.Probability.iidLaw_singleton
decl_606.label: Probability.iidLaw_singleton
decl_606.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_606.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ)
  (sample : Fin m → J), (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) {sample} = ∏ i, p (sample i)
decl_606.source:
theorem iidLaw_singleton (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (sample : Fin m → J) :
    iidLaw p m {sample} = ∏ i, p (sample i) := by
  simp [iidLaw, Measure.pi_singleton, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton]

/-- Every coordinate has precisely the specified one-draw distribution. -/

decl_604.name: FTC.Probability.iidLaw_eval_map
decl_604.label: Probability.iidLaw_eval_map
decl_604.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_604.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ)
  (i : Fin m), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Function.eval i) (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) = p.toMeasure
decl_604.source:
theorem iidLaw_eval_map (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :
    (iidLaw p m).map (Function.eval i) = p.toMeasure := by
  exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure) i).map_eq

/-- The sample coordinates are independent for the actual product law. -/

decl_605.name: FTC.Probability.iidLaw_independent
decl_605.label: Probability.iidLaw_independent
decl_605.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_605.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ),
  ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun i => Function.eval i) (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m)
decl_605.source:
theorem iidLaw_independent (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i : Fin m => Function.eval i) (iidLaw p m) := by
  simpa [iidLaw] using
    (iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure)
      (X := fun _ : Fin m => fun x : J => x) (fun _ => measurable_id.aemeasurable))

decl_609.name: FTC.Probability.integral_hit
decl_609.label: Probability.integral_hit
decl_609.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_609.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  (x : J), ∫ (y : J), FTC.Probability.hit x y ∂p.toMeasure = FTC.Probability.mass p x
decl_609.source:
theorem integral_hit (p : PMF J) (x : J) :
    ∫ y, hit x y ∂p.toMeasure = mass p x := by
  simp [PMF.integral_eq_sum, hit, mass]

decl_634.name: FTC.Probability.variance_hit
decl_634.label: Probability.variance_hit
decl_634.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_634.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  (x : J),
  ProbabilityTheory.variance (FTC.Probability.hit x) p.toMeasure =
    FTC.Probability.mass p x * (1 - FTC.Probability.mass p x)
decl_634.source:
theorem variance_hit (p : PMF J) (x : J) :
    variance (hit x) p.toMeasure = mass p x * (1 - mass p x) := by
  rw [variance_eq_sub (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (hit x) 2 p.toMeasure)]
  have hsquare : (hit x) ^ 2 = hit x := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, hit]
    split <;> norm_num
  rw [hsquare, integral_hit]
  ring

decl_610.name: FTC.Probability.integral_iid_eval
decl_610.label: Probability.integral_iid_eval
decl_610.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_610.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ)
  (i : Fin m) (f : J → ℝ),
  ∫ (sample : Fin m → J), f (sample i) ∂FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m = ∫ (x : J), f x ∂p.toMeasure
decl_610.source:
theorem integral_iid_eval (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (f : J → ℝ) :
    ∫ sample, f (sample i) ∂iidLaw p m = ∫ x, f x ∂p.toMeasure := by
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, f x ∂((iidLaw p m).map (Function.eval i)) :=
      (integral_map (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable
        (by exact AEStronglyMeasurable.of_discrete)).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [iidLaw_eval_map]

/-- The expected count is `m p(x)`. -/

decl_599.name: FTC.Probability.histogram_expectation
decl_599.label: Probability.histogram_expectation
decl_599.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_599.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  (m : ℕ) (x : J),
  ∫ (sample : Fin m → J), FTC.Probability.histogram sample x ∂FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m = ↑m * FTC.Probability.mass p x
decl_599.source:
theorem histogram_expectation (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (x : J) :
    ∫ sample, histogram sample x ∂iidLaw p m = (m : ℝ) * mass p x := by
  unfold histogram
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite)]
  simp [integral_iid_eval, integral_hit]

/-- The binomial variance, derived from independence of the product law. -/

decl_601.name: FTC.Probability.histogram_variance
decl_601.label: Probability.histogram_variance
decl_601.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_601.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  (m : ℕ) (x : J),
  ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun sample => FTC.Probability.histogram sample x) (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) =
    ↑m * (FTC.Probability.mass p x * (1 - FTC.Probability.mass p x))
decl_601.source:
theorem histogram_variance (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (x : J) :
    variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) =
      (m : ℝ) * (mass p x * (1 - mass p x)) := by
  have hfun : (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, fun sample : Fin m → J => hit x (sample i) := by
    funext sample
    simp [histogram]
  rw [hfun, iidLaw, variance_sum_pi (fun _ =>
    (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (hit x) 2 p.toMeasure))]
  simp [variance_hit]

/-- Chebyshev's inequality for one input frequency, with computed moments. -/

decl_598.name: FTC.Probability.histogram_deviation_le
decl_598.label: Probability.histogram_deviation_le
decl_598.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_598.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ},
  0 < m →
    0 < ε →
      ∀ (x : J),
        0 < FTC.Probability.mass p x →
          (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m)
              {sample |
                ε * (↑m * FTC.Probability.mass p x) ≤
                  |FTC.Probability.histogram sample x - ↑m * FTC.Probability.mass p x|} ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (1 / FTC.Probability.mass p x / (↑m * ε ^ 2))
decl_598.source:
theorem histogram_deviation_le (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (x : J) (hx : 0 < mass p x) :
    iidLaw p m {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / mass p x) / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) := by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hthreshold : 0 < ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) := mul_pos hε (mul_pos hmR hx)
  have hcheb := meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq
    (μ := iidLaw p m) (X := fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x)
    (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) 2
      (iidLaw p m)) hthreshold
  rw [histogram_expectation] at hcheb
  have hvar : variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) ≤
      (m : ℝ) * mass p x := by
    rw [histogram_variance]
    have hq := mass_nonneg p x
    have hmq : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * mass p x := mul_nonneg hmR.le hq
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_self (1 : ℝ) hq) hmq
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) /
          (ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x)) ^ 2) := hcheb
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((m : ℝ) * mass p x) /
          (ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x)) ^ 2) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hvar (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      field_simp [hmR.ne', hε.ne', hx.ne']
      <;> ring

/-- At least one input index has a deviation at or above its tolerance. -/

decl_589.name: FTC.Probability.badHistogram
