decl_589.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_589.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq J] → PMF J → ℝ → (m : ℕ) → Set (Fin m → J)

decl_611.name: FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum
decl_611.label: Probability.inverseMassSum
decl_611.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_611.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [Fintype J] → PMF J → ℝ
decl_611.source: noncomputable def inverseMassSum (p : PMF J) : ℝ := ∑ x, 1 / mass p x

decl_612.name: FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum_nonneg
decl_612.label: Probability.inverseMassSum_nonneg
decl_612.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_612.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  (p : PMF J), 0 ≤ FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum p
decl_612.source:
theorem inverseMassSum_nonneg (p : PMF J) : 0 ≤ inverseMassSum p :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => div_nonneg (by norm_num) (mass_nonneg p x)

/-- A finite union bound, with no assumption on the number of solutions. -/

decl_590.name: FTC.Probability.badHistogram_measure_le
decl_590.label: Probability.badHistogram_measure_le
decl_590.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_590.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ},
  0 < m →
    0 < ε →
      (∀ (x : J), 0 < FTC.Probability.mass p x) →
        (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) (FTC.Probability.badHistogram p ε m) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum p / (↑m * ε ^ 2))
decl_590.source:
theorem badHistogram_measure_le (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x) :
    iidLaw p m (badHistogram p ε m) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) := by
  have hset : badHistogram p ε m = ⋃ x : J,
      {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} := by
    ext sample
    simp [badHistogram]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x, iidLaw p m {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / mass p x) / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => histogram_deviation_le p hm hε x (hp x)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun x _ =>
        div_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (mass_nonneg p x))
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (sq_nonneg ε)))]
      congr 1
      simp [inverseMassSum, Finset.sum_div]

decl_588.name: FTC.Probability.accurateHistogram_of_not_bad
decl_588.label: Probability.accurateHistogram_of_not_bad
decl_588.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_588.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} {sample : Fin m → J},
  sample ∉ FTC.Probability.badHistogram p ε m → FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram (FTC.Probability.mass p) ε sample
decl_588.source:
theorem accurateHistogram_of_not_bad (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    {sample : Fin m → J} (h : sample ∉ badHistogram p ε m) :
    AccurateHistogram (mass p) ε sample := by
  intro x
  have hn : ¬ ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
      |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x| := fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact (not_le.mp hn).le

/-- Complete ordinary coreset guarantee for the actual iid law. The finite
histogram-complement event is a measurable witness for the probability bound. -/

decl_607.name: FTC.Probability.iid_coreset_success
decl_607.label: Probability.iid_coreset_success
decl_607.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_607.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {S : Type u_2} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    0 < m →
      0 < ε →
        (∀ (x : J), 0 < FTC.Probability.mass p x) →
          FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum p / (↑m * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure →
            FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure) fun sample =>
              FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a Finset.univ)
                (FTC.cost (FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution a (FTC.Probability.mass p) m sample)
                  Finset.univ)
decl_607.source:
theorem iid_coreset_success {S : Type*} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ}
    {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x)
    (hbound : inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample => IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
        (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a (mass p) m sample) Finset.univ)) := by
  have hbad : iidLaw p m (badHistogram p ε m) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal failure :=
    (badHistogram_measure_le p hm hε hp).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound)
  refine ⟨(badHistogram p ε m)ᶜ, MeasurableSet.of_discrete, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [measure_compl MeasurableSet.of_discrete (measure_ne_top _ _), measure_univ]
    exact tsub_le_tsub_left hbad 1
  · intro sample hsample
    exact (accurateHistogram_of_not_bad p hsample).isCoreset ha hm hp

/-- A loose but explicit finite-input ordinary sample count. It works for
every larger count, so it can be used as `m_sc` in the additive construction. -/

decl_594.name: FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize
decl_594.label: Probability.fallbackSampleSize
decl_594.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_594.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [Fintype J] → PMF J → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ
decl_594.source:
noncomputable def fallbackSampleSize (p : PMF J) (ε failure : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1

decl_596.name: FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize_pos
decl_596.label: Probability.fallbackSampleSize_pos
decl_596.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_596.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  (ε failure : ℝ), 0 < FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize p ε failure
decl_596.source:
theorem fallbackSampleSize_pos (p : PMF J) (ε failure : ℝ) :
    0 < fallbackSampleSize p ε failure := Nat.zero_lt_succ _

decl_595.name: FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize_bound
decl_595.label: Probability.fallbackSampleSize_bound
decl_595.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/FiniteIID.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_595.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (p : PMF J)
  {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    0 < failure →
      FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m → FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum p / (↑m * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure
decl_595.source:
theorem fallbackSampleSize_bound (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m) :
    inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure := by
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hceil : ⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ ≤ m :=
    (Nat.le_succ _).trans hsize
  have hceilR : (⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hceil
  have hratio := (Nat.le_ceil (inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2))).trans hceilR
  have hprod := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hfailure (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).1 hratio
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hmR (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).2
  nlinarith

decl_608.name: FTC.Probability.iid_coreset_success_of_sampleSize
decl_608.label: IID coreset success bound
decl_608.summary: Proves the ordinary iid coreset success guarantee at the explicit conservative sample size.
decl_608.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {S : Type u_2} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    0 < ε →
      0 < failure →
        (∀ (x : J), 0 < FTC.Probability.mass p x) →
          FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m →
            FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure) fun sample =>
              FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a Finset.univ)
                (FTC.cost (FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution a (FTC.Probability.mass p) m sample)
                  Finset.univ)
decl_608.source:
theorem iid_coreset_success_of_sampleSize {S : Type*} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ}
    {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample => IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
        (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a (mass p) m sample) Finset.univ)) :=
  iid_coreset_success p ha ((fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize) hε hp
    (fallbackSampleSize_bound p hε hfailure hsize)

end FTC.Probability

decl_602.name: FTC.Probability.hit
decl_602.label: Probability.hit
decl_602.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_602.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq J] → J → J → ℝ
decl_602.source:
def hit (x y : J) : ℝ := if y = x then 1 else 0

/-- Number of separately indexed sampled copies of `x`, viewed as a real. -/

decl_597.name: FTC.Probability.histogram
decl_597.label: Probability.histogram
decl_597.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_597.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq J] → {m : ℕ} → (Fin m → J) → J → ℝ

decl_613.name: FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution
decl_613.label: Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution
decl_613.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_613.statement: {J : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (J → S → ℝ) → (J → ℝ) → (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → J) → Fin m → S → ℝ
decl_613.source:
noncomputable def inverseProbabilityContribution (a : J → S → ℝ)
    (q : J → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Fin m → J) (i : Fin m) (s : S) : ℝ :=
  (1 / ((m : ℝ) * q (sample i))) * a (sample i) s

/-- Every stored frequency is relatively accurate. The count form avoids a
division by `m` in the event and in its concentration proof. -/

decl_584.name: FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram
decl_584.label: Probability.AccurateHistogram
decl_584.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_584.statement: {J : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq J] → (J → ℝ) → ℝ → {m : ℕ} → (Fin m → J) → Prop
decl_584.source:
def AccurateHistogram (q : J → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → J) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * q x| ≤ ε * ((m : ℝ) * q x)

decl_600.name: FTC.Probability.histogram_nonneg
decl_600.label: Probability.histogram_nonneg
decl_600.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_600.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → J) (x : J),
  0 ≤ FTC.Probability.histogram sample x
decl_600.source:
theorem histogram_nonneg {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → J) (x : J) :
    0 ≤ histogram sample x := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  unfold hit
  split <;> norm_num

/-- Group the sample's cost by its original input index. Duplicate samples
are counted, rather than identified. -/

decl_591.name: FTC.Probability.cost_eq_histogram
decl_591.label: Probability.cost_eq_histogram
decl_591.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_591.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ}
  (sample : Fin m → J) (s : S),
  FTC.cost (FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ s =
    ∑ x, FTC.Probability.histogram sample x / (↑m * q x) * a x s
decl_591.source:
theorem cost_eq_histogram {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → J) (s : S) :
    cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ s =
      ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
  unfold cost inverseProbabilityContribution
  calc
    (∑ i, (1 / ((m : ℝ) * q (sample i))) * a (sample i) s) =
        ∑ i, ∑ x, hit x (sample i) * ((1 / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp [hit, eq_comm]
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ i, hit x (sample i) * ((1 / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      unfold histogram
      ring

decl_585.name: FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram.coefficient_bounds
decl_585.label: Probability.AccurateHistogram.coefficient_bounds
decl_585.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_585.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [Fintype J] [inst : DecidableEq J] {q : J → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {sample : Fin m → J},
  FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram q ε sample →
    0 < m →
      (∀ (x : J), 0 < q x) →
        ∀ (x : J),
          1 - ε ≤ FTC.Probability.histogram sample x / (↑m * q x) ∧
            FTC.Probability.histogram sample x / (↑m * q x) ≤ 1 + ε
decl_585.source:
theorem AccurateHistogram.coefficient_bounds {q : J → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    {sample : Fin m → J} (h : AccurateHistogram q ε sample)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) (x : J) :
    1 - ε ≤ histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x) ∧
      histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  have hD : 0 < (m : ℝ) * q x := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm) (hq x)
  have habs := abs_le.mp (h x)
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hD).2
    nlinarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hD).2
    nlinarith

/-- The histogram certificate gives a coreset for all solutions at once. -/

decl_586.name: FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram.isCoreset
decl_586.label: Probability.AccurateHistogram.isCoreset
decl_586.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/Histogram.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_586.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
  {sample : Fin m → J},
  FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram q ε sample →
    (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
      0 < m →
        (∀ (x : J), 0 < q x) →
          FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a Finset.univ)
            (FTC.cost (FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ)
decl_586.source:
theorem AccurateHistogram.isCoreset {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ}
    {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {sample : Fin m → J}
    (h : AccurateHistogram q ε sample) (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) :
    IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
      (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ) := by
  intro s
  rw [cost_eq_histogram]
  have hcoeff := h.coefficient_bounds hm hq
  constructor
  · calc
      (1 - ε) * cost a Finset.univ s = ∑ x, (1 - ε) * a x s := by
        simp [cost, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff x).1 (ha x s)
  · calc
      (∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) ≤
          ∑ x, (1 + ε) * a x s := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff x).2 (ha x s)
      _ = (1 + ε) * cost a Finset.univ s := by simp [cost, Finset.mul_sum]

end FTC.Probability

decl_624.name: FTC.Probability.positiveSupport
decl_624.label: Probability.positiveSupport
decl_624.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_624.statement: {J : Type u_1} → Finset J → (J → ℝ) → Finset J
decl_624.source:
def positiveSupport (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ) : Finset J := by
  classical
  exact P.filter fun x => 0 < score x

/-- A sample is drawn from this finite support; the underlying input index is
its subtype value. -/

decl_587.name: FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex
decl_587.label: Probability.PositiveIndex
decl_587.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_587.statement: {J : Type u_1} → Finset J → (J → ℝ) → Type (max 0 u_1)
decl_587.source:
abbrev PositiveIndex (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ) :=
  {x : J // x ∈ positiveSupport P score}

decl_622.name: FTC.Probability.positiveIndex_mem
decl_622.label: Probability.positiveIndex_mem
decl_622.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_622.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
  (x : FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score), ↑x ∈ P
decl_622.source:
theorem positiveIndex_mem {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : x.val ∈ P := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.property).1

decl_623.name: FTC.Probability.positiveIndex_score_pos
decl_623.label: Probability.positiveIndex_score_pos
decl_623.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_623.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
  (x : FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score), 0 < score ↑x
decl_623.source:
theorem positiveIndex_score_pos {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : 0 < score x.val := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.property).2

decl_631.name: FTC.Probability.score_nonneg_of_dominates
decl_631.label: Probability.score_nonneg_of_dominates
decl_631.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_631.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) → (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) → ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x
decl_631.source:
theorem score_nonneg_of_dominates {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) :
    ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x :=
  fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)

/-- Zero sensitivity/proxy score really means zero contribution, even at
zero-cost queries. -/

decl_614.name: FTC.Probability.loss_zero_of_score_zero
decl_614.label: Probability.loss_zero_of_score_zero
decl_614.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_614.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) → ∀ {x : J}, x ∈ P → score x = 0 → ∀ (s : S), a x s = 0
decl_614.source:
theorem loss_zero_of_score_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    {x : J} (hx : x ∈ P) (hzero : score x = 0) (s : S) : a x s = 0 := by
  have h := (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost ha hx s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hscore x hx) (cost_nonneg ha P s))
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at h
  exact le_antisymm h (ha x s)

/-- The zero-total case is a zero objective. No probability distribution on
an empty positive-score support needs to be constructed. -/

decl_592.name: FTC.Probability.cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero
decl_592.label: Probability.cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero
decl_592.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_592.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) → FTC.totalScore score P = 0 → ∀ (s : S), FTC.cost a P s = 0
decl_592.source:
theorem cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : totalScore score P = 0) (s : S) : cost a P s = 0 := by
  have hscore0 := score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore
  unfold cost
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  have hle : score x ≤ totalScore score P := Finset.single_le_sum hscore0 hx
  rw [hT] at hle
  have hz : score x = 0 := le_antisymm hle (hscore0 x hx)
  exact loss_zero_of_score_zero ha hscore hx hz s

/-- The degenerate zero-total input has an exact empty summary. -/

decl_593.name: FTC.Probability.empty_coreset_of_totalScore_zero
decl_593.label: Probability.empty_coreset_of_totalScore_zero
decl_593.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_593.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) →
      FTC.totalScore score P = 0 → FTC.IsCoreset 0 (FTC.cost a P) (FTC.cost a ∅)
decl_593.source:
theorem empty_coreset_of_totalScore_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : totalScore score P = 0) : IsCoreset 0 (cost a P) (cost a ∅) := by
  intro s
  rw [cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero ha hscore hT s]
  simp

decl_626.name: FTC.Probability.positiveSupport_score_sum
decl_626.label: Probability.positiveSupport_score_sum
decl_626.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_626.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [DecidableEq J] [inst : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) → ∑ x, score ↑x = FTC.totalScore score P
decl_626.source:
theorem positiveSupport_score_sum {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) :
    (∑ x : PositiveIndex P score, score x.val) = totalScore score P := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  unfold positiveSupport totalScore
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro x hx hxnot
  have hn : ¬ 0 < score x := by
    intro hpos
    exact hxnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hpos⟩)
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) (hscore0 x hx)

/-- Restricting to positive scores does not change any reference query cost. -/

decl_625.name: FTC.Probability.positiveSupport_cost
decl_625.label: Probability.positiveSupport_cost
decl_625.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_625.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) →
      ∀ (s : S), FTC.cost (fun x t => a (↑x) t) Finset.univ s = FTC.cost a P s
decl_625.source:
theorem positiveSupport_cost {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (s : S) :
    cost (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) t => a x.val t) Finset.univ s = cost a P s := by
  classical
  unfold cost
  change (∑ x : PositiveIndex P score, a x.val s) = ∑ x ∈ P, a x s
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (positiveSupport P score) (fun x => a x s)]
  unfold positiveSupport
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro x hx hxnot
  have hn : ¬ 0 < score x := by
    intro hpos
    exact hxnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hpos⟩)
  have hz : score x = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn)
    (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore x hx)
  exact loss_zero_of_score_zero ha hscore hx hz s

/-- The actual one-draw PMF `q_x = score_x / T` on positive-score support. -/

decl_630.name: FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF
decl_630.label: Probability.scoreSupportPMF
decl_630.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_630.statement:
{J : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq J] →
    [inst : MeasurableSpace J] →
      [DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] →
        (P : Finset J) →
          (score : J → ℝ) →
            (∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) → 0 < FTC.totalScore score P → PMF (FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score)
decl_630.source:
def scoreSupportPMF (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) :
    PMF (PositiveIndex P score) :=
  pmfOfMass (fun x => score x.val / totalScore score P)
    (fun x => div_nonneg (positiveIndex_score_pos x).le hT.le)
    (by rw [← Finset.sum_div, positiveSupport_score_sum hscore0]; exact div_self hT.ne')

decl_619.name: FTC.Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF
decl_619.label: Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF
decl_619.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_619.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (P : Finset J)
  (score : J → ℝ) (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P)
  (x : FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score),
  FTC.Probability.mass (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x = score ↑x / FTC.totalScore score P
decl_619.source:
@[simp] theorem mass_scoreSupportPMF (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) :
    mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x = score x.val / totalScore score P := by
  unfold scoreSupportPMF
  rw [mass_pmfOfMass]

decl_620.name: FTC.Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos
decl_620.label: Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos
decl_620.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_620.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J] (P : Finset J)
  (score : J → ℝ) (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P)
  (x : FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score),
  0 < FTC.Probability.mass (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x
decl_620.source:
theorem mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : 0 < mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x := by
  rw [mass_scoreSupportPMF]
  exact div_pos (positiveIndex_score_pos x) hT

/-- The inverse-probability sample contribution is exactly the score-sampling
weight from Lemma 3.2 / Theorem A.1. -/

decl_633.name: FTC.Probability.support_sample_contribution_eq
decl_633.label: Probability.support_sample_contribution_eq
decl_633.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_633.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P)
  {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (sample : Fin m → FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex P score),
      FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContribution (fun x s => a (↑x) s)
          (FTC.Probability.mass (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT)) m sample =
        FTC.sampledContribution a (fun i => ↑(sample i)) score (FTC.totalScore score P) m
decl_633.source:
theorem support_sample_contribution_eq {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score) :
    inverseProbabilityContribution (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s)
        (mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT)) m sample =
      sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m := by
  funext i s
  unfold inverseProbabilityContribution sampledContribution samplingWeight
  rw [mass_scoreSupportPMF]
  rw [inverse_probability_weight hm hT (positiveIndex_score_pos (sample i))]

/-- Complete ordinary coreset guarantee for actual normalized-score iid draws,
with zero-score input indices handled by the support reduction above. -/

decl_627.name: FTC.Probability.scoreSampling_coreset_success
decl_627.label: Probability.scoreSampling_coreset_success
decl_627.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_627.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} (ha : ∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s)
  (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P) {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    0 < failure →
      FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score ⋯ hT) ε failure ≤ m →
        FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (FTC.Probability.iidLaw (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score ⋯ hT) m)
          (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure) fun sample =>
          FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
            (FTC.cost (FTC.sampledContribution a (fun i => ↑(sample i)) score (FTC.totalScore score P) m) Finset.univ)
decl_627.source:
theorem scoreSampling_coreset_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize
      (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) ε failure ≤ m) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast
      (iidLaw (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) m)
      (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
        IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
          (cost (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
            Finset.univ)) := by
  let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize
  have h := iid_coreset_success_of_sampleSize p
    (a := fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s)
    (fun x s => ha x.val s) hε hfailure
    (mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) hsize
  apply h.mono
  intro sample hco
  have href : cost (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s) Finset.univ =
      cost a P := funext (positiveSupport_cost ha hscore)
  rw [href, support_sample_contribution_eq (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT hm sample]
    at hco
  exact hco

/-- The actual normalized-score product distribution now supplies the clean
success hypothesis of Theorem A.1; it is no longer an external assumption. -/

decl_628.name: FTC.Probability.scoreSampling_fault_tolerant
decl_628.label: Probability.scoreSampling_fault_tolerant
decl_628.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Probability/ScoreSampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_628.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} (ha : ∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s)
  (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P) {m f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ε < 1 / 10 →
      0 < failure →
        1 ≤ α →
          FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score ⋯ hT) ε failure ≤ m →
            α * ↑f * FTC.totalScore score P / ε ≤ ↑m →
              FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast
                (FTC.Probability.iidLaw (FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score ⋯ hT) m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
                fun sample =>
                FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                  (FTC.sampledContribution a (fun i => ↑(sample i)) score (FTC.totalScore score P) m) Finset.univ
decl_628.source:
theorem scoreSampling_fault_tolerant {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {m f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hordinary : fallbackSampleSize
      (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) ε failure ≤ m)
    (hfault : α * (f : ℝ) * totalScore score P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ)) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast
      (iidLaw (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) m)
      (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
        FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
          (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
          Finset.univ) := by
  let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hordinary
  exact theorem_A_1_success_probability (iidLaw p m) ha
    (fun sample i => positiveIndex_mem (sample i)) hscore hm hε hεsmall hα hfault
    (scoreSampling_coreset_success ha hscore hT hε hfailure hordinary)

/-- Complete rounded additive construction for the actual iid score sampler.
It certifies the exact number of separately stored copies and its success
probability, using the explicit finite-input fallback as its ordinary count. -/

  (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalScore score P) {f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ε < 1 / 10 →
      0 < failure →
        1 ≤ α →
          have p := FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P score ⋯ hT;
          have m :=
            FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize (FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (FTC.totalScore score P) ε;
          Finset.univ.card = m ∧
            FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure) fun sample =>

decl_629.source:
theorem scoreSampling_fault_tolerant_rounded {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
    let m := faultTolerantSampleSize (fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (totalScore score P) ε
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card = m ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
        (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
          FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
            (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
            Finset.univ) := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  apply scoreSampling_fault_tolerant ha hscore hT hε hεsmall hfailure hα
  · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · exact faultTolerantSampleSize_lower _ f α (totalScore score P) ε

decl_632.label: Explicit IID fault-tolerant sampler
decl_632.summary: Instantiates fault-tolerant sampling with an explicit rounded iid sample count.
decl_632.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq J] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace J] [inst_2 : DiscreteMeasurableSpace J]
  {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} (ha : ∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) (hT : 0 < FTC.totalSensitivity a P) {f : ℕ}
  {ε failure α : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ε < 1 / 10 →
      0 < failure →
        1 ≤ α →
          have p := FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF P (FTC.sensitivity a P) ⋯ hT;
          have m :=
            FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize (FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P)
              ε;
          Finset.univ.card = m ∧
            FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (FTC.Probability.iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure) fun sample =>
              FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                (FTC.sampledContribution a (fun i => ↑(sample i)) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m)
                Finset.univ
decl_632.source:
theorem sensitivitySampling_fault_tolerant_rounded {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hT : 0 < totalSensitivity a P)
    {f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    let p := scoreSupportPMF P (sensitivity a P) (fun x _ => sensitivity_nonneg ha P x) hT
    let m := faultTolerantSampleSize (fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card = m ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
        (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P (sensitivity a P) =>
          FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
            (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) (sensitivity a P)
              (totalSensitivity a P) m) Finset.univ) := by
  exact scoreSampling_fault_tolerant_rounded ha (fun _ _ => le_rfl) hT
    hε hεsmall hfailure hα

end

decl_261.name: FTC.FilteringSuccess
decl_261.label: FilteringSuccess
decl_261.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_261.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq I] → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → (S → ℝ) → (I → S → ℝ) → Finset I → Prop
decl_261.source:
def FilteringSuccess (ε α : ℝ) (f : ℕ) (reference : S → ℝ)
    (c : I → S → ℝ) (U : Finset I) : Prop :=
  IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U) ∧
    ∀ (d : I → S → ℝ), (∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s) →
      ∀ (B : Finset I), B.card ≤ f →
        (∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s) →
        ∀ (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α),
          IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (peel oracle.score f U))

/-- Package the deterministic theorem as the simultaneous success predicate. -/

decl_677.name: FTC.filtering_success_of_entry_bound
decl_677.label: filtering_success_of_entry_bound
decl_677.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_677.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I} {f : ℕ}
  {ε δ α : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ reference s) →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε < 1 / 10 →
          0 ≤ δ →
            1 ≤ α →
              FTC.IsCoreset ε reference (FTC.cost c U) →
                (∀ i ∈ U, ∀ (s : S), c i s ≤ δ * reference s) →
                  ↑f * α * δ ≤ ε → FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f reference c U
decl_677.source:
theorem filtering_success_of_entry_bound {c : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U))
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f reference c U := by
  refine ⟨hcoreset, ?_⟩
  intro d hd B hB hagrees oracle
  exact filtering_decoder_correct hc hd hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα
    hcoreset hB hagrees hentry hbudget oracle

/-- Bridge to Definition 2.1 for actual point/weight corruptions. Once a valid
oracle is supplied on each corrupted summary, Algorithm 1 is a filtering
decoder for a `6ε`-coreset with its inherited weights. -/

decl_262.name: FTC.FilteringSuccess.to_isFilteringFaultTolerant
decl_262.label: FilteringSuccess.to_isFilteringFaultTolerant
decl_262.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_262.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq I] {ε α : ℝ} {f : ℕ} {reference : S → ℝ}
  {loss : X → S → ℝ} {U : Finset I} {entries : I → FTC.Entry X},
  FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (FTC.contribution loss entries) U →
    0 ≤ ε →
      (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ reference s) →
        (∀ (x : X) (s : S), 0 ≤ loss x s) →
          ∀ (oracles : (corrupted : I → FTC.Entry X) → FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle (FTC.contribution loss corrupted) α),
            FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant (6 * ε) f reference loss U entries fun corrupted =>
              FTC.peel (oracles corrupted).score f U
decl_262.source:
theorem FilteringSuccess.to_isFilteringFaultTolerant
    {ε α : ℝ} {f : ℕ} {reference : S → ℝ} {loss : X → S → ℝ}
    {U : Finset I} {entries : I → Entry X}
    (hsuccess : FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (contribution loss entries) U)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hloss : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ loss x s)
    (oracles : ∀ corrupted : I → Entry X,
      ApproxSensitivityOracle (contribution loss corrupted) α) :
    IsFilteringFaultTolerant (6 * ε) f reference loss U entries
      (fun corrupted => peel (oracles corrupted).score f U) := by
  constructor
  · intro s
    have hco := hsuccess.1 s
    have hεref := mul_nonneg hε (hreference s)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro corrupted hcorrupt
    obtain ⟨B, _, hB, hagrees⟩ := hcorrupt
    refine ⟨peel_subset (oracles corrupted).score f U, ?_⟩
    apply hsuccess.2 (contribution loss corrupted)
      (contribution_nonneg loss corrupted hloss) B hB ?_ (oracles corrupted)
    intro i hi hiB s
    simp only [contribution, hagrees i hi hiB]

end Deterministic

        0 < ε →
          ε < 1 / 10 →
            1 ≤ α →
              α * ↑f * FTC.totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ ↑m →
                FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                    (FTC.cost (FTC.sampledContribution a sample (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m) U) →
                  FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                    (FTC.sampledContribution a sample (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m) U
decl_668.source:
theorem exactSampling_filtering_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U := by
  apply filtering_success_of_entry_bound
    (fun i s => sampledContribution_nonneg ha (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P)
      (sensitivity_nonneg ha P (sample i)))
    (cost_nonneg ha P) hε.le hεsmall
    (div_nonneg (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P) (Nat.cast_nonneg m)) hα hcoreset
    (fun i _ s => lemma_3_2 ha hm (hsample i) s)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using sampling_budget hε hm hsize

  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ (i : I), sample i ∈ P) →
      (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) →
        0 < m →
          0 < ε →
            ε < 1 / 10 →
              1 ≤ α →
                α * ↑f * FTC.totalScore score P / ε ≤ ↑m →
                  FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.cost (FTC.sampledContribution a sample score (FTC.totalScore score P) m) U) →
                    FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.sampledContribution a sample score (FTC.totalScore score P) m) U
decl_693.source:
theorem proxySampling_filtering_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {score : J → ℝ} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalScore score P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m) U := by
  have hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x :=
    fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)
  have hT : 0 ≤ totalScore score P := totalScore_nonneg hscore0
  apply filtering_success_of_entry_bound
    (fun i s => sampledContribution_nonneg ha hT (hscore0 _ (hsample i)))
    (cost_nonneg ha P) hε.le hεsmall
    (div_nonneg hT (Nat.cast_nonneg m)) hα hcoreset
    (fun i _ s => proxySampling_entry_bound ha hscore hm (hsample i) s)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using sampling_budget hε hm hsize

variable {I S : Type*} [DecidableEq I]

/-- The standard clean success witness also certifies simultaneous recovery
against all admissible adversaries; the witnessing event is unchanged. -/

decl_678.name: FTC.filtering_success_probability
decl_678.label: filtering_success_probability
decl_678.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_678.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {I : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst_1 : DecidableEq I]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {p : ENNReal} {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I} {f : ℕ}
  {ε δ α : ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ clean ω i s) →
    (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ reference s) →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε < 1 / 10 →
          0 ≤ δ →
            1 ≤ α →
              (∀ (ω : Ω), ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ (s : S), clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s) →
                ↑f * α * δ ≤ ε →
                  (FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω => FTC.IsCoreset ε reference (FTC.cost (clean ω) U)) →
                    FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω => FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U
decl_678.source:
theorem filtering_success_probability {μ : Measure Ω} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I}
    {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ ω i s, 0 ≤ clean ω i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hentry : ∀ ω, ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε reference (cost (clean ω) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U) :=
  hstandard.mono fun ω hco => filtering_success_of_entry_bound (hc ω) hreference
    hε hεsmall hδ hα hco (hentry ω) hbudget

/-- Also, clean-event inclusion gives an outer-measure inequality for the full
predicates. The measurable-witness theorem above is the probability statement. -/

decl_683.name: FTC.outerMeasure_clean_event_le_filtering_event
decl_683.label: outerMeasure_clean_event_le_filtering_event
decl_683.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_683.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {I : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst_1 : DecidableEq I]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ clean ω i s) →
    (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ reference s) →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε < 1 / 10 →
          0 ≤ δ →
            1 ≤ α →
              (∀ (ω : Ω), ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ (s : S), clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s) →
                ↑f * α * δ ≤ ε →
                  μ {ω | FTC.IsCoreset ε reference (FTC.cost (clean ω) U)} ≤
                    μ {ω | FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U}
decl_683.source:
theorem outerMeasure_clean_event_le_filtering_event (μ : Measure Ω)
    {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I}
    {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ ω i s, 0 ≤ clean ω i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hentry : ∀ ω, ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε) :
    μ {ω | IsCoreset ε reference (cost (clean ω) U)} ≤
      μ {ω | FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U} := by
  exact measure_mono fun ω hco => filtering_success_of_entry_bound (hc ω) hreference
    hε hεsmall hδ hα hco (hentry ω) hbudget

end SuccessEvents

section SampleSuccessEvents

variable {Ω I J S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]

/-- Theorem 3.1 for any sufficiently large integer sample count. A standard
sampler's measurable clean-success event of mass `p` yields the same mass `p`
for recovery from every `f`-fault corruption. -/

decl_729.name: FTC.theorem_3_1_success_probability
decl_729.label: theorem_3_1_success_probability
decl_729.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_729.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq J] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J}
  {U : Finset I} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ENNReal},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : I), samples ω i ∈ P) →
      0 < m →
        0 < ε →
          ε < 1 / 10 →
            1 ≤ α →
              α * ↑f * FTC.totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ ↑m →
                (FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                    FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.cost
                        (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m) U)) →
                  FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                    FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m) U
decl_729.source:
theorem theorem_3_1_success_probability (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U) :=
  hstandard.mono fun ω hco =>
    exactSampling_filtering_success ha (hsample ω) hm hε hεsmall hα hsize hco

                        (FTC.cost (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (FTC.totalScore score P) m) U)) →

theorem theorem_A_1_success_probability (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {score : J → ℝ} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}

    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)

        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P) m) U) :=

    proxySampling_filtering_success ha (hsample ω) hscore hm hε hεsmall hα hsize hco

/-- Theorem 3.1 with the rounded additive sample size
`m_sc + ceil(α f T / ε)`. -/

decl_727.name: FTC.theorem_3_1
decl_727.label: Theorem 3.1 · Fault-tolerant sampling
decl_727.summary: Theorem 3.1: transfers an ordinary sensitivity sampler’s success guarantee to fault-tolerant sampling and decoding.
decl_727.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq J] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J}
  {U : Finset I} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ENNReal},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : I), samples ω i ∈ P) →
      0 < m_sc →
        0 < ε →
          ε < 1 / 10 →
            1 ≤ α →
              (FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                  FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                    (FTC.cost
                      (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P)
                        (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε))
                      U)) →
                FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                  FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                    (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P)
                      (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε))
                    U
decl_727.source:
theorem theorem_3_1 (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U) :=
  theorem_3_1_success_probability μ ha hsample (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc)
    hε hεsmall hα (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε) hstandard

/-- Theorem A.1 with the rounded additive proxy-score sample size. -/

decl_730.name: FTC.theorem_A_1
decl_730.label: Theorem A.1 · Proxy-score sampling
decl_730.summary: Theorem A.1: the sampling and decoding guarantee with proxy sensitivity scores.
decl_730.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I]

  {U : Finset I} {score : J → ℝ} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ENNReal},

    (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : I), samples ω i ∈ P) →
      (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) →
        0 < m_sc →
          0 < ε →
            ε < 1 / 10 →
              1 ≤ α →
                (FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                    FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.cost
                        (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (FTC.totalScore score P)

                        U)) →

theorem theorem_A_1 (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {score : J → ℝ} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U) :=

/-- Paper-sized specialization of Theorem 3.1: the stored indices are exactly
`Fin m`, where `m = m_sc + ceil(α f T / ε)`. Its cardinality is certified
explicitly alongside the probability guarantee. Repeated sampled points still
have different stored indices. -/

decl_728.name: FTC.theorem_3_1_fin
decl_728.label: theorem_3_1_fin
decl_728.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sampling.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_728.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {J : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : DecidableEq J]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ENNReal}
  (samples : Ω → Fin (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε) → J),
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : Fin (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε)), samples ω i ∈ P) →
      0 < m_sc →
        0 < ε →
          ε < 1 / 10 →
            1 ≤ α →
              (FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                  FTC.IsCoreset ε (FTC.cost a P)
                    (FTC.cost
                      (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P)
                        (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε))
                      Finset.univ)) →
                Finset.univ.card = FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε ∧
                  FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p fun ω =>
                    FTC.FilteringSuccess ε α f (FTC.cost a P)
                      (FTC.sampledContribution a (samples ω) (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P)
                        (FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) ε))
                      Finset.univ

theorem theorem_3_1_fin (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (samples : Ω → Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε) → J)
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) Finset.univ))) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε))).card =
        faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
        (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
          (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
            (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) Finset.univ) := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  exact theorem_3_1 μ ha hsample hmsc hε hεsmall hα hstandard

theorem theorem_A_1_fin (μ : Measure Ω)

decl_701.name: FTC.samplingWeight
decl_701.label: samplingWeight
decl_701.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.

noncomputable def samplingWeight (score : J → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (x : J) : ℝ :=
  T / ((m : ℝ) * score x)

noncomputable def sampledContribution (a : J → S → ℝ) (sample : I → J)
    (score : J → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (i : I) (s : S) : ℝ :=
