decl_735.name: FTC.totalSensitivity
decl_735.label: totalSensitivity
decl_735.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_735.statement: {J : Type u_2} → {S : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq J] → (J → S → ℝ) → Finset J → ℝ
decl_735.source:
noncomputable def totalSensitivity (a : J → S → ℝ) (P : Finset J) : ℝ :=
  totalScore (sensitivity a P) P

decl_734.name: FTC.totalScore_nonneg
decl_734.label: totalScore_nonneg
decl_734.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_734.statement: ∀ {J : Type u_2} [DecidableEq J] {score : J → ℝ} {P : Finset J}, (∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) → 0 ≤ FTC.totalScore score P

decl_736.name: FTC.totalSensitivity_nonneg
decl_736.label: totalSensitivity_nonneg
decl_736.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_736.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) → ∀ (P : Finset J), 0 ≤ FTC.totalSensitivity a P
decl_736.source:
theorem totalSensitivity_nonneg {a : J → S → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (P : Finset J) :
    0 ≤ totalSensitivity a P :=
  totalScore_nonneg fun x _ => sensitivity_nonneg ha P x

decl_702.name: FTC.samplingWeight_nonneg
decl_702.label: samplingWeight_nonneg
decl_702.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_702.statement:
∀ {J : Type u_2} [DecidableEq J] {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {x : J},
  0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ score x → 0 ≤ FTC.samplingWeight score T m x
decl_702.source:
theorem samplingWeight_nonneg {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {x : J}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hscore : 0 ≤ score x) :
    0 ≤ samplingWeight score T m x :=
  div_nonneg hT (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hscore)

decl_700.name: FTC.sampledContribution_nonneg
decl_700.label: sampledContribution_nonneg
decl_700.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_700.source:
theorem sampledContribution_nonneg {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I} {s : S}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hscore : 0 ≤ score (sample i)) :
    0 ≤ sampledContribution a sample score T m i s :=
  mul_nonneg (samplingWeight_nonneg hT hscore) (ha _ _)

/-- This identifies the weight with `1 / (m q_x)` for `q_x = score_x / T`.
The positivity hypotheses describe the support of the actual sampler. -/

decl_680.name: FTC.inverse_probability_weight
decl_680.label: inverse_probability_weight
decl_680.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_680.source:
theorem inverse_probability_weight {m : ℕ} {T t : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hT : 0 < T) (ht : 0 < t) :
    1 / ((m : ℝ) * (t / T)) = T / ((m : ℝ) * t) := by
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  field_simp [hm', hT.ne', ht.ne']

/-- Scalar cancellation underlying both exact and proxy sampling bounds.
When a score is zero the assigned contribution is zero, so the same bound
also covers that boundary case. -/

decl_681.name: FTC.inverse_score_contribution_le
decl_681.label: inverse_score_contribution_le
decl_681.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_681.source:
theorem inverse_score_contribution_le {v L t T : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcontribution : v ≤ t * L) :
    (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * v ≤ (T / (m : ℝ)) * L := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · simp only [ht0, mul_zero, div_zero, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hT (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hL
  · have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
    calc
      (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * v ≤ (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * (t * L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcontribution
          (div_nonneg hT (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ht))
      _ = (T / (m : ℝ)) * L := by field_simp [hm', ht0]

/-- The generic entry bound: any score dominating the input sensitivity works. -/

decl_699.name: FTC.sampledContribution_le
decl_699.label: sampledContribution_le
decl_699.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_699.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J} {P : Finset J}
  {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    sample i ∈ P →
      FTC.sensitivity a P (sample i) ≤ score (sample i) →
        0 ≤ T → 0 < m → ∀ (s : S), FTC.sampledContribution a sample score T m i s ≤ T / ↑m * FTC.cost a P s
decl_699.source:
theorem sampledContribution_le {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hi : sample i ∈ P)
    (hscore : sensitivity a P (sample i) ≤ score (sample i))
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hm : 0 < m) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample score T m i s ≤
      (T / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s := by
  have hscore0 : 0 ≤ score (sample i) :=
    (sensitivity_nonneg ha P (sample i)).trans hscore
  apply inverse_score_contribution_le (cost_nonneg ha P s) hscore0 hT hm
  exact (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost ha hi s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscore (cost_nonneg ha P s))

/-- Lemma 3.2: every indexed copy drawn by exact sensitivity sampling has
weighted contribution at most `T / m` times the input cost. -/

decl_682.name: FTC.lemma_3_2
decl_682.label: Lemma 3.2 · Per-copy contribution
decl_682.summary: Lemma 3.2: bounds the contribution of each sampled copy relative to the original objective.
decl_682.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J} {P : Finset J}
  {m : ℕ} {i : I},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    0 < m →
      sample i ∈ P →
        ∀ (s : S),
          FTC.sampledContribution a sample (FTC.sensitivity a P) (FTC.totalSensitivity a P) m i s ≤
            FTC.totalSensitivity a P / ↑m * FTC.cost a P s
decl_682.source:
theorem lemma_3_2 {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J} {P : Finset J}
    {m : ℕ} {i : I} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hi : sample i ∈ P) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m i s ≤
      (totalSensitivity a P / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s :=
  sampledContribution_le ha hi le_rfl (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P) hm s

/-- The entry-bound extension used in Theorem A.1, with total proxy score. -/

decl_692.name: FTC.proxySampling_entry_bound
decl_692.label: proxySampling_entry_bound
decl_692.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_692.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq J] {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J} {P : Finset J}
  {score : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I},
  (∀ (x : J) (s : S), 0 ≤ a x s) →
    (∀ x ∈ P, FTC.sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) →
      0 < m →
        sample i ∈ P →
          ∀ (s : S),
            FTC.sampledContribution a sample score (FTC.totalScore score P) m i s ≤
              FTC.totalScore score P / ↑m * FTC.cost a P s
decl_692.source:
theorem proxySampling_entry_bound {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hi : sample i ∈ P) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m i s ≤
      (totalScore score P / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s := by
  apply sampledContribution_le ha hi (hscore _ hi) _ hm s
  exact totalScore_nonneg fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)

/-- The usual sample-size lower bound implies the deterministic filtering
budget `α f (T/m) ≤ ε`. -/

decl_703.name: FTC.sampling_budget
decl_703.label: sampling_budget
decl_703.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_703.source:
theorem sampling_budget {α ε T : ℝ} {f m : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε ≤ (m : ℝ)) :
    α * (f : ℝ) * (T / (m : ℝ)) ≤ ε := by
  have hm' : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hm').2
  have h := (div_le_iff₀ hε).1 hsize
  nlinarith

/-- The integer sample size corresponding to the paper's additive overhead. -/

decl_671.name: FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize
decl_671.label: faultTolerantSampleSize
decl_671.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_671.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ
decl_671.source:
noncomputable def faultTolerantSampleSize (m_sc f : ℕ) (α T ε : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  m_sc + ⌈α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε⌉₊

decl_672.name: FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize_lower
decl_672.label: faultTolerantSampleSize_lower
decl_672.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_672.statement: ∀ (m_sc f : ℕ) (α T ε : ℝ), α * ↑f * T / ε ≤ ↑(FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε)
decl_672.source:
theorem faultTolerantSampleSize_lower (m_sc f : ℕ) (α T ε : ℝ) :
    α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε ≤ (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε : ℝ) := by
  unfold faultTolerantSampleSize
  rw [Nat.cast_add]
  exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

decl_673.name: FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize_pos
decl_673.label: faultTolerantSampleSize_pos
decl_673.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_673.statement: ∀ {m_sc f : ℕ} {α T ε : ℝ}, 0 < m_sc → 0 < FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε
decl_673.source:
theorem faultTolerantSampleSize_pos {m_sc f : ℕ} {α T ε : ℝ}
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) : 0 < faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le hmsc (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

/-- Rounded sample size, in the multiplication order of the deterministic
filtering theorem's budget. -/

decl_704.name: FTC.sampling_budget_ceil
decl_704.label: sampling_budget_ceil
decl_704.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/SamplingWeights.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_704.statement: ∀ {α ε T : ℝ} {f m_sc : ℕ}, 0 < ε → 0 < m_sc → ↑f * α * (T / ↑(FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε)) ≤ ε
decl_704.source:
theorem sampling_budget_ceil {α ε T : ℝ} {f m_sc : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) :
    (f : ℝ) * α * (T / (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε : ℝ)) ≤ ε := by
  have h := sampling_budget (α := α) (T := T) (f := f) hε
    (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc) (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α T ε)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h

end FTC

decl_635.name: FTC.SelectionRule
decl_635.label: SelectionRule
decl_635.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_635.source:
structure SelectionRule (I : Type*) [DecidableEq I] where
  select : (Q : Finset I) → Q.Nonempty → I
  select_mem : ∀ Q h, select Q h ∈ Q

decl_636.name: FTC.SelectionRule.IsMaxFor
decl_636.label: SelectionRule.IsMaxFor
decl_636.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_636.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [inst : DecidableEq I] → FTC.SelectionRule I → (Finset I → I → ℝ) → Prop
decl_636.source:
def SelectionRule.IsMaxFor (rule : SelectionRule I) (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ Q h, ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q (rule.select Q h)

decl_709.name: FTC.selectionStep
decl_709.label: selectionStep
decl_709.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_709.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [inst : DecidableEq I] → FTC.SelectionRule I → Finset I → Finset I
decl_709.source:
def selectionStep (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  if h : Q.Nonempty then Q.erase (rule.select Q h) else Q

decl_705.name: FTC.selectionRun
decl_705.label: selectionRun
decl_705.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_705.statement: {I : Type u_1} → [inst : DecidableEq I] → FTC.SelectionRule I → ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
decl_705.source:
def selectionRun (rule : SelectionRule I) : ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
  | 0, Q => Q
  | n + 1, Q => selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)

decl_711.name: FTC.selectionStep_spec
decl_711.label: selectionStep_spec
decl_711.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_711.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I},
  Q.Nonempty → ∃ g ∈ Q, FTC.selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g
decl_711.source:
theorem selectionStep_spec (rule : SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g := by
  exact ⟨rule.select Q h, rule.select_mem Q h, by simp [selectionStep, h]⟩

decl_710.name: FTC.selectionStep_removes
decl_710.label: selectionStep_removes
decl_710.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_710.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {score : Finset I → I → ℝ},
  rule.IsMaxFor score →
    ∀ {Q : Finset I}, Q.Nonempty → ∃ g ∈ Q, FTC.selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g
decl_710.source:
theorem selectionStep_removes (rule : SelectionRule I) {score : Finset I → I → ℝ}
    (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score) {Q : Finset I} (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g := by
  exact ⟨rule.select Q h, rule.select_mem Q h, by simp [selectionStep, h], hmax Q h⟩

decl_712.name: FTC.selectionStep_subset
decl_712.label: selectionStep_subset
decl_712.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_712.statement: ∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I), FTC.selectionStep rule Q ⊆ Q
decl_712.source:
theorem selectionStep_subset (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionStep rule Q ⊆ Q := by
  unfold selectionStep
  split
  · exact Finset.erase_subset _ _
  · exact Finset.Subset.refl _

decl_643.name: FTC.card_le_selectionStep_add_one
decl_643.label: card_le_selectionStep_add_one
decl_643.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_643.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I),
  Q.card ≤ (FTC.selectionStep rule Q).card + 1
decl_643.source:
theorem card_le_selectionStep_add_one (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (selectionStep rule Q).card + 1 := by
  by_cases h : Q.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep⟩ := selectionStep_spec rule h
    rw [hstep]
    have := Finset.card_erase_add_one hg
    omega
  · simp [selectionStep, h]

decl_647.name: FTC.card_selectionStep_add_one
decl_647.label: card_selectionStep_add_one
decl_647.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_647.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I},
  Q.Nonempty → (FTC.selectionStep rule Q).card + 1 = Q.card
decl_647.source:
theorem card_selectionStep_add_one (rule : SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : (selectionStep rule Q).card + 1 = Q.card := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep⟩ := selectionStep_spec rule h
  rw [hstep]
  exact Finset.card_erase_add_one hg

decl_708.name: FTC.selectionRun_subset
decl_708.label: selectionRun_subset
decl_708.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_708.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  FTC.selectionRun rule n Q ⊆ Q
decl_708.source:
theorem selectionRun_subset (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionRun rule n Q ⊆ Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ n ih => exact (ih _).trans (selectionStep_subset rule Q)

decl_706.name: FTC.selectionRun_add
decl_706.label: selectionRun_add
decl_706.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_706.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  FTC.selectionRun rule (n + m) Q = FTC.selectionRun rule m (FTC.selectionRun rule n Q)
decl_706.source:
theorem selectionRun_add (rule : SelectionRule I) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionRun rule (n + m) Q = selectionRun rule m (selectionRun rule n Q) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih => simpa [Nat.succ_add, selectionRun] using ih (selectionStep rule Q)

decl_707.name: FTC.selectionRun_antitone
decl_707.label: selectionRun_antitone
decl_707.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_707.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {n m : ℕ},
  n ≤ m → ∀ (Q : Finset I), FTC.selectionRun rule m Q ⊆ FTC.selectionRun rule n Q
decl_707.source:
theorem selectionRun_antitone (rule : SelectionRule I) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (Q : Finset I) : selectionRun rule m Q ⊆ selectionRun rule n Q := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [selectionRun_add]
  exact selectionRun_subset rule d _

decl_642.name: FTC.card_le_selectionRun_add
decl_642.label: card_le_selectionRun_add
decl_642.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_642.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  Q.card ≤ (FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).card + n
decl_642.source:
theorem card_le_selectionRun_add (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (selectionRun rule n Q).card + n := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (selectionStep rule Q)
    have hstep := card_le_selectionStep_add_one rule Q
    change Q.card ≤ (selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)).card + (n + 1)
    omega

decl_646.name: FTC.card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty
decl_646.label: card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty
decl_646.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_646.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty → (FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).card + n = Q.card
decl_646.source:
theorem card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty) :
    (selectionRun rule n Q).card + n = Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hs : (selectionStep rule Q).Nonempty := h.mono (selectionRun_subset rule n _)
    have hq : Q.Nonempty := hs.mono (selectionStep_subset rule Q)
    have hcard := card_selectionStep_add_one rule hq
    have hind := ih (selectionStep rule Q) h
    change (selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)).card + (n + 1) = Q.card
    omega

decl_715.name: FTC.selection_removed_card_le
decl_715.label: selection_removed_card_le
decl_715.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_715.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (Q \ FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).card ≤ n
decl_715.source:
theorem selection_removed_card_le (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (Q \ selectionRun rule n Q).card ≤ n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (selectionRun_subset rule n Q)]
  have := card_le_selectionRun_add rule n Q
  omega

decl_714.name: FTC.selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty
decl_714.label: selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty
decl_714.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_714.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I),
  (FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty → (Q \ FTC.selectionRun rule n Q).card = n
decl_714.source:
theorem selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty) :
    (Q \ selectionRun rule n Q).card = n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (selectionRun_subset rule n Q)]
  have := card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty rule n Q h
  omega

decl_716.name: FTC.selection_removed_has_stage
decl_716.label: selection_removed_has_stage
decl_716.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_716.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {score : Finset I → I → ℝ},
  rule.IsMaxFor score →
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I} {x : I},
      x ∈ Q →
        x ∉ FTC.selectionRun rule n Q →
          ∃ t < n,
            x ∈ FTC.selectionRun rule t Q ∧
              ∀ y ∈ FTC.selectionRun rule t Q, score (FTC.selectionRun rule t Q) y ≤ score (FTC.selectionRun rule t Q) x
decl_716.source:
theorem selection_removed_has_stage (rule : SelectionRule I)
    {score : Finset I → I → ℝ} (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score)
    {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I} {x : I}
    (hx : x ∈ Q) (hgone : x ∉ selectionRun rule n Q) :
    ∃ t < n, x ∈ selectionRun rule t Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ selectionRun rule t Q,
        score (selectionRun rule t Q) y ≤ score (selectionRun rule t Q) x := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hgone hx)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hs : x ∈ selectionStep rule Q
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt, hmaxT⟩ := ih hs hgone
      refine ⟨t + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [selectionRun] using hxt
      · simpa [selectionRun] using hmaxT
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, hmaxQ⟩ := selectionStep_removes rule hmax ⟨x, hx⟩
      have heq : x = g := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hs (hstep.symm ▸ Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hx⟩)
      subst x
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n, hg, hmaxQ⟩

decl_713.name: FTC.selection_good_stage_of_bad_remaining
decl_713.label: selection_good_stage_of_bad_remaining
decl_713.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Selection.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_713.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (rule : FTC.SelectionRule I) {score : Finset I → I → ℝ},
  rule.IsMaxFor score →
    ∀ (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ),
      B.card ≤ f →
        (FTC.selectionRun rule f U ∩ B).Nonempty →
          ∃ t < f,
            ∃ g ∈ FTC.selectionRun rule t U,
              g ∉ B ∧
                ∀ y ∈ FTC.selectionRun rule t U,
                  score (FTC.selectionRun rule t U) y ≤ score (FTC.selectionRun rule t U) g
decl_713.source:
theorem selection_good_stage_of_bad_remaining (rule : SelectionRule I)
    {score : Finset I → I → ℝ} (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score)
    (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hbad : (selectionRun rule f U ∩ B).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t < f, ∃ g ∈ selectionRun rule t U, g ∉ B ∧
      ∀ y ∈ selectionRun rule t U,
        score (selectionRun rule t U) y ≤ score (selectionRun rule t U) g := by
  let R := selectionRun rule f U
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hbad
  have hbR : b ∈ R := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).1
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hcard : (U \ R).card = f := selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty rule f U ⟨b, hbR⟩
  have hex : ∃ g ∈ U \ R, g ∉ B := by
    by_contra h
    have hsub : insert b (U \ R) ⊆ B := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact hbB
      · by_contra hxB
        exact h ⟨x, hx, hxB⟩
    have hbnot : b ∉ U \ R := by simp [hbR]
    have hlarge := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbnot, hcard] at hlarge
    omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgB⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨hgU, hgR⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgt, hmaxT⟩ := selection_removed_has_stage rule hmax hgU hgR
  exact ⟨t, ht, g, hgt, hgB, hmaxT⟩

end FTC

decl_718.name: FTC.sensitivityRatios
decl_718.label: sensitivityRatios
decl_718.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_718.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → (I → S → ℝ) → Finset I → I → Set ℝ

decl_717.name: FTC.sensitivity
decl_717.label: sensitivity
decl_717.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_717.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq I] → (I → S → ℝ) → Finset I → I → ℝ

decl_657.name: FTC.contribution_ratio_le_one
decl_657.label: contribution_ratio_le_one
decl_657.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_657.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) → ∀ {Q : Finset I} {i : I}, i ∈ Q → ∀ (s : S), c i s / FTC.cost c Q s ≤ 1
decl_657.source:
theorem contribution_ratio_le_one (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) :
    c i s / cost c Q s ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s := lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
    exact (div_le_one hpos).2 (contribution_le_cost hc hi s)

decl_719.name: FTC.sensitivityRatios_bddAbove
decl_719.label: sensitivityRatios_bddAbove
decl_719.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_719.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) → ∀ {Q : Finset I} {i : I}, i ∈ Q → BddAbove (FTC.sensitivityRatios c Q i)
decl_719.source:
theorem sensitivityRatios_bddAbove (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    BddAbove (sensitivityRatios c Q i) := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
  · norm_num
  · exact contribution_ratio_le_one hc hi s

decl_720.name: FTC.sensitivityRatios_nonempty
decl_720.label: sensitivityRatios_nonempty
decl_720.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_720.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [DecidableEq I] (c : I → S → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) (i : I),
  (FTC.sensitivityRatios c Q i).Nonempty
decl_720.source:
theorem sensitivityRatios_nonempty (c : I → S → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (sensitivityRatios c Q i).Nonempty :=
  ⟨0, by simp [sensitivityRatios]⟩

decl_725.name: FTC.sensitivity_nonneg
decl_725.label: sensitivity_nonneg
decl_725.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_725.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) → ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), 0 ≤ FTC.sensitivity c Q i
decl_725.source:
theorem sensitivity_nonneg (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ sensitivity c Q i := by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Q
  · rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hc hi) (by simp [sensitivityRatios])
  · simp [sensitivity, hi]

decl_723.name: FTC.sensitivity_le_one
decl_723.label: sensitivity_le_one
decl_723.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_723.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) → ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), FTC.sensitivity c Q i ≤ 1
decl_723.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_one (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Q
  · rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    apply csSup_le (sensitivityRatios_nonempty c Q i)
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
    · norm_num
    · exact contribution_ratio_le_one hc hi s
  · simp [sensitivity, hi]

decl_726.name: FTC.sensitivity_of_not_mem
decl_726.label: sensitivity_of_not_mem
decl_726.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_726.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ} {Q : Finset I} {i : I},
  i ∉ Q → FTC.sensitivity c Q i = 0
decl_726.source:
@[simp] theorem sensitivity_of_not_mem {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∉ Q) :
    sensitivity c Q i = 0 := by
  simp [sensitivity, hi]

/-- The sensitivity controls a contribution even for a zero-cost query. -/

decl_655.name: FTC.contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost
decl_655.label: contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost
decl_655.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_655.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    ∀ {Q : Finset I} {i : I}, i ∈ Q → ∀ (s : S), c i s ≤ FTC.sensitivity c Q i * FTC.cost c Q s
decl_655.source:
theorem contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) :
    c i s ≤ sensitivity c Q i * cost c Q s := by
  by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
  · have hci : c i s = 0 := cost_eq_zero_contribution hc hi hz
    simp [hz, hci]
  · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s := lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).1
    rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hc hi)
      (by exact Or.inr ⟨s, rfl⟩)

/-- A uniform contribution bound gives an upper bound on the exact supremum. -/

decl_721.name: FTC.sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le
decl_721.label: sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le
decl_721.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_721.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    ∀ {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {r : ℝ},
      i ∈ Q → 0 ≤ r → (∀ (s : S), c i s ≤ r * FTC.cost c Q s) → FTC.sensitivity c Q i ≤ r
decl_721.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {r : ℝ} (hi : i ∈ Q) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbound : ∀ s, c i s ≤ r * cost c Q s) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ r := by
  rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
  apply csSup_le (sensitivityRatios_nonempty c Q i)
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
  · exact hr
  · by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
    · simpa [hz] using hr
    · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hpos).2 (hbound s)

/-- The useful form for a good sampled entry during filtering: a per-entry
bound relative to the input, and a lower bound for the current summary, suffice. -/

decl_722.name: FTC.sensitivity_le_of_reference_bound
decl_722.label: sensitivity_le_of_reference_bound
decl_722.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_722.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    ∀ {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {reference : S → ℝ} {δ β : ℝ},
      i ∈ Q →
        0 ≤ δ →
          0 < β →
            (∀ (s : S), c i s ≤ δ * reference s) →
              (∀ (s : S), β * reference s ≤ FTC.cost c Q s) → FTC.sensitivity c Q i ≤ δ / β
decl_722.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_of_reference_bound (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {reference : S → ℝ} {δ β : ℝ}
    (hi : i ∈ Q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hentry : ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hcost : ∀ s, β * reference s ≤ cost c Q s) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ δ / β := by
  apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hc hi (div_nonneg hδ hβ.le)
  intro s
  calc
    c i s ≤ δ * reference s := hentry s
    _ = (δ / β) * (β * reference s) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hβ.ne']
    _ ≤ (δ / β) * cost c Q s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcost s) (div_nonneg hδ hβ.le)

/-- Removing entries can only increase the sensitivity of an entry retained. -/

decl_724.name: FTC.sensitivity_mono_denominator
decl_724.label: sensitivity_mono_denominator
decl_724.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_724.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq I] {c : I → S → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : I) (s : S), 0 ≤ c i s) →
    ∀ {Q R : Finset I} {i : I}, Q ⊆ R → i ∈ Q → FTC.sensitivity c R i ≤ FTC.sensitivity c Q i
decl_724.source:
theorem sensitivity_mono_denominator (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q R : Finset I} {i : I} (hQR : Q ⊆ R) (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    sensitivity c R i ≤ sensitivity c Q i := by
  apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hc (hQR hi) (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i)
  intro s
  exact (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost hc hi s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_mono hc hQR s) (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i))

/-- An `α`-approximate oracle, in the multiplicative form used in the peeling
proof. For positive `α`, `lower` is equivalent to `σ / α ≤ score`. -/

decl_0.name: FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle
decl_0.label: ApproxSensitivityOracle
decl_0.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_0.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq I] → (I → S → ℝ) → ℝ → Type u_1
decl_0.source:
structure ApproxSensitivityOracle (c : I → S → ℝ) (α : ℝ) where
  score : Finset I → I → ℝ
  lower : ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), i ∈ Q → sensitivity c Q i ≤ α * score Q i
  upper : ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), i ∈ Q → score Q i ≤ sensitivity c Q i

decl_1.name: FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle.div_le_score
decl_1.label: ApproxSensitivityOracle.div_le_score
decl_1.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_1.source:
theorem ApproxSensitivityOracle.div_le_score {α : ℝ}
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle c α) (hα : 0 < α)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    sensitivity c Q i / α ≤ oracle.score Q i := by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using oracle.lower Q i hi

decl_2.name: FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle.score_nonneg
decl_2.label: ApproxSensitivityOracle.score_nonneg
decl_2.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_2.source:
theorem ApproxSensitivityOracle.score_nonneg {α : ℝ}
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle c α) (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (hα : 0 < α) {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    0 ≤ oracle.score Q i :=
  (div_nonneg (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i) hα.le).trans
    (oracle.div_le_score hα hi)

/-- Exact sensitivity is an oracle with approximation factor one. -/

decl_670.name: FTC.exactSensitivityOracle
decl_670.label: exactSensitivityOracle
decl_670.summary: Declaration in FaultTolerantCoresets/Sensitivity.lean. See the Lean statement and proof below.
decl_670.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → [inst : DecidableEq I] → (c : I → S → ℝ) → FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle c 1
decl_670.source:
noncomputable def exactSensitivityOracle (c : I → S → ℝ) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle c 1 where
  score := sensitivity c
  lower := by intros; simp
  upper := by intros; exact le_rfl

end FTC
